verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice;
Him serve with fear, his praise forth tell.
Come ye before him, and rejoice.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Know that the Lord is God indeed;
Without our aid he did us make;
We are his flock, he doth us feed,
And for his sheep he doth us take.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O enter then his gates with praise;
Approach with joy his courts so true;
Laud, and bless His name always.
For it is seemly so to do.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: For why, the Lord our God is good;
His mercy is forever sure;
His truth at all times firmly stood,
And shall from age to age endure.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: To Father, Son and Holy Ghost,
The God whom heaven and earth adore.
From men and from the angel host
Be praise and glory evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: All the earth proclaim the Lord,
Sing your praise to God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Serve you the Lord, heart filled with gladness,
Come into His Presence singing for joy!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Know that the Lord is our Creator.
Yes, He is our Father; we are His sons.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: We are the sheep of His green pasture,
For we are His people; He is our God.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Enter His gates bringing thanksgiving,
O enter His courts while singing His praise.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Our Lord is good, His love enduring,
His word is abiding now with all people.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Honour and praise be to the Father,
The Son, and the Spirit, world without end.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Glory to God, glory,
O praise him alleluia!
Glory to God, glory,
O praise the name of the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Bless the Lord all you works of the Lord
Praise and glorify Him forever.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sun and moon bless the Lord
Bless the Lord you stars of heaven.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Light and darkness bless the Lord
Bless the Lord you nights and days.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Now let the earth bless the Lord
Praise and glorify Him forever.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Mountains and hills bless the Lord
Bless the Lord you seas and rivers.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Now let the Church bless the Lord
Let his people praise His name.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Bless the Lord you saints of the Lord
Peoples near and far, praise His name.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Praise to Father and to the Son,
To the Holy Spirit Three in One.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come, let us sing songs of glory,
Let us clap our hands and shout for joy.
From day to day God will show the way:

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Glory! sing glory! glory,
Give the glory due and sing:
Glory unto God the King.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: God is our King and our Father;
He's a mighty God and King of Kings.
He filled the seas, and He made the trees.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Ours is the joy of His people;
We can walk in safety at his side
In stormy night, He will give us light.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let us remain ever faithful,
Let us always know that He is near,
Light from above, teaching us to love.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come sound His praise abroad
And nile of glory sing:
Jesus is the sovereign Lord,
The universal King.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Praise Ye the Lord, Alleluia!
Praise Ye the Lord Alleluia!
Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!
Praise Ye the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: He formed the deeps unknown;
He gave the seas their bounds:
The watery worlds are all His own
And all the solid ground.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Come, worship at His throne,
Come bow before the Lord:
We are His work, and not our own,
He formed us by His word.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: To-day attend His voice,
Nor dare provoke His rod:
Come like the people of His choice,
And own your gracious God.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come, Thou almighty King,
Help us your name to sing.
Help us to praise!
Father all glorious, wholly victorious.
Come and rule over us, Ancient of Days.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Come, Thou Incarnate Word,
And make your message heard
Our prayer attend;
Come and your people bless,
And give your word success;
And let your holiness, to us descend.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Come, holy Comforter,
Your sacred witness bear,
In this glad hour;
You who almighty art, enlighten every heart
From us do not depart, Spirit of pow'r.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: To you, great One in Three,
Eternal praises be,
Hence, ever more!
Your sovereign majesty, may we in glory see,
And to eternity love and adore.

title: COME TO THE SPRINGS OF LIVING WATER

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come to the springs of living water
Flowing from the heart of God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Come from the distant valley to the mountain
of the Lord,
Come from the far-off islands to God
Nation arise,
Cast the clouds of darkness from your eyes.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Come with your precious ointment to the
mountain of the Lord.
Come with your humble offerings to God.
Come to him now.
Hasten to pay him your vows.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Come with guitars and cymbals to the
mountain of the Lord.
Come with your music singing to God.
Lift up your voice.
Ours is the God of Jacob, rejoice.

title: CRY OUT WITH JOY TO THE LORD (PSALM 100)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Arise, come to your God,
Sing Him your songs of rejoicing.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Glory to you, O God!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Cry out with joy to the Lord all the earth,
Serve the Lord with gladness,
Come before Him singing for joy.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Know that He the Lord is God,
He made us we belong to him,
We are His people, the sheep of His flock.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Go within his gates giving thanks,
Enter His courts with songs of praise,
Give thanks to Him and bless His name.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Indeed how good is the Lord
Eternal His merciful love;
He is faithful from age to age.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Give glory to the Father Almighty,
To his Son, Jesus Christ, the Lord,
To the Spirit who dwells in our hearts.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Father, within thy house today,
We wait thy kindly love to see,
Since thou hast said in truth that they,
Who dwell in love are one with thee,
Bless those who for thy blessing wait;
Their love accept and consecrate.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Dear Lord of Love, whose heart of fire,
So full of pity for our sin,
Was once in that divine desire,
Broken, thy Bride to woo and win,
Look down and bless them from above,
And keep their hearts alight with love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Blest Spirit, who with life and light,
Didst quicken chaos to thy praise,
Whose energy, in sin's despite,
Still lifts our nature up to grace,
Bless those who here in truth consent;
Creator, crown thy Sacrament.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Great One in Three, of whom are named,
All families on earth and heaven,
Hear us, who have thy promise claimed.
And let a wealth of grace be given;
Grant them in life and death to be,
Each knit to each, and both to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Blessed is he who delights
in the law of the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Happy indeed is the man who follows
Not the counsel of the wicked,
Not lingers in the way of sinners
Not lingers in the way of sinners,
Nor sits in the company of scorners,
But whose delight is the law of the Lord
And who ponders his law day and night.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: He is like a tree that is planted
Beside the flowing waters,
That yields its fruit in due season
And whose leaves shall never fade;
And all that he does shall proper.
Not so are the wicked, not so!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: For they like winnowed chaff
Shall be driven away by the wind.
When the wicked are judged,
they shall not stand,
Nor find room among those who are just,
For the Lord guards the way of the just,
But the way of the wicked leads to doom.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Give praise to the Father Almighty,
To his Son, Jesus Christ, the Lord,
To the Spirit who dwells in our hearts,
Both now and forever. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hark, my soul, how everything
Strives to serve our bounteous King;
Each a double tribute pays,
Sings its part, and then obeys.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Nature's chief and sweetest choir,
Him with cheerful notes admire;
Chanting every day their lauds,
While the grove their song applauds.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Though their voices lower be,
Streams have too their melody;
Night and day they warbling run,
Never pause, but still sing on.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: All the flowers that gild the spring,
Hither their still music bring;
If heaven bless them, thankful, they
Smell more sweet, and look more gay.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Only we can scare afford,
This short office to our Lord;
We, on whom his bounty flows,
All things give, and nothing owes.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Wake, for shame, my sluggish heart,
Wake, and gladly sing your part;
Learn of birds, and springs, and flowers,
How to use your noblest powers.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Call whole nature to your aid;
Since 'twas he whole nature made;
Join in one eternal song,
Who to one God all belong.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hear, O thou bounteous Maker, hear,
Our humble vows with gracious ear;
Turn not thy saving face away,
Whilst on this solemn feast we pray.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Great searcher of our hearts, to thee,
We here deplore our misery;
Behold, we to thy mercies fly,
Do thou thy healing grace apply.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Great are our sins, O Lord, but thou
Canst pardon more than we can do;
May our defects, like shadows, raise
The beauty and the life of grace.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: May fasts extinguish in our will,
The fuel and desire of oil,
And thus our souls from fetters free
May only thirst and follow thee.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Grant, O most sacred Trinity,
One undivided Unity,
That abstinence may here improve,
Our claim to reign with thee above.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: King high exalted, all the world's redeemer,
To thee thy children lift their eyes with weeping;
Christ, we implore thee, hear our supplications.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hear us, O Lord, and have mercy upon us,
For we have sinned against thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Right hand of Godhead, headstone of the corner,
Path of salvation, gate of heaven's kingdom,
Cleanse thou thy people,
stained with their transgressions.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: We, they eternal majesty entreating,
Make lamentation in thy holy hearing;
Gracious, grant thou to our sins indulgence.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Humbly confess we,
who have sinned against thee,
All our misdoings, hidden now no longer,
May thy redeeming mercy find us pardon.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Led away captive, guiltless, unresisting,
Brought by false witness unto death for sinners,
Christ do thou keep us whom thy blood
hath ransomed.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Here we are, all together;
As we sing our song joyfully;
Here we are, joined together,
As we pray we'll always be.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Join we now as friends, and celebrate
The brotherhood we share, all as one.
Keep the fire burning, kindle it with care,
And we'll all join in and sing.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Let us make the world an alleluia,
Let us make the world a better place.
Keep a smile handy, have a helping hand,
Let us all join in and sing.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Ho! my comrades see the signal
waving in the sky
Reinforcement now appearing, victory is nigh.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hold the fort for I am coming,
Jesus signals still,
Wave the answer back to heaven,
By the grace, we will.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: See the mighty host advancing,
Satan leading on,
Mighty men around us falling courage
almost gone.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: See the glorious banner waving,
Hear the trumpet blow;
In our leaders name we triumph,
over every foe.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Fierce and long the battle rages,
But our help is near.
Onward comes our great Commander,
Cheer my comrades, cheer.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Holy, holy, holy! Lord God almighty!
Early in the morning our song shall rise to thee;
Holy, holy, holy! merciful and mighty!
God in three persons, blessed Trinity!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Holy, holy, holy! all the saints adore thee.
Casting down their golden crowns
around the glassy sea;
Cherubim and seraphim falling down
before thee,
Which wert, and art and evermore shalt be.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Holy, holy, holy! Lord God almighty!
All thy works shall praise thy name, on earth,
and sky, and sea;
Holy, holy, holy! merciful and mighty!
God in three persons, blessed Trinity.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Holy, holy, holy! though the darkness hide thee,
Though the eye of sinful man thy glory
may not see,
Only thou art holy, there is none beside thee
Perfect in power, in love, and purity.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hosanna! Hosanna! Hosanna!
Blessed is He that cometh,
Blessed is He that cometh,
Blessed is He that cometh,
in the Name of the Lord.
Blessed be the King of Israel, -
Blessed be the King of Israel, -
Blessed, Blessed, Blessed, Blessed,
Blessed, Blessed. Blessed,
Is He that cometh in the Name of the Lord.
In the Name of the Lord,
Hosanna! Hosanna! Hosanna!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: How great is your name, O Lord our God
Through all the earth!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Your majesty is praised above the heaven;
on the lips of children and of babes
you have found praise to foil your enemy,
to silence the foe and the rebel.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: When I see the heavens, the work of your hands,
the moon and the stars which you arranged,
what is man that you should keep him in mind mortal man that you care for him?

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Yet you have made him little less than a god;
gave him power over the works of your hand,
put all things under his feet.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: All of them sheep and cattle,
yes, even the savage beasts,
birds of the air, and fish
that make their way through the waters.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Give glory to the Father Almighty,
to his Son, Jesus Christ, the Lord,
to the Spirit who dwells in our hearts,
both now and forever. Amen.

title: I REJOICE WHEN I HEARD THEM SAY (PSALM 122)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We shall go up into God's house with
shouts of joy
We shall go into house of the Lord

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I rejoiced when I heard them say:
"Let us go to God's house,"
And now our feet are standing
Within your gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Jerusalem is built as a city
strongly compact.
It is there that the tribes go up,
the tribes of the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: For Israel's law it is
There to praise the Lord's name,
There were set the thrones of judgment,
Of the house of David.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: For the peace of Jerusalem, pray:
"Peace be to your homes!
May peace reign in your walls,
In your palaces, peace!"

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: For love of my brethren and friends,
I say: "Peace upon you!"
For love of the house of the Lord,
I will ask for your good.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Praise the Father, the Son and Holy Spirit
Both now and forever,
The God who is, who was and is to come
At the end of the ages.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I was glad, I was glad, when they said unto me;
We will go into the house of the Lord,
I was glad, I was glad, when they said unto me,
We will go into the house of the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Our feet shall stand within your gates,
O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, Jerusalem
Peace be within your walls,
And prosperity, prosperity,
Be within your palaces, palaces.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: They shall proper, they shall prosper
that love you.
They shall prosper that love you. Amen, Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I want to sing, I want to shout your praise,
O Lord!
Awake and sing my soul;
Awake and play, my harp and zither!
Let the dawning day join in praise.
My heart is ready to praise you, O Lord;
To bless you, God of my salvation, alleluia!
For great and wonderful your glory, my God;
Your name is great above the heavens, alleluia
Lord, your mercy over-shadows the earth;
Your glory lights the firmament on high,
Alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice,
Before the Lord, for he comes, for he comes,
for he comes.

title: LET US ALL COME AND BOW

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Let us come to him with song,
Sing the glory of his name,
For the Lord God is Almighty,
For His powers are greater than all,
Let us come to him with song.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Let us all come and bow,
Let us all come and kneel,
And to adore our God,
For His mercies bide with us.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Let us come and sing to the Lord,
Let us make a joyful noise,
For the Lord God is Almighty,
The rock of our salvation.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: All the earth is in his hands,
Heaven and the mountain are His,
And the sea that he had made,
And the whole earth are his hand made.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let us all come and bow down,
Let us all come and kneel down,
Before Our Lord the Creator.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O God, Thy people gather,
Obedient to Thy word,
Around Thy holy alter,
To praise Thy name, O Lord,
For all Thy loving kindness,
Our grateful hearts we raise,
But pardon first the blindness
Of all our sinful ways.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thou art our loving Father,
Thou art our holiest Lord,
But we have sinned against Thee,
By thought and deed and word,
Before the court of heaven
We stand and humbly pray,
Our sins may be forgiven
Our faults be washed away.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Though sinful, we implore Thee
To turn and make us live,
That so we may adore thee
And our due offering give,
And may the prayers and voices
Of Thy glad people rise,
As Thy whole Church rejoices
In this great Sacrifice.

title: O GOD, YOU ARE MY STRENGTH (PSALM 43:3-5)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O God, you are my strength,
why have you rejected me?
Send forth your light and your truth,
They will guide me to your holy hill.
I will go to the altar of God,
and I will glorify him in song.
Why are you depressed, my soul?
Hope in God, trust in his goodness

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Open up your hearts and let the Lord come in,
Open up your hearts and let the Lord come in,
Open up your hearts and let the Lord come in,
Offer yourself to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: God is our Father so come on in,
God is our Father so come on in,
God is our Father so come on in,
Offer yourself to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Christ is our brother so take him in,
Christ is our brother so take him in,
Christ is our brother so take him in,
Offer yourself to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Sing his praises, come on in,
Sing his praises, come on in,
Sing his praises, come on in,
Offer yourself to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Praise my soul the King of Heaven:
To His feet thy tribute bring;
Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven,
Who like thee His praise shall sing?
Praise Him! Praise Him! Praise Him!
Praise Him! Praise the everlasting King!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Praise Him for His grace and favour
To our fathers in distress;
Praise Him, still the same as ever,
Slow to chide, and swift to bless:
Praise Him! Praise Him! Praise Him!
Praise Him! Glorious in His faithfulness!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Father- like He tends and spares us,
Well our feeble frame He knows;
In His hands He gently bears us,
Rescues us from all our foes:
Praise Him, Praise Him, Praise Him,
Praise Him, Widely as His mercy flows.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Angel, help us to adore Him,
Ye behold Him face to face
Sun and moon, bow down before Him
Dwellers all in time and space:
Praise Him! Praise Him! Praise Him!
Praise with us the God of grace!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
the King of creation!
O my soul, praise him for he is
our health and salvation.
All you who hear now to his presence
draw near
Join in profound adoration.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Praise to the Lord, let us offer our gifts
at the altar
Let not our sins and offences
now cause us to falter
Christ, the High Priest, bids us
all join in his feast
Victims with him on the altar.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Praise to the Lord, O let all
that is in us adore him,
All that has life and breath comes now
rejoicing before him,
Let the Amen sound from his people again
As we here worship before him.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: See the Church assembled here,
See the Church in common prayer,
See the family of God
Gathered here to-day
Closer than we understand
Mystery of Unity,
Lord, make us always one,
Lord, make us always one.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Christ the Lord, our Offering,
Christ the Lord, our Sacrifice,
Christ the Lord, our common meal,
Present here to-day;
Offering himself in us,
Food for every one of us.
Lord, make us one with him
Lord make us one with him.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Shout from the highest mountain the glory of
the Lord,
Let all men rejoice in him.
Sing from the highest mountain the praises of
the Lord.
Let all men know the wonders of our God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: For all the good things the Lord has done for
us let us join now in song.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: For all the birds in the trees and the sky and
all nature as well.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: For all the children who play in the fields: may
they always be young.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: For all the people who follow his ways, those
bring joy to men.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: And for our country that keeps us in peace:
may we always be free.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sing a new song to the Lord of the world,
Speak of his glory and power.
Go and proclaim all the wonders of God
Tell of his deeds to all men.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sing a new song to the Lord of the world,
God is alone to be praised,
God the great maker of heaven and earth
Glory and splendour are His.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sing a new song to the Lord of the world,
Praise to the name of the Lord.
Enter his temple to offer your gifts
Gifts from your labouring hands.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Sing a new song to the Lord of the world,
Ocean and earth sing His praise,
God will protect all mankind with His love,
Justice and mercy and truth.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Sing a new song to the Lord of the world,
Praise to the name of the Lord,
Father and Son and the Spirit of Light,
Glory and praise without end.

title: SING PRAISE TO THE LIVING GOD

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sing praise to the living God, Glory Halleluia.
Come adore the living God, Glory Halleluia,
Though sun and moon may pass away,
His word will ever stay
His power is forevermore, Glory Halleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Glory to the Trinity, the undivided unity.
The Father; Son and Spirit One,
From whom all life and goodness come.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: To the living God we sing, Glory, Halleluia,
Let our love and praises ring, Glory, Halleluia.
To His sons, He always
gives His mercy and His love.
Praise Him now forevermore, Glory, Halleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: To the God who cannot die, Glory, Halleluia
To the living God we cry, Glory, Halleluia
He promised to be with us
and He lives in everyone
Love Him now forevermore, Glory, Halleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sing to God all people,
serve him with joy,
Come before him singing,
He is our God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: He is our Creator;
Shepherd and Lord,
Throng his holy temple,
grateful and glad.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Praise him, serve him, bless him,
how good is God,
Kind and gentle ever,
Great is his love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Glory to the Father,
praise to the Son,
to the Holy Spirit,
Glory and praise.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Stand up and sing to the Lord,
we're gathered to worship
Lift up your heart and be not afraid.
We've come together to share his love.
Stand up and sing to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Praise the Lord from the heavens,
praise him in the heights:
Praise him all you his angels,
praise him all you his hosts:
Praise him sun and moon;
Praise him all you shining stars.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Praise him you highest heavens,
and you waters above the heavens
Let them praise the name of the Lord
for he commanded and
they were created;
He established them forever and ever;
He gave them a duty which shall not pass away.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Praise the Lord from the earth;
You sea monster and all depths; fire and hail,
snow and mist, storm winds that fulfil his word;
You mountains and all you hills,
you fruit trees and all you cedars;
You wild beast and all tame animals,
you creeping things and you winged fowl.

title: STAND UP! STAND UP! FOR JESUS

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Stand up! stand up for Jesus!
Ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner,
It must not suffer loss.
From victory unto victory
His army shall he lead,
Till every foe is vanquished,
And Christ is Lord indeed.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Stand up! stand up for Jesus!
The trumpet call obey;
Forth to the mighty conflict
In this His glorious day!
Ye that are men, now serve Him
Against unnumbered foes;
Let courage rise with danger,
And strength so strength oppose.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Stand up! stand up for Jesus!
Stand in His strength alone;
The arm of flesh will fail you ...
Ye dare not trust your own:
Put on the gospel armour,
And watching unto prayer,
Where duty calls or danger,
Be never wanting there.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Stand up! stand up for Jesus!
The strife will not be long,
This day the noise of battle,
The next the victor's song;
To him that overcometh
A crown of life shall be;
He with the King of glory
Shall reign eternally.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The earth, O Lord, rejoices,
And sings with glad acclaim,
A hymn of many voices, in honour of thy name,
We join the happy
that hails the morning light.
And bless the Lord that o'er us
kept loving watch all night.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Our ev'ry thought and action we offer to thee
From folly and distraction,
we beg thee keep us free.
Let no profane example, no censure,
no applause,
Lead us this day to trample O Lord,
upon thy laws.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: It pleased thee, Lord, to make us,
that we may serve thee here
Let not thy grace forsake us,
but keep us in thy fear.
Preserve our life, O Father,
that we may serve thee still.
But let us lose it, rather, than disobey thy will.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The works of your hands declare
your glory, O God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Lord, open my lips and my
mouth shall declare your praise.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The heavens proclaim the glory of God,
and the firmament shows forth
the work of his hands.
Day unto day takes up the story,
And night unto night makes known the message.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: No speech, no word, no voice is heard,
Yet their span goes forth through all the earth.
Their words to the utmost bounds of the world.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: There he has placed the tent for the sun;
It comes forth like a bride-groom
coming from his tent
Rejoices like a champion to run its course.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: At the end of the sky is the rising of the sun;
To the furthest end of the sky is its course;
There is nothing concealed
from its burning heat.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The joy of the Lord, our rampart and power!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Blessed are you, O merciful Lord
Praised by all men for ages to come.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O Lord on high, your glorious name,
Let all the earth proclaim without end.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Glory and power to Father and Son,
And to the Spirit, joy of our life.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The King of glory comes, the nation rejoices.
Open the gates before him, lift up your voices.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Who is the King of glory; how shall we call him?
He is Emmanuel, the promised of ages.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: In all of Galilee, in city or village,
He goes among his people curing their illness.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Sing then of David's Son,
our Saviour and brother;
In all of Galilee was never another.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: He gave his life for us, the pledge of salvation;
He took upon himself the sins of the nation.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: He conquered sin and death; He truly has risen,
And he will share with us his heavenly vision.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Seek the face of the Lord, and yearn for Him.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Open wide O you gates eternal
and let the King of glory enter.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The Lord's is the earth and its fullness,
The world and all its peoples,
It is He who set it on the sea;
On the waters He made it firm.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Who shall climb the mountain of the Lord?
Who shall stand in His holy place?
The man with clean hands and pure heart,
Who desires not worthless things.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: He shall receive blessings from the Lord
And reward from the God who saves him.
Such are the men who seek him,
Seek the face of the God of Jacob.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: This is the day that the Lord has made;
Let us be glad and rejoice in it!
Let us be glad and rejoice!
This is the day that the Lord has made.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Alleluia, alleluia!
Alleluia is our song of joy!
Sing the song we will sing forever:
Alleluia, alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: This is the day when the Lord arose;
Let us be glad and rejoice in it!
Let us be glad and rejoice!
This is the day when the Lord arose.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: This is the day when we rise with Him;
Let us be glad and rejoice in it!
Let us be glad and rejoice!
This is the day when we rise with Him!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: This is the day all the world is new;
Let us be glad and rejoice in it!
Let us be glad and rejoice!
This is the day all the world is new!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Thy kingdom come, yea, bid it come,
But, when thy kingdom first began
On earth, thy kingdom was a home,
A child, a woman, and a man.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The child was in the midst thereof,
O blessed Jesus, Holiest One
The center and the fount of love,
Mary and Joseph's little Son.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Wherever on this earth shall be
A child, a woman, and a man,
Imaging that sweet Trinity
Wherewith thy kingdom first began.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Establish there thy kingdom, yea,
And o'er that Trinity of love
Send down, as in thy appointed day,
The brooding spirit of thy Dove.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Abba, Father, send your Spirit
Glory, Jesus Christ
Abba, Father, send your Spirit
Glory, Jesus Christ

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Glory, Hallelujah! Glory Jesus Christ,
Glory, Hallelujah! Glory Jesus Christ.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: I will give you living water
Glory, Jesus Christ (x2)

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: If you seek me, you will find me...

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: If you listen, you will hear me...

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Come, my children, I will teach you...

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: I am your shepherd, I will lead you...

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Peace I leave you, peace I give you...

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: I'm your life and resurrection...

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: Glory Father, glory Spirit...

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come, praise the Lord, you
Children of the Lord,
Come raise your voice in
Joyous song
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Come, bless His name, you
Children of the Lord,
Come, sing His praise and let
The trumpet sound. Alleluia...

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Rejoice in God,
His love descends on us,
Life up voice and sound
His name afar. Alleluia..

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: How great is your name for
Those who can see
Where it's written all over the sky
Where the stars sing their praise
Spell your name many ways
Or the eagle that fly with
The clouds on high
While the mountains declare:
"I am Lord everywhere
In the wide restless sea that
Is shouting of me.''

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: How clear is your voice for
Those who will stop
To hear what you have to say
It is heard in the breeze
As it rustles the leaves
Or the raindrops that spray
On a gray stormy day
But the heart hears it best
When the mind is at rest
And the stubbornest will is
Surrendered and still.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: How lovely your face for
Those who will see
Where it's found on earth
Everywhere in the glance of a child
Or a mother so mild
In a sinner's despair or a
Saint that's in prayer
In every person that we
Meet in a crowded city street
We can see where your face
Is in the whole human race.

title: I WILL SING, I WILL SING

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I will sing, I will sing a song
Unto the Lord (x2)
Alleluia, glory to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Alleluia, alleluia, glory to the Lord (x2)
Alleluia, glory to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We will come, we will come
As one before the Lord (x2)
Alleluia, glory to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: If the Son, if the Son shall
Make you free (x2)
You shall be free indeed.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: They that sow in tears shall
Reap in joy (x2)
Alleluia, glory to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Ev'ry knee shall bow
And ev'ry tongue confess (x2)
That Jesus Christ is Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: In His name, in His name,
We have the victory (x2)
Alleluia, glory to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Fields full of flowers and
Woods full of pine
And the waters clear and blue
Every bird who is winging
Through the sky overhead
Lift our hearts to thoughts of
You God of hosts
They Lift our hearts to you.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: All of heavens and all of the earth
Will praise the Holy of holies.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Who will go up to the
Mountain of God?
Who will see his holy face?
Every man who is pure of
Heart and set in the right
They will see the holy face of the Lord
They'll see His holy face.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Lift up your heads, O you
Ancient doors
Open up ye gates and ring
For the Lord who is God of
All has come to your doors
Let us sing songs of glory to the Lord
O Lord of hosts our King.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Praise Him, praise Him
Praise Him, in the morning
Praise Him, in the noontime
Praise Him, praise Him
Praise Him when the sun
Goes down.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Love Him, love Him,
Love Him in the morning
Love Him in the noontime
Love Him, love Him
Love Him when the sun
Goes down.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Trust Him, trust Him
Trust Him in the morning
Trust Him in the noontime
Trust Him, trust Him,
Trust Him when the sun
Goes down.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Serve Him, serve Him
Serve Him in the morning
Serve Him in the noontime
Serve Him, serve Him
Serve Him when the sun
Goes down.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Jesus, Jesus,
Jesus in the morning
Jesus in the noontime
Jesus, Jesus
Jesus when the sun
Goes down.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Accept almighty Father,
These gifts of wine and bread,
Now offered at the altar
To you through Christ our Head
In humble reparation
For sins and failings dread;
To gain life everlasting
For living and for dead.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O God, by this co-mingling
Of water and of wine
May he who took our nature
Give us His life divine
Come then, and make us holy,
Receive this sacrifice;
Into your favour take us,
In Christ may we arise.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: All man's labour can produce,
You have given for our use,
Take, O Lord, this offering.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: May this lowly, bread and wine
Be the sacrifice divine
Of our Saviour Jesus Christ,
Of our Saviour Jesus Christ
On this gift of bread and wine,
Of our sacrifice a sign,
Father, look with favour now.
May this food which strength imparts
Bring refreshment to our hearts,
And a taste of joy to come.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Almighty Father take this bread
your people offer you;
Where sins divide us take instead,
tone fold, one family

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The wine we offer soon will be Christ's blood,
redemption's price:
Receive it Holy Trinity, this holy sacrifice

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O God, by angels' choir adored,
your name be praised on earth;
On all men be that peace outpoured
once promised at his birth.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: All that I am, all that I do,
All that I'll ever have I offer now to you
All that I dream, all that I pray,
All that I'll ever make, I give to you today
Take and sanctify these gifts
for your honour Lord.
Knowing that I love and serve you
is enough reward.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: All that I am, all that I do,
All that I'll ever have I offer now to you.
Take and sanctify these gifts
for your honour Lord.
Knowing that I love and serve you
is enough reward.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: All that I dream, all that I pray,
All that I'll ever make I give to you today.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sowing in the morning,
sowing seeds of kindness
Sowing in the noontide and the dewy eves,
Waiting for the harvest and the time of reaping,
We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the sheaves.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Bringing in the sheaves,
bringing in the sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the sheaves.
Bringing in the sheaves,
bringing in the sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the sheaves.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sowing in the sunshine, sowing in the shadows,
Fearing neither clouds nor winter's
chilling breeze,
By and by the harvest and the labour ended,
We shall come rejoicing,
bringing in the sheaves.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hark! 'tis the shepherd's voice I hear,
Out in the desert dark and dreary,
Calling the sheep who've gone astray,
Far from the shepherd's fold away.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring them in from the fields of sin.
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring the wandering ones to Jesus.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Who'll go and help this shepherd kind,
Help Him the wandering ones to find?
Who'll bring the lost ones to the fold
Where they'll be sheltered from the cold?

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Out in the desert hear their cry,
Out on the mountains wild and high.
Hark! 'tis the Master speaks to thee,
"Go find my sheep where-e'er they be."

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come God's children let us sing, alleluia.
Bringing gifts to praise our King, alleluia.
Drawing close in heart and mind, alleluia.
That by his aid the truth we'll find, alleluia.
We offer gifts of bread and wine, alleluia.
In Christ our Lord, the Son Divine, alleluia.
In joyful song our voices raise, alleluia.
To God above we offer praise, alleluia.
We must love him with all our heart, alleluia.
As a whole and not a part, alleluia.
Come God's children let us sing, alleluia.
Bringing gifts to praise our King, alleluia.

title: I TRUSTED EVEN WHEN I SAID (PSALM 155: 10 ... 19)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: How can I repay the Lord
for his goodness to me
I will raise the cup of salvation,
I will call on God's name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I trusted, even when I said:
"I am sorely afflicted"
And when I said in my alarm:
"No man can be trusted."

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: How can I repay the Lord
For his goodness to me?
The cup of salvation I will raise
I will call on the Lord's name.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: My vows to the Lord I will fulfil
Before all his people,
O precious in the eyes of the Lord
Is the death of his faithful.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: You servant; Lord, your servant am I;
You have loosened my bonds,
A thanksgiving sacrifice I make,
I will call on the Lord's name.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: My vows to the Lord I will fulfil
Before all his people
In the courts of the house of the Lord.
In your midst, O Jerusalem.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Praise the Father, the Son, and Holy Spirit
Both now and forever,
The God who is, who was and is to come
At the end of the ages.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O children of Christ Jesus come
To offer your presents to God,
Give us this day our daily bread,
We ask from Thee through Jesus Christ.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: God Almighty, take our offering
We give to Thee today on earth.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sins of the world, had made us fall
The wicked ones, are against us
O Father, take us from their hands,
And make us strong, to overcome them

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O Holy Spirit, make our hearts pure,
To be good followers of Christ,
Kindle in us, thy blessed light,
Spirit of God, remain with us.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Praises to God, in Heaven above.
Praises to Christ, His only Son,
We pray for everlasting life,
All these we ask, from Thee O God.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God loves a cheerful giver,
give all you've got
He loves to hear you laughing.
When you're in an awkward spot.
When the odds add up against you,
it's time to stop and sing:
"Praise God!" To Praise Him
is a joyous thing.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Peter always made a fuss, Peter was impetuous,
He knew hard times when he denied his Lord,
But hardly had he fallen
when he got right up began again,
Christ named him His successor as his reward.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Jonah was a gloomy sort,
he always had a sad report.
He ran from God, he ran and he set sail,
His journey's end was quite abrupt,
A fish came by and swallowed him up,
He spent three dark and dreary days
inside the whale.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Holy job was richly blessed,
He lost it all but stood the test,
For Job was steadfast in his misery,
"God gives to me, He takes away,
Blessed be the name of God this day,"
And he was doubly blessed for his fidelity.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God our Father everlasting,
please accept the gifts we offer;
Take our bread upon the altar,
and our wine that fill the chalice.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thankful hearts and joyful voices
we approach your holy altar.
Bearing gifts of your creation,
we return what you have given.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: To you Father; now we offer
with the host and with the chalice.
All we have and all our being
in this sacrifice most holy.

title: LET US BREAK BREAD TOGETHER ON OUR KNEES

lines: Let us break bread together on our knees;

lines: Let us praise God together on our knees;

lines: Let us break bread together at the altar,

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Let us drink wine together at the altar,

lines: Let us join hands together at the altar,

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let us love one another at the altar,

title: LORD, ACCEPT THE GIFTS WE OFFER

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Lord, accept the gifts we offer,
At this Eucharistic feast.
Bread and Wine to be transformed now
Through the action of your priest (priests)
Take us too, O Lord, transform us
May your grace in us increase.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: May our souls be pure and spotless.
As the host of wheat so fine,
May all stain of sin be crushed out,
Like the grape that forms the wine,
As we too, become partakers
In this sacrifice divine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Take our gifts, almighty Father
Living God eternal true,
Which we give through Christ our Saviour
Pleading here for us anew
Grant salvation to all present,
And our faith and love renew.

title: O GIVE THE LORD, YOU SONS OF GOD(PSALM 29)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Bring to the Lord your offerings;
adore Him in His holy place.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O give the Lord you children of God,
give the Lord glory and power;
give the Lord the glory of His name;
adore the Lord in His holy court.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The Lord's voice resounding on the waters
the Lord on the immensity of waters;
the voice of the Lord full of power,
the voice of the Lord, full of splendour.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The Lord's voice shattering the cedars,
the Lord shatters the cedars of Lebanon;
He makes Lebanon leap like a calf
and Sirion like a young wild-ox.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: The Lord's voice shaking the wilderness,
the Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh;
the Lord's voice rending the oak tree
and stripping the forest bare.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: The God of glory thunders.
In his temple they all cry: "Glory!"
The Lord sat enthroned over the flood;
the Lord sits as king forever.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Give glory to the Father Almighty,
to his Son, Jesus Christ, the Lord,
to the Spirit who dwells in our hearts,
both now and forever. Amen.

title: O SING A NEW SONG TO THE LORD (PSALM 96)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Bring an offering and enter His courts;
in his temple worship the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O sing a new song to the Lord,

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Proclaim His help day by day,

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The Lord is great and worthy of praise,

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: It was the Lord, who made the heavens,

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Give the Lord, you families of peoples,

verses.label: VERSE 1

verses.label: VERSE 2

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Take my hands, I give them to you, Lord,

so all may know the love and hope you gave.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Take my hands,
take my hands, O Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Take our bread, we ask you,
Take our hearts, we love you;
Take our lives, O Father, we are yours,
we are yours.

lines: Yours as we stand at the table you set;

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Your holy people standing washed in your blood,

the best we could;
We are yours, we are yours.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: When we walk with the Lord
in the light of his word
What a glory he sheds on our way!
While we do his good will,
he abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Trust and obey,
for there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Not a shadow can rise, not a cloud in the skies
But his smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt nor a fear, not a sigh nor a tear

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Not a burden we bear, not a sorrow we share

Not a grief nor a loss, not a crown or a cross,

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: But we never can prove the delight of his love

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We bring our gifts Lord, bread and wine,

lines: Make us one, Lord, as we prayed,

lines: Let us love, Lord, as you loved,
Let us love, Lord, as you loved,
In this banquet, Lord, we find strength,
O Lord, Kumbaya.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We gather together,
To sing the Lord's praises,
To worship the Father,
Through Jesus, His Son.
In this celebration,
All sing with jubilation,
We are His holy people,
Whose freedom He won.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: We greet our Lord present,
Within our assembly,
We hear His good news,
Announced clearly to all,
Our priest is presiding,
In Christ we are abiding,
As we invoke God's blessing,
And answer His call.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Since Christ is the vine,
And his people the branches,
In Him we give praise,
To the Father above,
He brings every nation,
To learn of His salvation,
That all may grow in knowledge,
In faith, hope and love.

title: WE OFFER THEE THE HOLY MASS

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We offer thee the Holy Mass,
Thee our creator to adore,
To thank thee for thy gracious gifts,
And praise thy Name for evermore. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Now Jesus Christ, thy flesh and blood,
Will be our sacrifice Divine,
The same in Mass as on the Cross,
Though under forms of Bread and Wine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We pray for pardon and for grace
To change the lives that we have led,
And beg thee for Thy Son's dear sake,
To bless the living and the dead.

title: WE OFFER YOU, O FATHER ABOVE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We offer you, O Father above,
These earthly gifts of bread and wine,
We give ourselves within this sing,
O Lord, accept our gift.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The Lamb of God was offered for us,
For men, He gave His Body and Blood,
We offer now this gift of love,
O Lord, accept our gift.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We know we are not worthy alone
To worship at so holy a throne,
And so with Jesus Christ we pray,
O Lord, accept our gift.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We plough the fields, and scatter
the good seed on the land,
But it is fed and water'd by God's Almighty hand;
He sends the snow in winter,
The warmth to swell the grain,
The breezes, and the sunshine,
And soft refreshing rain.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: All good gifts around us
are sent from Heav'n above.
Then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord,
for all His Love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: He only is the Maker of all things near and far;
He paints the wayside flower,
He lights the evening star;
The winds and waves obey Him,
By Him the birds are fed;
Much more to us, His Children,
He gives our daily bread.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: We thank Thee then, O then, O Father,
For all things bright and good,
The seed time and the harvest,
Our life, our health, our food;
Accept the gifts we offer
for all Thy love imparts.
And, what Thou most desirest,
Our humble, thankful hearts.

title: WHAT HAVE WE TO OFFER HIM?

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: What have we to offer him,
Who is God and Lord of all?
We have one true sacrifice,
Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: From the Father came the Son,
Crucified to save us all
This our only offering,
Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: All true men are joined in him,
Who for love has saved the world.
Joined in one as God made man,
Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Father, take this offering
take the bread and take the wine,
Take the victim now prepared,
Jesus Christ our Lord.

title: WHAT A BLESSED HOPE IS MINE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: What a blessed hope is mine,
Through the love of Jesus;
I am heir of love Divine
Through the love of Jesus.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: He will my soul defend,
He my unchanging friend;
He will keep me to the end,
All glory be to Jesus (x2)

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: For the blessed hope of Christ,
I lay strife of this world;
For our salvation dear Christ
Did come down to us from the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Amazing grace! how sweet the sound!
That saved a wretch like me;
I once was lost, but now am found;
Was blind, but now I see.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear,
The hour I first believed!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Through many dangers, toils and snares,
I have already come:
'Tis grace that brought me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Yes, when this heart and flesh shall fail,
And mortal life shall cease,
I shall possess within the veil,
A life of joy and peace.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: "Are ye able'' said the Master,
"To be crucified with Me?"
"Yea,'' the conquering Christians answered,
"To the death, we follow Thee."

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Lord, we are able, our Spirits are Thine,
Remould them, make us like Thee, divine:
Thy guiding radiance above us shall be,
A beacon to God, to love and loyalty.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O heart! thou joy of saints on high!
Thou hope of sinners here.
Attracted by those loving words,
To thee I lift my prayer.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Wash thou my wounds in that dear blood
Which forth from thee doth flow;
New grace, new hope inspire, a new
And better hear bestow.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Have you been to Jesus
for the cleansing power?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you fully trusting in His grace this hour?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Are you washed, are you washed,
In the blood, in the blood,
In the soul cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Are you walking daily by the Saviour's side?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in the Crucified?
Are you washed in the Blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: When the bridegroom cometh
will your robes be white?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready for the mansions bright
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Lay aside the garments that are stained with sin,
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb,
There's a fountain flowing for the soul unclean,
O be washed in the blood of the Lamb.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: As your family Lord, see us here, (x2)
O Lord, see us here.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: At your altar Lord, we are fed (x2)
O Lord, we are fed.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Fill our hearts Lord, with your love (x2)
O Lord, with your love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Make us friends Lord, with everyone (x2)
O Lord, with everyone.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Blessed Saviour, Thee I love,
All my other joys above,
All my hopes in thee abide,
Thou my hope, and naught beside;
Ever let my glory be,
Only, only, only, Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Once again beside the cross,
All my gain I strValue but loss;
Earthly pleasures fade away, -
Clouds they are that hide my day,
Hence, vain shadows;
Let me see Jesus crucified for me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Blessed Saviour, Thine am I,
Thine to live, and Thine to die;
Height or depth, or creature power,
Ne'er shall hide my Saviour more;
Ever shall my glory be,
Only, only, only, Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Bread you have given us, Lord,
That we may see;
Wine you have shared with us,
Lord that we may see;
Your heart and your flesh
Are forever one with us
Lord that we may see,
Lord that we may see.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: We come to sing at the table of love, (x2)
We come to sing all the songs we know,
To bring our love, to bring our love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We come to laugh at the table of love, (x2)
We come to laugh at the joy we know,
To bring our love, to bring our love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: We come to die at the table of love, (x2)
We come to die all the death we know,
To bring our love, to bring our love.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: We come to be at the table of love, (x2)
We come to be all the life we know,
To bring our love, to bring our love.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: I come with you to the table of love, (x2)
I come with you whom I long to know,
To bring our love, to bring our love.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Christ is my Rock, my Refuge, my Stronghold,
Firm as the tree's root that clutches the land.
He who has faith builds without worry,
Not like the man who builds upon sand.
I set my house on a solid foundation:
Christ is my rock,
the root of my soul's recreation.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I know a man who love to live free,
He pitched his tent by the side of the sea.
It stood near the surf and
was washed by the spray,
Till one day a wave came and washed it away.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: I know a man who loved to love high,
He built his castle near up to the sky.
Through summer and spring, it stood pretty well,
When winter wind whistled, it toppled and fell.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: I know a man, a cool one to know,
He built his house out of ice and of snow.
In chill isolation, his night work was done,
But it melted away with the warm morning sun.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: I know a man who built out of straw,
The flimsiest fellow that I ever saw.
One day a spark set it to flame,
And nothing was left to remember his name.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: For we are one in the love of Christ.
If we die with him we will rise up to life.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: If in your life love abounds,
Seek no further for God is found.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Oh when your brother cries out tears,
Share with him his hopes and fears.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Oh when great joy fills your heart,
Open up a smile will start.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Share all your goods with your fellow man,
Walk together hand in hand.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: His Body we eat, His Blood we drink,
Of the Bread of love, we eat heartily.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Glory to God on high;
Peace to all good men.
Honour and praise Him all of our days
and love Him in all mankind.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sing out praise to God
For his wond'rous deed;
Know for sure that in his love
He answers all our needs.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Praise the Lord in prayer,
Praise the Lord in song,
Praise the Lord in all we do,
And we can't go far wrong.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Seek and you will find;
Ask and He will give;
Trust the Lord with all our might,
And then we'll always live.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let us give Him thanks
For sending us His Son,
Who taught us all the way to love,
And the joy that's to be won.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: God gave one command
So the Scriptures tell,
For in the love of all mankind
We love our God as well.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: To the Father now give praise,
And praise be to the Son,
And by His Spirit's love in us
We know that God is One.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God gives His people strength,
If we believe in His way,
He's swift to repay,
All those who bear the burden of the day.
God gives His people strength.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: God gives His people hope,
If we but trust in His word,
Our prayers are always heard,
He warmly welcomes anyone who's erred.
God gives His people hope.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: God gives His people love,
If we but open wide our heart,
He's sure to do His part,
He's always the first to make a start.
God gives His people love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: God gives His people peace,
When sorrow fills us to the brim,
And courage grows dim,
He lays to rest our restlessness in Him.
God gives His people peace.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God is love, and he who abides in love
Abides in God and God in him.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The love of Christ has gather us together.
Let us rejoice in him and be glad.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: By this shall all know that we are his disciples,
If we have love for one another.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Owe no man anything except to love
one another,
For he who loves his neighbour
will fulfil the whole law.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O carry on another's burdens,
And so you will fulfil the law of Christ.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: The cup of blessing, which we bless,
Is it not fellowship in the Blood of Christ?

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: The Bread which we break,
Is it not fellowship in the Body of Christ?

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: We many are one bread, one body
For we all partake of the one Bread.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: This is the bread that came down from heaven,
He who eats this bread shall live forever.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Greet we this mystery yearly returning
Still doth its history set our hearts burning:
Gone are the former things,
All shall be new again,
Thoughts, word, actions be true again.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Christ, in the sight of his brethren reclining
On that last night of his, gave them for dining
Bread where no leaven was,
Lamb that was slain for them.
So did Moses ordain for them.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: After that offering made for a token
There stood he proffering his body broken,
Now in those hands of his,
Now within reach of them,
Whole for all as for each of them.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: His body fortified spirits that sickened;
Hearts sad and mortified his blood requickened;
Drink of this cup that is offered
He said "for you;
Drink my blood that is shed for you."

title: GUIDE ME O THOU GREAT REDEEMER

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Guide me O Thou great Redeemer,
Pilgrim through this barren land;
I am weak but thou art mighty,
Hold me with Thy powerful hand.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Bread of heaven, Bread of heaven,
Feed me now and evermore;
Feed me now and evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We gather Lord around your table
Waiting for the Bread of life.
Make us worthy, make us holy,
Take away all sin and strife.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Living bread come down from heaven,
He who eats it shall not die.
Come and eat and live forever,
You shall live with God on High.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hear thy children, gentle Jesus,
While we breathe our evening prayer,
Save us from all harm and danger,
Take us 'neath thy shelt'ring care.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Save us from the wiles of Satan,
'Mid the lone and sleepful night,
Sweetly may the guardian angles,
Keep us 'neath their watchful sight.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Gentle Jesus, look in pity
From thy great white throne above
All the night thy heart is wakeful,
In the Sacrament of love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Shades of heaven fast are falling,
Day is fading into gloom,
When the shades of death fall round us,
Lead thine exile children home

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want,
He maketh me down to lie, in pastures green,
He leadeth me, the quiet waters by.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: His yoke is easy, His burden is light,
I've found it so, I've found it so.
He leadeth me, by day and night,
Where living waters flow.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: My soul crieth out: Restore me again,
And give me the strength to take
The narrow path of righteousness,
E'en for His own Name's, sake.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Yea, though I should walk in the valley of death
E'en yet will I fear no ill,
For thou art with me and thy rod and staff
Thy comfort me still.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Holy, holy is the Lord
Holy, mighty, holy is the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Tremble, for the Lord is King
He's ruling over everything,
So bring Him glory, let us sing His glory;
Blessings let us bring unto a very mighty, King;
Hossana! Blessings let us bring
unto a very mighty King.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sisters, brothers, let us shout his praise
Praising His holy name all the day,
So bring Him glory, etc.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Justice is what our God loves
Justice that always comes from above,
So bring Him glory, etc.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Thank Him for His guiding hand,
Ask Him to bless our Father's land,
And bring him glory, etc.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Aaron called His mighty name,
He came all in a pillar of flame,
So bring him glory, etc.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Moses felt the Lord close by,
Giving a help from on high,
So bring him glory, etc.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Millions called His mighty name,
He answered ev'ry-one, just the same,
So bring Him glory, etc.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Hail Him who is King on high,
Love Him who hears our every cry,
And bring Him glory, etc.

title: HOW LOVELY IS YOUR DWELLING PLACE (PSALM 84)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: How Lovely is your dwelling place
O Lord of hosts.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: My soul is longing and yearning,
Is yearning for the courts of the Lord.
My heart and my soul ring out their joy
To God, the living God.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The sparrow herself finds a home
And the swallow a nest for her brood;
She lays her young by your altars,
God of hosts, my King and my God.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: They are happy who dwell in your house,
For ever singing your praise.
They are happy, whose strength is in you,
In whose hearts are the roads to Sion,

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: As they go through the bitter valley,
They make it a place of springs,
They walk with ever-growing strength,
They will see the God of gods in Sion,

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer,
Give ear, O God of Jacob.
Turn your eyes, O God, our shield,
Look on the face of your anointed.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: One day within your courts
Is better than a thousand elsewhere,
The threshold of the house of God
I prefer to the dwellings of the wicked.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: For the Lord God is a rampart, a shield;
He will give us His favour and glory.
The Lord will not refuse any good
To those who walk without blame.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Lord, God of hosts, happy the man
who trusts in you.

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: Give praise to the Father Almighty
To his Son, Jesus Christ, the Lord.
To the Spirit who dwells in our hearts,
Both now and forever. Amen.

title: HUMBLY LET US VOICE OUR HOMAGE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Humbly let us voice our Homage
For so great a sacrament:
Let all former rites surrender
To the Lord's New Testament;
What our senses fail to fathom
Let us grasp through faith's consent!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Glory, honour, adoration
Let us sing with one accord!
Praised be God, almighty Father;
Praised be Christ, His Son, our Lord;
Praised be God, the Holy Spirit;
Triune Godhead be adored!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Christ, our God and brother
Hear our humble plea;
By this holy banquet
Keep us joined to Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Humbly we adore Thee,
Christ Redeemer King,
Thou art Lord of Heaven,
Thou to whom we sing.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: God, the mighty, thou hast come,
Bearing gifts of grace;
Son of Adam, still thou art,
Saviour of our race.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Jesus, Lord, we thank Thee
For this wonderous bread;
In our land Thou dwellest,
By Thee we are fed.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: We who share this mystery,
In Thee are made one;
Ev'ry act we offer thee
In Thy name is done.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Thou who died to save us,
Live on as our light;
Through our eyes are blinded,
Yet our faith gives sight.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Christ, do thou be merciful;
Lamb for sinners slain;
We in grief confess our guilt;
Cleanse our souls of stain.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: If we eat of the Lord,
And we drink of the Lord,
Like the Lord we shall all be.
Then we live with His life
And we share in His love,
And his truth will make us free.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The Lord tells us His plans,
Listen to His commands:
"To the Father come through me;
Share this banquet of love,
Eat my flesh, drink my blood,
Do this in my memory."

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: "This command'', says the Lord,
"I give especially to you
Love each man as I love you.
By this sign all will know
What I have to bestow,
Through this love, man I renew."

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: From this banquet of life
Bring my love to the world,
Be a sing for all to see,
That I bring man my peace
Through the breaking of bread,
That I come to make him free.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: If we eat of the Lord
And we drink of the Lord,
Like the Lord we shall all be.
Then we will live with His life
And we share in His love,
And His truth will make us free.

title: IN CHRIST THERE IS NO EAST OR WEST

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: In Christ there is no East or West,
In Him no South or North,
But one great fellowship of love
Throughout the whole wide earth.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: In Him shall true hearts everywhere
Their high communion find;
His service is the golden cord
Close binding all mankind.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Join hands then, brothers of the faith,
Whate'er your race may be!
Who serves my Father as a son
Is surely kin to me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: In Christ now meet both East and West.
In him meet South and North,
All Christly souls are one in Him,
Throughout the whole wide earth.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: In your Body, Lord, we are one (x2)
O Lord, we are one.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: For your Church, Lord, intercede; (x2)
O Lord, intercede.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Undivided, Lord, we shall stand (x2)
O Lord, we shall stand.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: To all men, Lord, grant your peace (x2)
O Lord, grant your peace.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Give thy Spirit, Lord, to us all (x2)
O Lord, to us all.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Make our hearts, Lord, great like Thine (x2)
O Lord, great like Thine.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: In this banquet, Lord, we find strength, (x2)
O Lord, we find strength.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Draw us nearer, Lord, each to each (x2)
O Lord, each to each.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Fill our hearts, Lord, with your care (x2)
O Lord, with your care.

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: Bless us, Lord, with your love (x2)
O Lord, with your love.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jesus Thou art coming,
Holy as Thou art,
Thou, the God who made me,
To my sinful heart,
Jesus! I believe it,
On Thy only word;
Kneeling, I adore Thee
As my King and Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Who am I, my Jesus,
That thou com'st to me?
I have sinned against Thee,
Often, grievously
I am very sorry
I have caused Thee pain,
I will never, never
Wound Thy Heart again.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Put Thy kind arms around me.
Feeble as I am:
Thou art my good Shepherd
I, Thy little lamb.
Since Thou comest, Jesus,
Now to be my Guest,
I can trust Thee always,
Lord, for all the rest.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Dearest Lord, I love Thee,
With my whole, whole heart,
Not for what Thou givest,
But for what Thou art,
Come, O come, sweet Saviour,
Come to me, and stay,
For I want Thee Jesus,
More than I can say.

title: LET ALL MORTAL FLESH KEEP SILENCE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Let all mortal flesh keep silence,
And with fear and trembling stand,
Ponder nothing earthly minded,
For with blessing in his hand
Christ, our God, to earth descendeth,
Our full homage to demand.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: King of Kings, yet born of Mary,
As of old on earth he stood,
Lord of Lords in human vesture,
In the Body and the Blood
He will give to all the faithful
His own self for heav'nly food.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Rank on rank the host of heaven
Spreads its vanguard on the way,
As the Light of light descendeth
From the realms endless day
That the pow'rs of hell may vanish
As the darkness clears away.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: At his feet the six-winged seraph;
Cherubim with sleepless eye,
Veil their faces to the Presence,
As with ceaseless voice they cry:
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia, Lord most high!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My soul is thirsting for the Lord:
When shall I see Him face to face?

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I shall go to the house of God
with songs of joy.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Like the deer that yearns
For running streams,
So my soul is yearning
For you, my God.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: My soul is thirsting for God,
The God of my life;
When can I enter and see
The face of God?

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: My tears have become my bread
By night and by day,
As I hear it said all day long:
"Where is your God?"

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Why are you cast down my soul,
Why groan within me?
Hope in God, I will praise Him still
My Saviour and my God.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Praise the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit,
Both now and forever,
The God who is, who was and who will be,
World without end.

title: O KING OF MIGHT AND SPLENDOUR

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O King of might and splendour,
Creator most adored,
This sacrifice we render
To thee as sovereign Lord.
May these, our gifts, be pleasing
Unto thy majesty;
Mankind from sin releasing
Who have offended thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thy body thou hast given,
Thy blood thou hast outpoured
That sin might be forgiven,
O Jesus, living Lord.
As now with love most tender
Thy death we celebrate,
Our lives in self-surrender
To thee we consecrate.

title: MY SOUL, GIVE THANKS TO THE LORD (PSALM 102)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My soul, give thanks to the Lord,
and bless His holy name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: My soul, give thanks to the Lord,
All my being bless His holy name.
My soul give thanks to the Lord,
And never forget all his blessings.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: It is he who forgives all your guilt,
Who heals every one of your ills,
Who redeems your life from the grave,
Who crowns you with love and compassion.
Who fills your life with good things,
Renewing your youth like an eagle's.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The Lord does deeds of justice,
Give judgement for all who are oppressed.
He made known His ways to Moses
And his deeds to Israel's sons.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: The Lord is compassion and love,
Slow to anger and rich in mercy.
His wrath will come to an end,
He will not be angry for ever.
He does not treat us according to our sins
Nor repay us according to our faults.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: For as the heavens are high above the earth,
So strong is His love for those who fear him.
As far as the east is from the west,
So far does He remove our sins.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: As a father has compassion on his sons,
The Lord has pity on those who fear Him.
For He knows of what we are made,
He remembers that we are dust.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: As for man, his days are like grass,
He flowers like the flower of the field;
The wind blows and he is gone,
And his place never sees him again.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Give praise to the Father Almighty,
To His Son, Jesus Christ, the Lord,
To the Spirit who dwells in our hearts,
Both now and forever. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O bread of heaven, beneath this veil
Thou dost my very God conceal,
My Jesus, dearest treasure, hail
I love thee and adoring kneel:
Each loving soul by thee is fed
With thy own self in form of bread.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O food of life, Thou who dost give
The pledge of immortality;
I live; no 'tis not I that live.
God gives me life, God lives in me.
He feeds my soul, he guides my ways,
And every grief with joy repays.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O bond of love, that dost unite
The servant to his loving Lord;
Could I dare live, and not requite
Such love ... Then death were meet reward
I cannot live unless to prove
Some love for such unmeasured love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Beloved Lord in heaven above,
There, Jesus, thou awaitest me:
To gaze on thee with changeless love;
Yes, thus, I hope thus shall it be,
For how can He deny me heaven
Who here on earth Himself hath given?

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O food of angels, now food for men
Communion, Christ Himself, not mere a symbol
O joy wonderful
The poor, the servant
And the lowly, the humble, eat the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Jesus to His people
His flesh to eat
His blood to drink
Communion is Christ Himself,
not merely a symbol;
O Mystery Sublime

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: And the lowly; the humble eat the Lord
The poor, the servant; the humble eat the Lord.

title: O GIVE THANKS TO THE LORD (PSALM 136)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O give thanks to the Lord for He is good,
Great is His love, love without end,
Give thanks to the God of gods,
Great is His love, love without end,
Give thanks to the Lord of lords.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Who alone has wrought marvellous works,
Great is His love, love without end,
Whose wisdom it was made the skies,
Great is His love, love without end,
Who spread the earth on the seas.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: It was He who made the great lights,
Great is His love, love without end
The sun to rule in the day,
Great is His love, love without end,
The moon and stars in the night.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The first-born of the Egyptians he smote,
Great is His love, love without end,
Brought Israel out from their midst,
Great is His love, love without end,
Arm outstretched, with power in His hand.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: He divided the Red Sea in two,
Great is His love, love without end,
Made Israel pass through the midst,
Great is His love, love without end,
Flung Pharaoh and his force in the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Through the desert His people He led,
Great is His love, love without end,
Nations in their greatness He struck,
Great is His love, love without end,
King in their splendour He slew.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: He let Israel inherit their land,
Great is His love, love without end,
On His servant their land He bestowed,
Great is His love, love without end,
He remembered us in our distress.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: And he snatched us away from our foes,
Great is His love, love without end,
He gives food to all living things,
Great is His is love, love without end,
To the God of heaven give thanks.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O Godhead hid, devoutly I adore Thee,
Who truly art within the forms before me;
To Thee my heart I bow with bended knee,
As failing quite in contemplating Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sight, touch, and taste in Thee
are each deceived;
The ear alone most safely is believed;
I believe all the Son of God has spoken,
Than Truth's own word there is truer token.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: God only on the Cross lay hid from view;
But here lies hid at once the Manhood too;
And I, in both professing my belief,
Make the same prayer as the repentant thief.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Thy wounds as Thomas saw, I do not see;
Yet Thee confess my Lord and God to be;
Make me believe Thee ever more and more;
In Thee my hope, in Thee my love to store.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O Thou Memorial of our Lord's own dying!
O Bread that living art and vivifying!
Make ever Thou my soul on Thee to live;
Ever a taste of Heavenly sweetness give.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: O loving Pelican! O Jesus, Lord!
Unclean I am, but cleanse me in Thy Blood;
Of which a single drop, for sinners spilt,
Is ransom for a world's entire guilt.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Jesus! whom for the present veil'd I see,
What I so thirst for, Oh, vouchsafe to me:
That I may see Thy countenance unfolding,
And may be blest Thy glory in beholding.

title: O LORD, I AM NOT WORTHY

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O Lord, I am not worthy,
That Thou shouldst come to me.
But speak the word of comfort,
My spirit shall be healed.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I'm longing to receive Thee
The Bridegroom of my soul,
No more by sin to grieve Thee,
Or flee Thy sweet control.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O Lord, Thou art all holy,
The angels Thee adore;
How, then ought I sincerely,
My wrongs and sins deplore!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: But when Thou soon wilt enter,
My heart, my sinful heart,
Then heal me, be my shelter,
For Thou my Saviour art.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O Lord, how can I thank Thee
For such a gift as this?
A gift which truly filleth,
My soul with heav'nly bliss!

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: I praise Thee, I extol Thee,
I love Thee, O my Sire,
Till once in joy and glory,
In heav'n I'll Thee admire.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: O Sacrament most holy,
O Sacrament divine,
All praise and all thanksgiving
Be every moment Thine.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O Jesus, we adore thee,
Who in thy love divine,
Conceal thy mighty God-head,
In forms of bread and wine

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O Sacrament most holy,
O Sacrament divine!
All praise and all thanksgiving
Be ev'ry moment thine!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O Jesus, we adore thee
Our Victim and our Priest.
Whose precious blood and body
Become our sacred feast.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O Jesus, we adore thee
Our Saviour and our King,
And with the saints and angels,
A humble homage bring.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O Jesus, we adore thee,
Come, live in us, we pray,
That all our thoughts and actions,
Be thine alone today.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: O come, all who labour
In sorrow and pain;
Come, eat this bread from heaven,
Your peace and strength regain.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Once more, my soul,
