thy Saviour through thy word.
Is offered full and free.
And now, O Lord, I must,
I must decide: shall I accept of thee?

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: l will, I will,
I will, God helping me I will,
O Lord be thine,
Thy precious blood was shed to purchase me.
I will be wholly Thine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: By grace I will thy mercy now receive.
Thy love my heart hath won,
In Thee, O Christ,
I will, I will, believe and trust in thee alone.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Thou knowest Lord how very weak I am,
And now I fear to stray for strength to serve,
I look to thee alone:
Thy strength you must supply.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O Sacrament most holy,
O Sacrament divine!
All praise and all thanksgiving
Be every moment thine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Now come, all you who labour
In sorrow and in pain,
Come, eat this bread from heaven;
Thy peace and strength regain.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Lord Jesus, we adore thee,
Our Victim and our Priest,
Whose precious blood and body
Become our sacred feast.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O Sacrament most holy,
O Sacrament divine!
All praise and all thanksgiving
Be every moment thine.

title: PASS ME NOT, O GENTLE SAVIOUR

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Pass me not, O gentle Saviour;
Hear my humble cry.
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Saviour, Saviour, hear my humble cry;
And while on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Let me at thy throne of mercy
find a sweet relief;
Kneeling there in deep contrition,
help my unbelief.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Trusting only in Thy merit,
Would I seek Thy face;
Heal my wounded, broken spirit.
Save me by Thy grace.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Thou the Spring of all my comfort,
More than life to me;
Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
Whom in heaven but Thee?

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Praise to the holiest in the height
And in the depth be praised,
In all his words most wonderful,
Most sure in all his ways.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O loving wisdom of our God!
When all was sin and shame,
A second Adam to the fight
And to the rescue came.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O wisest love! that flesh and blood
Which did in Adam fail,
Should strive afresh against their foe,
Should strive and should prevail.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And that a higher gift than grace
Should flesh and blood refine,
God's presence and his very self,
And essence all divine.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O generous love! that he who smote
In man for man the foe,
The double agony in man
For man should undergo.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: And in the garden secretly,
And on the cross on high,
Should teach his brethren, and inspire
To suffer and to die.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Praise to the holiest in the height
And in the depth be praise,
In all his words most wonderful,
Most sure in all his ways.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We praise thee, O God,
For the Son of thy love,
For Jesus who died,
And is now gone above.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Alleluia, Thine the glory,
Alleluia, Amen.
Alleluia, Thine the glory,
Revive us again.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We praise Thee, O God.
For thy spirit of light,
Who has shown us our Saviour,
And scattered our night.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: All glory and praise
To the Lamb that was slain,
And hath cleansed every stain
From all his children.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Revive us again,
Fill each soul with thy love,
May each soul be rekindled
With fire from above.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Rock of ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee
Let the Water and the Blood,
From Thy riven side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure,
Save me from its guilt and power.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Not the labour of my hands
Can fulfil Thy law's demands;
Could my zeal no respite know,
Could my tears for ever flow,
All for sin could not atone:
Thou must save, and Thou alone.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Nothing in my hand I bring,
Simply to The Cross I cling!
Naked, come to Thee for dress;
Helpless, look to Thee for grace;
Foul, I to the fountain fly;
Wash me, Saviour, or I die.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: While I draw this fleeting breath,
When my eyelids close in death,
When I soar to worlds unknown,
See Thee on Thy judgment throne,
Rock of ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Blessed are the poor in spirit; (x2)
Theirs is the kingdom of God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: On that mountain,
Jesus talking with us;
On that mountain,
Jesus walking with us;
On that mountain, halleluia!
Halle, - halleluia.
Sing out all you children of the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Blessed is the man who is humble; (x2)
he'll win possession of the land.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Blessed are the ones now in mourning; (x2)
they'll have their comfort one day.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Blessed all who thirst for justice; (x2)
for they will soon be satisfied.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Blessed is the man of mercy; (x2)
he will have mercy in his turn.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Blessed are the clean of heart; (x2)
they will see the face of the lord.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Blessed are the peacemakers; (x2)
they are the children of their God.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Blessed are the sons of justice; (x2)
theirs is the kingdom of the Lord.

title: SING WITH JOY, THE SAVIOUR'S GLORY

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Men and angels, sing in
And adoring bend the knee!
Praise our God whom here before us
In the sacred host we adore.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sing with joy the Saviour's glory
Of his flesh the myst'ry sing;
Of the blood all price exceeding,
Shed by our immortal King.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: On the night of his last supper,
Seated with his chosen band,
He as food to all his brethren
Gave himself with his own hand.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: While we bow in adoration,
Let our hearts his gift revere;
Faith its aid to vision lending,
Tell that he unseen is here.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sons of God, hear his holy word!
Gather round the table of the Lord!
Eat His Body, drink His Blood,
And we'll sing a song of love:
Allelu, allelu, allelu, alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Brothers, sisters, we are one,
And our life has just begun;
In the Spirit we are young:
We can live forever.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Shout together to the Lord
Who has promised our reward.
Happiness a hundred-fold
And we'll live forever.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Jesus gave a new command
That we love our fellow man
Till we reach the promised land,
Where we'll live forever

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: If we want to live with him,
We must also die with him,
Die to selfishness and sin,
And we'll rise forever.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Make the world a unity,
Make all men one family
Till we meet the Trinity
And live with them forever.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Soul of my Saviour, sanctify my breast;
Body of Christ, be Thou my saving Guest;
Blood of my saviour, bathe me in thy tide;
Wash me with waters, flowing from thy side.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Strength and protection, may thy passion be,
O Blessed Jesus, hear and answer me.
Deep in thy wounds Lord, hide and shelter me,
So shall I never, never part from Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Guard and defend me, from the foe malign;
In death's dread moments, make me only thine;
Call me and bid me, come to Thee on high.
Where I may praise Thee,
with thy saints for aye.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sweet Sacrament divine,
Hid in your earthly home,
Lo! round thy lowly shrine,
With suppliant hearts we come,
Jesus, to you our voice we raise,
In songs of love and heartfelt praise,
Sweet Sacrament divine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sweet Sacrament of peace,
Dear home of every heart,
Where restless yearnings cease,
And sorrows all depart,
There in your ear, all trustfully
We tell our tale of misery
Sweet Sacrament of peace.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sweet Sacrament of rest,
Ark from the ocean's roar,
Within your shelter blest
Soon may we reach the shore,
Save us for still the tempest raves;
Save, lest we sink beneath the waves;
Sweet Sacrament of rest.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Sweet Sacrament divine,
Earth's light and jubilee,
In thy far depths doth shine
The Godhead's majesty,
Sweet light, so shine on us, we pray
That earthly joys may fade away,
Sweet Sacrament divine.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jesus, my Lord, to Thee I cry;
Unless Thou help me, I must die!
Oh, bring Thy free salvation nigh,
And take me as I am.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: And take me as I am, and take me as I am,
My only plea ... Christ died for me!
Oh, take me as I am.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Helpless I am, and full of guilt;
But yet for me Thy blood was spilt,
And Thou canst make me what Thou wilt,
And take me as I am.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: No preparation can I make,
My best resolves I only break,
Yet save me for Thine own name's sake,
And take me as I am.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Behold me, Saviour at thy feet;
Deal with me as Thou see-est me;
Thy work begin, Thy work complete,
And take me as I am.

title: TASTE AND SEE THAT THE LORD IS GOOD!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Taste and see that the Lord is good!
Happy is the man who trusts in Him!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sing to the Lord with me,
In let us praise his name,
Look to him and be filled with joy,
For the Lord's blessings come over his people.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Listen, my friends to me,
If you would have eternal life,
Turn from evil, seek joy, and peace,
For the Lord looks with favour on all just men.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Call on the Lord in grief,
For he is near the crushed of heart,
Many troubles oppress the just,
But the Lord saves his people from all evil.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come, let's share in the banquet of the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.
Come, let's share in the supper of the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Eat the bread and drink the wine,
Flesh and blood of the Lord divine,
Share his life, it is yours and mine,
For we are one in his design.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Come, let's share in the passion of the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.
Come, let's share the resurrection of the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Come, let's share the ascension of the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.
Come, let's share our union with the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Come, let's share in the life of the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.
Come, let's share in the love of the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Come, let's share in the banquet of the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.
Come, let's share in the supper of the Lord,
In the Blessed Sacrament.

title: THE CHURCH IS WHERE MEN ARE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The Church is where men are,
For there we find Christ,
He's hidden behind ev'ry face we behold.
By saying we're christians,
We must be on guard because
through our actions,
the truth will unfold.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Let our light shine for all to see,
Serving both friend and enemy.
Since He died for us, let us live for Him
and be His disciples eternally.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The Church is where Christ is,
And Christ dwells in men;
And folks ev'ry where are made by the Lord,
What we do to others we do to Him,
By judging our neighbour, we spell our reward.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The Church is where men are,
And we are the Church.
It is from the fruit one discovers the tree.
We are silent witnesses, living the Mass,
By taking him with us wherever we be.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: His goodness shall follow me always
to the end of my days.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: My shepherd is the Lord,
nothing indeed shall I want.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The Lord is my shepherd,
nothing shall I want.
He leads me by safe paths,
nothing shall I fear.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The Lord is my shepherd,
There is nothing I shall want.
Fresh and green are the pastures
Where he gives me repose.
Near restful waters he leads me
To revive my drooping spirit.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: He guides me along the right path,
He is true to his name.
If I should walk in the valley of darkness,
No evil would I fear.
You are there with your crook and your staff:
With these you give me comfort.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: You have prepared a banquet for me
In the sight of my foes.
My head you have anointed with oil,
My cup is overflowing.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Surely goodness and kindness shall follow me
All the days of my life.
In the Lord's own house shall I dwell,
Forever and ever.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: To the Father and Son give glory,
Give glory to the Spirit.
To God who is, who was, and who will be
Forever and ever.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The Lord's my Shepherd, I'll not want,
He makes me down to lie
In pastures green; he leadeth me
the quiet waters by.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: My soul he doth restore again
And me to walk doth make
Within the paths of righteousness
E'en for his own name sake.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Yea, though I walk through death's dark vale,
Yet will I fear no ill;
For thou art with me, and thy rod
And staff me comfort still.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: My table thou hast furnished
In the presence of my foes:
My head thou dost with oil anoint
And my cup overflows.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Goodness and mercy all my life
Shall surely follow me;
And in God's house for evermore
My dwelling place shall be.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: There's a call comes ringing o'er
the restless wave
Send the light... send the light!...
There are souls to rescue,
there are souls to save.
Send the light... send the light!...

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Send the light... the blessed gospel light!
Let it shine... from shore to shore!
Send the light... the blessed gospel light!
Let it shine for evermore!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We have heard the Macedonia call today,
Send the light... send the light!
And our grateful offerings at the cross we lay
Send the light... send the light!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: May the grace of Jesus unto all abound,
Send the light... send the light!
And a Christ-like Spirit everywhere be found
Send the light... send the light!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let us not grow weary, in the work of love
Send the light... send the light!
While we gather jewels for our crown above
Send the light... send the light!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: This is my Body, given
for your freedom.
This is my Blood which was shed
for all mankind.
Take, all, and eat, till the day of my return.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Peace to Sion, Yahweh's people;
Put your sorrows in my hands.
As I once led you to freedom,
Come now to my Father's house.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: On your journey to the kingdom,
You will find the strength you need,
At this table of remembrance,
Of my rising from the dead.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Hear, my flock, now hear me calling
For I know you all by name.
Come with me the Blessed Shepherd,
To the new Jerusalem.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: When the whole world shakes with terror,
When the sky bursts into flame,
On the clouds shall I appear,
And you shall know my hour has come.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We are your bread now,
He is our life now,
We are your bread now,
The bread of love are we,
We are your heart now,
We are your flesh now,
We are your bread now,
The bread of love are we.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: With one heart and one voice,
We sing to him we know,
In the breaking of the bread
Of our people and ourselves,
A song of love with heart
Full open and full free,
In the word of Him
Who melodies our lives.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Give us this day, O Lord,
Our daily bread,
The bread of all we do,
And all this day we are to meet,
Take us with trust.
To every table that You set,
That we never be afraid
To take and eat.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: With joy l hear
The beauty of His words
Make this your own body,
My body and all we do,
And the thrill of a heart
That is happy just to know,
That the grain of me
Is next to you.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Many the grains but one
The bread we form,
In the wonder
Of a thousand loaves,
We stand here rich and poor,
I am yours and you are mine,
And we all are Christ's the Lord,
And He, O joy is God.

title: WE LONG FOR YOU, O LORD

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We long for you, O Lord,
We long for you, O Lord,
Come, make us one with you in love,
We long for you, O Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: We cannot rest, O Lord,
We cannot rest,
O Lord, come, Lamb of God, and give us peace,
We cannot rest, O Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We hunger for you, O Lord,
We hunger for you, O Lord,
Come, feed us now with living bread,
We hunger for you, Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Your flesh is strength, O Lord,
Your flesh is strength, O Lord,
Come, holy strong One, make us strong,
Your flesh is strength, O Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: You live in us, O Lord,
You live in us, O Lord,
To be our Way and Truth and Life,
You live in us, O Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: You live in others, Lord,
You live in others, Lord,
Our love of them is love of you,
You live in others, Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: You love through us, O Lord,
You love through us, O Lord,
We are your heart and hands and voice,
You love through us, O Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O listen to a wondrous story,
Counted once among the lost,
Yes, one come down from heaven's glory,
Saving us awful cost.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Who saved us from eternal loss?
Who but God's Son upon the cross,
What did he do? He died for us,
Where is he now?
Believe it thee in heaven interceding.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: No angel could His place have taken
Highest of the high though he,
The loved One on the cross forsaken
Was one of the Godhead Three.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Will you surrender to this Saviour?
To His sceptre humbly bow,
You too shall come to know his favour,
He will save you, save you now.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: What happiness can equal mine?
I have found the object of my love,
My Saviour and my Lord Divine;
Is come to me from Heaven above.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: He makes my heart His own abode;
His flesh becomes my daily bread,
He pours on me His healing Blood,
And with His life my soul is fed.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Dear Jesus now my heart is Thine,
Oh, may it never from thee fly;
My God be thou forever mine,
And I Thine own eternally.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Whatsoever you do to the least of my brothers
That you do unto me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: When I was hungry you gave me to eat,
When I was thirsty you gave me to drink,
Now enter into the home of my Father.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: When I was homeless you opened your door,
When I was naked you gave me your coat,
Now enter into the home of my Father.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: When I was weary you helped me find rest,
When I was anxious you calmed all my fears,
Now enter into the home of my Father.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: When I was restless, you listened and cared,
When I was lonely you gave me your love,
Now enter into the home of my Father.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: When in a prison you came to my cell,
When on a sick bed, you cared for my needs,
Now enter into the home of my Father.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: In a strange country you made me at home,
Seeking employment you found me a job,
Now enter into the home of my Father.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Hurt in the battle, you bound up my wounds,
Searching for kindness you held out your hand,
Now enter into the joy of my Father.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: When I was laughed at, you stood at my side,
When I was happy, you shared in my joy,
Now enter into the home of my Father.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: "You are my people, I am your God,
You are my people, close to my heart.''

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Lord, we are thirsty, walkin' thro'
this desert land!
Lord, we are thirsty, give us to drink!
The Lord sent water from the rock
to give his people to drink.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Lord, we are hungry, walkin' thro'
this desert land!
Lord, we are hungry, give us some food!
The Lord sent manna from the sky
to give his people food.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Lord, we are weary, lost in this desert land!
Lord, we are weary, show us the way!
The Lord sent a pillar of cloud by day,
a pillar of fire by night to show his people
the way.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Still they cried out, they complained,
Where is the Saviour, the Anointed one?
The Lord sent his only Son, Christ, the Anointed.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: I give you my body to be your food;
My blood I pour out that you may never thirst,
I give you my light: I give you my love;
I give you my Spirit of love.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Blessed assurance, Jesus is Mine!
Oh, what a foretaste of glory Divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
Born of His Spirit, washed in His Blood!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour, all the day long.
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Saviour, all the day long.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Perfect submission, perfect delight!
Visions of rapture now burst at my sight!
Angels descending bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Perfect submission, all is at rest.
And in my Saviour, I'm happy and blessed;
Watching and waiting, looking above,
Filled with His goodness, lost in His love.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I need thee ev'ry hour,
Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice like
Thine can peace afford.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I need thee, O I need thee;
Ev'ry hour I need thee;
O bless me now, my Saviour,
I come to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: I need thee ev'ry hour,
Stay thou nearby;
Temptations lose their pow'r
When thou art nigh.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: I need thee every hour,
Most Holy One;
O make me thine indeed,
Thou blessed Son.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: I need thee ev'ry hour;
Teach me thy will;
Thy promises so rich
In me fulfil.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Around the altar, we sing and
Pray with one heart,
Around the altar come,
Around the altar, we celebrate
Our oneness,
Our joy is full in Christ.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Take His body, singing,
Praying altogether,
Take the body of Christ,
Take His body, singing, praying altogether,
Take and eat with joy.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Drink His blood, singing,
Praying altogether,
Drink the blood of Christ,
Drink the blood, singing, praying altogether,
Take and drink with joy.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: This meal that is given by Christ Jesus
Is real food indeed,
Whoever shares it will never die,
He has eternal life.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Help us, Jesus to fully understand
The meaning of the meal,
That we may always be
Very grateful, for your death for the world.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: All glory, praise, and honour to thee,
Redeemer king!
To whom the lips of children
Make sweet hosannas ring!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: All glory, praise, and honour
To thee, Redeemer King!
To whom sweet hosannas ring!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: True King art thou, Lord Jesus,
Of David's royal line!
Our King by right eternal
Both human and divine.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The saints and angels praise thee,
While men on earth proclaim
Thy rule of love and mercy,
In hearts that bless thy name!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: All of my life, I will praise the living God,
My heart full of joy, I will bless His holy name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
And never forget his gifts.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
He pardons all our sin.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
He saves us from all harm.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
He fills our life with good.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
He keeps us ever young.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
His mercy never ends.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
His kindness never ends.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
His promises he keeps.

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
He died to bring us life.

verses.label: VERSE 11
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
He is the Bread of life.

verses.label: VERSE 12
lines: Bless the Lord, O my soul!
In him we find all love.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Blessed be God. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Blessed be His Holy name. Amen

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Blessed be His Holy angels. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: May the power of His name be upon us. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Blessed be His angels forever and ever. Amen.
Alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O all you works of the Lord, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: To him be highest glory and praise forever.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: And you, angels of the Lord, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And you, heavens of the Lord, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: And you, sun and moon, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: And you, stars of heav'ns, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: And you, showers and rain, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: And you, all breezes and winds, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: And you, cold and heat, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: And you, night-time and day, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 11
lines: And you, mountains and hills, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 12
lines: And you, all plants of the earth, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 13
lines: And you, rivers and seas, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 14
lines: And you, creatures of the sea, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 15
lines: And you, ev'ry bird in the sky, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 16
lines: And you, wild beasts and tame, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 17
lines: And you, children of men, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 18
lines: And you, Priests of the Lord, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 19
lines: And you, servants of the Lord, bless the Lord:

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Christ be with me, Christ within me,

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Christ behide me, Christ before me,

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Christ beside me, Christ to win me,

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Christ to comfort and restore me,

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Christ beneath me, Christ above me,

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Christ in quiet, Christ in danger,

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Christ in hearts of all that love me,

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Christ in mouth of friend and stranger.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Now the day is over,
Night is drawing nigh,
Shadows of the evening
Steal across the sky.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Now the darkness gathers,
Stars begin to peep,
Birds and beasts and flowers
Soon will be asleep.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Jesus, give the weary
Calm and sweet repose;
With thy tenderest blessing
May mine eyelids close.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Grant to little children
Visions bright of these;
Guard the sailors tossing
On the deep blue sea.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Comfort every sufferer
Watching late in pain;
Those who plan some evil
From their sin restrain.

title: DAY IS DYING IN THE WEST

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Day is dying in the west,
Heaven is touching earth with rest.
Wait and worship while the night
Set her evening lamps alight
through all the sky.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of host!
Heaven and earth are full of Thee!
Heaven and earth are praising Thee,
O Lord most high!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Lord of life, beneath the dome
Of the universe, Thy home.
Gather us, who seek Thy home.
To the fold of thy embrace,
For Thou art nigh.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: While the deepening shadows fall,
Heart of love, enfolding all,
Through the glory and the grace
Of the stars that veil Thy face,
Our hearts ascend.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: When for ever from our sight,
Pass the stars, the day, the night,
Lord of angels, on our eyes
The eternal morning rise,
And shadows end.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Fight the good fight with all thy might,
Christ is thy strength, and Christ thy right,
Lay hold on life, and it shall be
Thy joy and crown eternally.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Run the straight race through God's good grace;
Lift up thine eyes, and seek His face;
Life with its way before us lies,
Christ is the path, and Christ the prize.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Cast care aside, upon thy guide,
Lean, and His mercy will provide,
Lean, and the trusting soul shall prove
Christ is its life, and Christ its love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Faint not nor fear, His arms are near,
He changeth not, and thou art dear.
Only believe, and thou shalt see
That Christ is all in all to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Glorious God, King of creation,
We praise you, we bless you,
We worship you in song;
Glorious God, in adoration,
At your feet we belong.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Lord of life, Father Almighty,
Lord of hearts, Christ the King,
Lord of love, Holy Spirit,
To whom we homage bring.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Glorious God, magnificent, holy,
We love you, adore you,
And come to you in prayer.
Glorious God, mighty eternal,
We sing your praise ev'ry where.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Glory be to the Father, glory be to the Son,
And to the Holy Spirit, now and forever. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: His mercy lives forever, glory be to God,
His wisdom dulls the wisdom of men,
now and forever. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Oh, sing his praise o'er the land,
glory be to God,
And with your voices sound his name,
now and forever. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: His love endures forever, glory be to God,
His goodness knows no limit,
now and forever. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Glory to God, glory,
O praise Him alleluia,
Glory to God, glory,
O praise the name of the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Praise Christ the Son of the living God.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Praise Christ the Word of the living God.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Praise the Light of the living God.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Go, Prophet, go! Go Prophet, go!
Go to the ends of the earth for me!
Go, Prophet, go! Go Prophet, go!
Tell them of Christ's new victory!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Go to the night-clubs, cabarets,
Go where the rhythm rocks and wails,
Tell them of him who dances in death,
Show them his beat of whips and nails.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Go to the gaudy city streets,
Crowded with empty souls again.
Tell them of Christ upon a beam,
Abandoned by God to die with men.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Go to the haunts where men are trapped,
Caught by their guilt and misery.
Tell them of Christ who lives again,
Offers the power to set them free.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Live with the people whom you know,
Love them in all their pains and fears
Tell them the healing word of Christ,
Give them your laughter and your tears.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Light of Christ, light our way,
Light our way as we go.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The Lord is my light and my salvation,
whom shall I fear?

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The Lord is the stronghold of my life,
of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: He will hide me under the cover of his wings.
He will set me high on a rock.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: And I shall dwell in the house of the Lord,
All the days of my life.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: The Lord is a lamp unto my feet.
He is a light to my path.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: His light shall break forth like the dawn.
Arise for the light has come.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Lord, dismiss us with your blessing;
Fill our hearts with joy and peace;
Let us each, your love possessing,
Triumph in redeeming grace:
O refresh us, O refresh us,
As we work to keep a-pace.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thanks, we give and adoration
For your gospel's joyful sound:
May the fruits of this Communion
In our hearts and lives abound:
Ever faithful, ever faithful
To the truth may we be found.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: So that when your love shall call us,
Saviour, from the world away,
Let no fear of death upset us,
Glad summons to obey:
May we ever, may we ever,
In your loving presence stay. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: "Must I go... and empty handed?"
Thus my dear Redeemer meet?
Not one day of service give Him,
Lay no trophy at His feet?

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: "Must I go... and empty - handed?"
Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him?
Must I empty-handed go?

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Not a death I shrink or falter,
For my Saviour saves me now,
But to meet Him empty-handed,
Thought of that now clouds my brow.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Oh, the years of singing wasted,
Could I but recall them now,
I would give them to my Saviour,
To His will, I'd gladly bow.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Up, ye saints, arouse, be earnest;
Up and work while yet 'tis day;
Ere the night of death o'ertake you,
Strive for souls while yet you may.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My God loves me,
And all the wonders I see,
Are all small signs of the love,
My God has for me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: He calls my name,
To Him no one else is the same,
I'm just not lost in the crowd,
To Him I'm me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: My God loves me,
Because of this I can see,
In spite of all my fault,
He still loves me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: My God loves me,
O what a mystery,
That God should share his love,
With a sinner like me.

title: NOW THANK WE ALL OUR GOD

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Now thank we all our God,
With heart and hands and voices,
Who wondrous things has done,
In whom his world rejoices,
Who from our mother's arms
Has blessed us on our way,
With countless gifts of love,
And still is ours today.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O may this bounteous God
Through all our life be near us,
With ever joyful hearts,
And blessed peace to cheer us,
And keep us in his grace,
And guide us when perplexed,
And free us from all ill,
In this world and the next.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: All praise and thanks to God
The Father now be given,
The Son, and him who reigns
With them in highest heaven,
The one eternal God.
Whom earth and heaven adore;
For thus it was, is now,
And shall be evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O God of love, O King of Peace,
Make wars throughout the world cease,
The plans of sinful men restrain,
Give peace O Lord, give peace again.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Remember Lord, your works of old,
The wonders that our fathers told,
Remember not sin's dark stain,
Give peace O Lord, give peace again.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Where saints and angels dwell above,
All hearts are one in holy love,
May we to that high state attain,
Give peace O Lord, give peace again.

title: O GOD, OUR HELP IN AGES PAST

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O God, our help, in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Our shelter from the stormy blast,
And our eternal home!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Beneath the shadow of thy throne,
The Saints have dwelt secure,
Sufficient is thine arm alone,
And our defence is sure.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Before the hills in order stood,
Or earth receive her frame,
From everlasting thou art God,
To endless years the same.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: A thousand ages in thy sight,
Are like an evening gone,
Short as the watch that ends the night,
Before the rising sun.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Time, like an ever-rolling stream,
Bears all its sons away
They fly forgotten as a dream
Dies at the opening day.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
And our eternal home,
Be thou our guard while troubles last.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Oh! sing praise, Oh! sing praises,
O sing praises to God most high.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Oh! sing praises, Oh! sing praises,
Sing praises, sing praises, sing praises,
To God most high.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: For His goodness and compassion
Is bestowed upon His Children.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: For His good He made us
to adore Him forever.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: For He is love, He loves us,
Let us love one another.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Praise God of Abraham
The heavenly King who with love abideth
in eternity,
My hymn14 O Lord is high,
Heaven and earth praise Thee:
I will always exalt Thy Holy Name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Praise God of Abraham, giver of all blessings
Who to seek joy at His right hand,
Hath exalted man: I loath all worldly cares,
That may draw me away from thee:
Knowledge and strength and fear
Will be my key steps to God.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O God who lives on high,
There all the angels praise:
Saying holy, holy, holy, almighty King:
Thou who sitteth on the throne,
Shall reign for ever more,
My nile of praise is great
O Lord, we worship Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: All the heavenly powers glorify and praise thee,
The Father, Son and Holy Spirit for evermore:
With the heavenly choir
I will thank my Lord and God:
For Kingdom, Power and Glory
Are thine now and ever more. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Praise the Lord in Heaven
praise Him in His holy place,
praise Him for His greatness
praise Him for His powerful deeds.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Praise the Lord with trumphets
praise Him with a thousand strings,
praise the Lord with dancing,
praise Him with joyful shout.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Praise the Lord with cymbals,
praise Him with resounding brass,
praise Him, all the living,
praise the Lord for evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Praise the glorious Father,
praise the everlasting Son,
praise the Holy Spirit,
praise and glory, Three in One.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Praise the Lord; you heav'ns adore Him;
Praise Him, angels in the height;
Sun and moon rejoice before Him,
Praise Him all you stars and light,
Praise the Lord for He has spoken;
Worlds His mighty voice obeyed;
Laws which never shall be broken
for their guidance He has made.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Praise the Lord, for He is glorious:
Never shall His promise fail,
God has made His Saints victorious;
Sin and death shall not prevail,
Praise the God of our salvation,
Hosts on high his pow'r proclaim;
Heav'n and earth and all creation,
Praise and magnify His name.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sent forth by God's blessing,
our true faith confessing,
The People of God from his dwelling take leave,
God's sacrifice ended, O now be extended;
The fruit of this Mass in all hearts who believe,
The seed of his teaching,
our inner souls reading,
Shall blossom in action for God and for man.
His grace shall incite us,
His love shall unite us,
To further his kingdom by God's holy plan.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: With Praise and thanksgiving,
to God who is living.
The tasks of our ev'ryday life we embrace.
Our faith ever sharing, in love ever caring;
We claim as our brothers all men of each race.
One Bread that has fed us,
one light that has led us,
Unite us as one in His life that we share
Then may all the living,
with praise and thanksgiving,
Give honour to Christ and
His name that we bear.

title: SWEET SAVIOUR, BLESS US ERE WE GO

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sweet Saviour bless us ere we go,
Thy word into our minds instil,
And make our lukewarm hearts to glow
With lowly love and fervent will.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Through life's long day and death's dark night,
O gentle Jesus, be our light.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The day is done, its hours have run,
And thou hast taken strValue of all,
The scanty triumphs grace has won
The broken vow, the frequent fall.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Grant us, dear Lord, from evil ways
True absolution and release,
And bless us more than in past days
With purity and inward peace.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Do more than pardon, give us joy,
Sweet fear and sober liberty,
And loving hearts without alloy,
That only long to be like thee.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Labour is sweet, for thou hast toiled,
And care is light for thou hast cared,
Let not our words with self be soiled,
Nor in unsimple ways ensnared.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: For all we love ... the poor, the sad,
The sinful ... unto these we call,
Oh let thy mercy make us glad,
Thou art our Jesus and our all.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Thank you for giving me the morning,
Thank you for ev'ry day that's new,
Thank you that I can know my worries
Can be cast on you.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thank you for all my brothers and sisters,
Thank you for all the men that live,
Thank you for even greatest enemies,
I can forgive.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Thank you I have my occupation,
Thank you for ev'ry pleasure small,
Thank you for music, light and gladness,
Thank you for them all.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Thank you for many little sorrows,
Thank you for every kindly word,
Thank you that everywhere your guidance Reaches every Land.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Thank you, I see your Word has meaning,
Thank you I know your Spirit here,
Thank you because you love all people,
Those both far and near.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Thank you, O Lord, you spoke unto us,
Thank you that for our words you care,
Thank you, O Lord, you came among us,
Bread and wine to share.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Thank you, O Lord, your love is boundless,
Thank you that I am full of you,
Thank you, you made me feel so glad,
And thankful as I do.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The Mass is ended, all go in peace,
We must diminish and Christ increase,
We take him with us where'er we go,
That through our action his life may show.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: We witness his love to everyone,
By our communion with Christ his Son,
We take the Mass to where men may be,
So Christ may shine forth for all to see.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Thanks to the Father who shows the way,
His life is with us throughout each day,
Let all our living and loving be
To praise and honour the Trinity.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We stand for God, and for his glory
The Lord Supreme and God of all;
Against his foes we raise his standard,
Around the Cross we hear his call.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Strengthen our faith Redeemer,
Guard us when danger is nigh;
To you we pledge our lives and service
Strong in a trust that ne'er shall die.
To you we pledge our lives and service,
Strong in a trust that ne'er shall die.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We stand for God, let us be loyal,
Our love proclaim with every breath,
To Christ the King and Lord of Lords,
We shall be faithful unto death.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Where two or three are gathered together
for my sake,
there am I in the midst of them.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: If you come to eat,
If you come to play,
If you come to work, or
If you come to pray.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: If you walk in love,
As I told you to,
When you can call my name,
I will be there with you.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: If your skin is dark,
If your skin is light,
You are in my heart,
And you are in my sight.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: When I look at the work of your hands,
Wonderful, wonderful is your handiwork.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Lord, our God, glorious is your name,
Blazoned through all the earth.
Even the infants your power proclaim
And babes at new birth.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: When I look at the heavens above,
The moon and the stars you have set,
What is man that you show him love
And never forget?

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Your dominion you let him share,
Of creatures of field and stall.
Fish of the sea and birds of the air,
For him you made all.

title: COME LORD JESUS, THE LIGHT IS DYING

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come Lord Jesus, the light is dying,
The night keeps crying, come Lord Jesus.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Christ, come quickly,
There's danger at the door,
Poverty a-plenty
Hearts gone wild with war,
There's hunger in the city
And famine on the plain.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Want demands a hearing,
In far too many lands,
The sick go unattended,
Death deals a heavy hand
The dreams of all are empty,
Their cup of sorrow full.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The world awaits in darkness
A mighty burst of light,
To set the lame man leaping,
To give the blind man sight,
We have the prophets' promise.
We await the Prince of peace.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: The clouds shall send a Saviour
Like softly falling rain,
Yet mighty in his power,
To free us from our chains.
His shield will be compassion,
His weapon liberty.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come thou long expected Saviour,
Born to set thy people free;
From our fears and sins release us;
Let us find our rest in thee,
Israel's strength and consolation,
Hope of all the earth thou art;
Fond desire of every nation,
Joy of every longing heart.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Born thy people to deliver,
Born a child and yet a King,
Born to reign in us forever,
Now thy gracious Kingdom bring.
By thine own eternal spirit;
Rule in all our hearts alone;
By thine all sufficient merit,
Raise us to thy glorious throne.

title: DEAR MAKER OF THE STARRY SKIES

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Dear maker of starry skies,
Light never lost by faithful eyes,
Christ, the salvation sent to all,
Be near thy servants when they call.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thy love that pitied from on high,
A guilty race foredoomed to die,
Was pain that sentence to repeal,
Those failing energies to heal.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: So, at the eventide of earth,
From that bridechamber of thy birth,
Our mortal flesh thou didst assume,
Born of a spotless Virgin's womb.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O thou, at whose august decree,
Once heard, creation bends the knee,
While heaven and earth obey thy will,
Trembling before thee, and are still.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Holiest of holy ones, from whom
Eternity receives its doom,
In this brief world of time, we pray,
Keep Satan's treacherous darts at bay.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: To God the Father, God the Son,
And God the Spirit, Three in One,
Glory and power and majesty
Through everlasting ages be.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O come we are waiting, x)
Emmanuel.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: All who walk in darkness,
Will see a great light,
On a land of deep shadow,
A bright light will shine,
There will be rejoicing,
Like men sharing spoil,
The rod of oppression,
He'll break and destroy.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: A sign God will give us,
A maid is with child,
He'll choose only goodness,
And evil destroy,
And the ruling of nations,
On His shoulders will dwell,
And He shall be called Emmanuel.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The peace He will bring us,
It never will end,
O'er the kingdom of David,
His power will extend;
His justice and mercy
Will never more cease,
Wonderful Counsellor,
Mighty God, Prince of Peace.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: A shoot springs from Jesse,
A branch from it stems,
And the spirit of Yahweh
Shall rest upon him.
With the poor and the meek,
His justice will stay,
With the breath from his lips
The wicked he'll slay.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: The wolf and the leopard,
With the lamb they shall lie,
The lion and the calf
Shall be led by a boy,
On the nest to the viper,
The young child shall trod,
For the earth shall be filled
With the knowledge of God.

title: HAIL O MARY FULL OF GRACE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hail O Mary full of grace,
Daughter true of David's race,
Thou of women first and best,
Art beyond all others blest.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Fear not, thou shalt bear a Son,
Aided by the Holy One,
Greater than the greatest,
He Son of God most high shall be.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Thus the Holy Angel said.
Blessed Mary bowed her head,
Lo! the handmaid of the Lord,
With His word may all accord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: So to hearts still undefiled,
Comes this promise of a Child,
Full of joy akin to tears,
Full of hope, yet full of tears.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Happy she who answers still,
Be it Lord at thy sweet will,
All I am to thee I owe,
All thy purpose thou dost know.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: What thou givest to be mine,
May it ne'er be aught but mine,
Be it good or be it ill,
Still be all at thy sweet will.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Holy Mary, taught by thee,
Let us vain forboding flee,
God is giving fear must cease,
In His will is perfect peace.

title: O COME, THOU WISDOM WHOSE DECREE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O come, thou wisdom whose decree,
Doth govern all things peacefully,
The way of prudence here below,
And life hereafter deign to show.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Rejoice, rejoice Emmanuel,
Is born to save thee, Israel.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O come, thou everlasting Lord,
Who once by Israel's host adored,
Thy dread commandment madest known,
In majesty of glory show.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O Rod of Jesse, mystic bough,
From Satan's cruel snares do thou,
From death's grim dungeon, we implore
And hell's abyss thine own restore.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O come, thou Key of David's store,
Unlock the heavenly gates once more;
Safe journey to thy courts bestow,
And shut the way that leads below.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: O come, thou Daystar seen on high,
With healing for our hearts draw nigh;
Do thou the mists of night dispel,
And death's foreboding darkness quell.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: O come, of Gentile hearts the King,
A world that needs thee ransoming,
And save thy servants, who confess
With humbled hearts their faithlessness.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: O come, o come, Emmanuel,
Redeem thy captive Israel,
That doth in exile homeless mourn,
Until her Saviour Christ be born.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The coming of our God
Our thought must now employ,
Then let us meet him on the road
With songs of holy joy.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The co-eternal Son
A maiden's offspring see,
A servant's form Christ put on
To set his people free.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Daughter of Sion, rise
To greet thine infant King,
Nor let thy stubborn heart despise
The pardon he doth bring.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: In glory from his throne
Again will Christ descend,
And summon all that are his own
To joys that never end.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let deeds of darkness fly
Before the approaching morn,
For unto sin 'tis ours to die
And serve the Virgin born.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Our joyful praise sing
To Christ, that set us free,
Like tribute to the Father bring,
And Holy Ghost, to thee.

title: WE LONG TO SEE THEE SO

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We long to see Thee so,
To see the newly Born
We long for Christmas morn,
The sands of time run slow.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O come, O come, O come,
Our Saviour dear to be,
O come, O come, O come,
We have no King but thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We long to see Thee so,
To see the Angels glory,
To hear their midnight story,
And with Thee Shepherds go.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: We long to see Thee so,
No other joys can please us,
We want Thee Baby Jesus,
The sands of time run slow.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: When he comes back, x)
Our lamps will be burning to welcome him
When he comes back.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The Master has promised that he will return
On a night when there's no one expecting
to see him at all,
Keep oil in the lamps so they're ready to burn
On the night of his secret,
when those who are waiting he'll call.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Look not for the Master in heaven's dark space,
By the light of our living on earth
we'll discover his face,
The face of the Master is always at hand:
In the face of the stranger, the poor,
in the face of a man.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: This stranger will search for his home
in the night;
And then how will he find it
unless all the windows are bright?
But if we are waiting ... why then he'll come in
And there'll be a homecoming
with dancing and singing within.

title: ANGELS FROM THE REALMS OF GLORY

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Angels, from the reams of glory,
Wing your flight o'er all the earth;
Ye, who sang creation's story,
Now proclaim Messiah's birth,
Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ the new-born King.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Shepherds in the field abiding,
Watching o'er your flocks by night.
God in man is now residing:
Yonder shines the Infant light,
Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ the new-born King.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sages, leave your contemplations,
Brighter visions gleam afar;
Seek the great Desire of nations;
Ye have seen his natal star,
Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ the new-born King.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Saint before the altar bending,
Watching long in hope and fear,
Suddenly the Lord descending,
In His temple shall appear,
Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ the new-born King.

title: ANGELS WE HAVE HEARD ON HIGH

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Angels we have heard on high,
Sweetly singing o'er the plains,
And the mountains in reply
Echoing their joyous strain.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Gloria in excelsis Deo
Gloria in excelsis Deo.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Shepherds, why this jubilee?
Why your joyous strains prolong?
What the gladsome tidings be,
Which inspire your joyous song.
Gloria in excelsis Deo.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Come to Bethlehem, and see
Him whose birth the angles sing;
Come, adore on bended knee,
Christ the Lord, the new-born king.
Gloria in excelsis Deo.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: See Him in a manger laid
Whom the choirs of angels praise!
Mary, Joseph, lend your aid
While our hearts in love we raise.
Gloria in excelsis Deo.

title: AS WITH GLADNESS MEN OF OLD

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: As with gladness men of old
Did the guiding star behold,
As with joy they hailed its light,
Leading onward, beaming bright;
So, most gracious Lord, may we
Ever more be Led to Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: As with joyful steps they sped
Saviour to Thy lowly bed,
There to bend the knee before Thee,
Whom heav'n and earth adore;
So many we with willing feet
Ever seek thy mercy-seat.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Holy Jesus, every day
Keep us in the narrow way;
And, when earthly things are past,
Bring our ransomed souls at last
Where they need no star to guide,
Where no clouds Thy glory hide.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: In the heavenly country bright
Need they no created light;
Thou its Light, its Joy, its Crown,
Thou its Sun which goes not down,
There for ever may we sing
Hallelujah to our King.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
The little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head.
The stars in the bright sky looked down
where He lay;
The little Lord Jesus asleep on the hay.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The cattle are lowing, the Baby awakes,
But little Lord Jesus no crying He makes.
I love Thee, Lord Jesus!
Look down from the sky;
And stay by my side until morning is nigh.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Be near me, Lord Jesus: I ask Thee to stay
Close by me forever and love me, I pray.
Bless all the dear children in Thy tender care;
And fit us to heaven, to live with Thee there.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Bethlehem! Of noblest cities,
None can once with thee compare;
Thou alone, the Lord from heaven,
Didst for us incarnate bear.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Fairer than the sun at morning,
Was the star that told His birth;
To the lands their God announcing,
Hid beneath a form of earth.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: By its lambent beauty guided,
See, the eastern kings appear;
See them bend, their gifts to offer,
Gifts of incense, gold, and myrrh.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Solemn things of mystic meaning!
Incense doth the God disclose;
Gold a royal Child proclaimeth;
Myrrh a future tomb foreshows.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Holy Jesus, in thy brightness,
To the gentile world display'd,
With the Father and the Spirit,
Endless praise to thee be paid.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Christmas comes to bless the earth,
With its wondrous heavenly birth,
Bright and high the dawning light,
Burning through the gloom of night.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: God hath come with men to dwell,
In this message hard to tell,
God the Son, the one Divine,
Sent below from heaven thine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Glory to the Father be,
Sing the angels all to thee,
Father, Son and Holy Ghost,
All in one our praises most.

title: COME, ROCK THE CRADLE FOR HIM

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come, rock the cradle for Him,
Come, in the crib adore Him,
Dull care, I pray you, bury:
And in the Lord make merry,
Sweet little Jesu, sweet little Jesu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Come rock his cradle lowly,
The throne of God all holy:
Come worship and adore Him,
And kneel we down before Him,
Sweet little Jesu, Sweet little Jesu.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Do nothing to annoy Him,
But everything to joy Him:
For sin by night or morrow,
Would cause Him pain and sorrow,
Sweet little Jesu, sweet little Jesu.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: So at your hour of dying,
This Babe in cradle lying,
For He is king supernal'
Shall grant you rest eternal,
Sweet little Jesu, sweet little Jesu.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God rest you merry, gentlemen,
Let nothing you dismay,
Remember Christ our Saviour
Was born on Christmas Day;
To save us all from Satan's pow'r
When we were gone astray.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O tidings of comfort and joy,
Comfort and joy,
O tidings of comfort and joy.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: From God, our heav'nly Father,
A blessed angel came;
And unto certain shepherds
Brought tidings of the same;
How that in Bethlehem was born
The Son of God by name.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Good Christian men, rejoice
With heart and soul and voice;
Give you heed to what we say: news, news.
Jesus Christ is born today!
Ox and ass before him bow,
And He's in the manger now.
Christ is born today: Christ is born today!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Good Christian men, rejoice
With heart and soul and voice;
Now you hear of endless bliss: joy, joy.
Jesus Christ was born for this!
He hath opened heaven's door.
And man is blessed evermore.
Christ was born for this!
Christ was born for this!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Good Christian men, rejoice
With heart and soul and voice;
Now you need not fear the grave: peace, peace.
Jesus Christ was born to save!
Calls you one and calls you all
To gain His everlasting hall.
Christ was born to save!
Christ was born to save!

title: GO TELL IT ON THE MOUNTAIN

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Go tell it on the mountain,
Over the hills and everywhere,
Go tell it on the mountain,
Our Jesus Christ is born.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: When l was a learner,
l sought both night and day;
I asked the Lord to help me,
And he showed me the way.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: While shepherds kept their watching
O'er wand'ring flocks at night;
Behold from out of heavens
There came a holy light.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Lo, when they had seen it,
They all bowed down and prayed;
They travelled on together
To where the babe was laid.

title: HARK! A HERALD VOICE IS SOUNDING

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hark! a herald voice is sounding,
"Christ is nigh!" It seems to say;
"Cast away the dreams of darkness,
O ye children of the day!"

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Startled at the solemn warning,
Let the earth-bound soul arise;
Christ her sun, all sloth dispelling,
Shines upon the morning skies.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Lo! the Lamb so long expected,
Come with pardon down from heaven;
Let us haste, with tears of sorrow,
One and all to be forgiven.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: So when next he comes with glory,
Shrouding all the earth in fear,
May he then as our defender,
On the clouds of heaven appear.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Honour, glory, virtue, merit,
To the Father and the Son,
With the co-eternal Spirit,
While eternal ages run.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hark! the herald angels sing:
"Glory to the new-born King;
Peace on earth and mercy mild:
God and sinners reconciled."
Joyful, all ye nations, rise,
Join the triumph of the skies;
With angelic hosts proclaim,
"Christ is born in Bethlehem."

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hark! the herald angels sing:
"Glory to the new-born King."

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Hail the heav'n-born Prince of Peace!
Hail the Sun of righteousness!
Light and life to all He brings,
Risen with healing in His wings.
Mild He lays His glory by,
Born that man no more may die;
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Herod, why thrills thy heart with fear?
The royal Babe thou seekest here
Envies no earthly toys, for he
A heavenly crown doth offer thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: In haste to Bethlehem that day
The wise men took their star-led way,
Their light to seek, where light doth shew,
Gifts on the Giver to bestow.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Killed at the tyrant's anxious call,
For Christ a thousand victims fall;
And mothers' hearts the piteous tale
Of murdered innocents bewail.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Lo, dipped in Jordan's cleansing stream,
The Lamb of God would whiter seem;
Yet 'twas our sins, in foul array,
He bore, and bearing washed away.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Marvels the Pharisees refute
That would his heavenly birth dispute;
The sick no more with fever burn,
And at his voice the dead return.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: New evidence of Wondrous power
Behold in Cana's marriage-dower;
Swift its own nature to resign,
The water blushes into wine.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Joy to the world! the Lord is come;
Let earth receive her King.
Let ev'ry heart prepare Him room,
And heav'n and nature sing,
And heav'n and nature sing,
And heav'n and heav'n and nature sing.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Joy to the world! the Saviour reigns;
Let men their songs employ.
While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat, repeat the sounding joy.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: He rules the world, with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove,
The glories of his righteousness,
And wonders of his love,
And wonders of his love,
And wonders, and wonders of his love.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Mary had a baby, yes, my Lord,
Mary had a baby, Lord,
Mary had a baby, yes, my Lord;
And the angels in the heavens are singing.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: What did she name him, yes, my Lord,
What did she name him Lord?
What did she name him, yes, my Lord;
And the angels in the heavens are singing.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Named him King Jesus, yes, my Lord,
Named him King Jesus, Lord,
Named him King Jesus, yes, my Lord;
And the angels in the heavens are singing.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Where was he born, yes, my Lord,
Where was he born, Lord?
Where was he born, yes, my Lord;
And the angels in the heavens are singing.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Born in a manger, yes, my Lord,
Born in a manger, Lord,
Born in a manger, yes, my Lord;
And the angels in the heavens are singing.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Long time ago in Bethlehem
So the Holy Bible says,
Mary's Boy Child Jesus Christ,
Was born on Christmas Day.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hark now hear the angels sing,
A new King born today,
And man will live for evermore,
Because of Christmas Day.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
They saw a bright new shining star,
They heard a choir sing,
The music seemed to come from afar.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Now Joseph and his wife Mary,
Came to Bethlehem that night,
She found no place to bear her child,
Not a single room was in sight.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: By and by they found a little nook,
In a stable all forlorn,
And in a manger cold and dark,
Mary's little boy was born.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O come all ye faithful,
Joyful and triumphant,
O come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem;
Come and behold Him,
Born the King of angels:

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sing, choirs of angels,
Sing in exultation,
Sing, all ye citizens of heaven above,
Glory to God
In the highest glory:

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Saviour, we greet you,
Born this happy morning,
Jesus, to you be all glory given;
Word of the Father,
Now in the flesh appearing.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O little town of Bethlehem,
How still we see thee lie!
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep
The silent stars go by;
Yet in thy dark streets shineth
The everlasting Light;
The hopes and fears of all the years,
Are met in thee tonight.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: For Christ is born of Mary;
And gathered all above,
While mortals sleep, the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.
O morning stars, together
Proclaim the holy birth,
And praises sing to God the King,
And peace to men on earth.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: How silently, how silently,
The wondrous gift is given!
So God imparts to human hearts
The blessings of His heaven.
No ear may hear His coming,
But in this world of sin;
Where meek souls will receive Him, still
The dear Christ enters in.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Once in royal David's city,
Stood a lowly cattle shed,
Where a mother laid her Baby,
In a manger for His bed.
Mary was that Mother mild,
Jesus Christ, her little Child.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: He came down to earth from heaven,
Who is God and Lord of all;
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall,
With the poor and mean and lowly,
Lived on earth, our Saviour holy.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: And our eyes at last shall see Him,
Through His own redeeming love,
For that Child so dear and gentle,
Is our Lord in Heaven above;
And He leads His children on,
To the place where He is gone.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Not in that poor lowly stable,
With the oxen standing by;
We shall see Him but in heaven,
Set at God's right hand on high.
When like star His children crowned,
All in white shall wait around.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hail thou ever-blessed morn,
Hail redemption's happy dawn,
Sing through all Jerusalem,
Christ is born in Bethlehem.
Sing through all Jerusalem,
Christ is born in Bethlehem.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: See, amid the winter's snow,
Born for us on earth below,
See, the tender Lamb appears,
Promised from eternal years.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Lo, within a manger lies,
He, who built the starry skies,
He, who throned in height sublime,
Sits amid the Cherubim.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Say, ye holy shepherds, say,
What your joyful news today,
Wherefore have ye left your sheep,
On the lonely mountain steep.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: As we watched at dead of night,
Lo, we saw a wondrous light,
Angels singing "peace on earth,
Told us of the Saviour's birth."

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Sacred Infant, all divine,
What a tender love was thine,
Thus to come from highest bliss,
Down to such a world as this

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Silent night, holy night,
All is calm, all is bright,
'Round yon Virgin Mother and Child;
Holy infant, so tender and mild,
Sleep in heavenly peace,
Sleep in heavenly peace.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Silent night, holy night,
Shepherds quake at the sight,
Glories stream from heaven afar,
Heav'nly hosts sing alleluia.
Christ, the Saviour, is born,
Christ, the Saviour, is born.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Silent night, holy night,
Son of God, love's pure light,
Radiant beams from your holy face,
With the dawn of redeeming grace,
Jesus, Lord, at your birth,
Jesus, Lord, at your birth!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sleep Holy Babe,
Upon thy Mother's breast,
Great Lord of earth and sea and sky,
How sweet it is to see Thee lie
In such a place of rest.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sleep Holy Babe,
Thine angels watch around;
All bending low with folded wings,
Before th' Incarnate King of Kings,
In reverent awe profound.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sleep Holy Babe,
While I with Mary gaze,
In joy upon that face awhile,
Upon the loving Infant smile,
Which there divinely plays.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Sleep Holy Babe,
Ah, take thy brief repose;
Too quickly will thy slumbers break
And thou to lengthened pains awake,
That death alone shall close.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O Lady blest,
Sweet Virgin hear my cry;
Forgive the wrong that I have done
To Thee, in causing thy dear Son
Upon the Cross to die.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The first Noel, the angel did say,
Was to certain poor shepherds,
In fields as they lay,
In fields where they lay keeping their sheep,
On a cold winter's night,
That was so deep.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: They look'd above and there saw a star,
That shone in the east beyond them afar,
And which to earth did give great light,
And so it continued by day and night.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And by the light of that same Star,
Three wise men came from country far;
To seek for a King was their intent,
And to follow the star wherever it went.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: This star drew near to the north-west,
At length over Bethlehem seemed to rest,
And there it stayed by night and by day,
Right over the place where Jesus lay.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Then entered in those wise men three
Most reverently with bended knee;
And offered there in His presence,
Both gold and myrrh with frankincense.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Then let us all with one accord,
Sing praises to our heavenly Lord,
That made both heaven and earth of nought,
And with His blood mankind has bought

title: UNTO US IS BORN A SON

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Unto us is born a Son,
Kind of quires supernal,
See on earth His life begun,
Of lords the Lord eternal.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Christ, from heav'n descending low,
Comes on earth a stranger;
Ox and ass their Owner know
Be cradled in a manger.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: This did Herod sore affray,
And grievously bewilder;
So he gave the word to slay,
And slew the little children.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Of his love and mercy mild
This the Christmas story:
And O that Mary's gentle Child
Might lead us up to glory!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O and A and A and O.
Cum cantibus in choro.
Let the merry organ go,
Benedicamus Domino.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We three kings of Orient are,
Bearing gifts we traverse afar;
Field and fountain, moor and mountain,
Following yonder star.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O star of wonder, star of night,
Star with royal beauty bright,
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to thy perfect light.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Born a King on Bethlehem's plain,
Gold I bring to crown Him again,
King forever, ceasing never,
Over us all to reign.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Frankincense to offer have I,
Incense owns a Deity nigh,
Prayer and praising, all men raising,
Worship Him, God most high.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Myrrh is mine, its bitter perfume,
Breathes a life of gathering gloom,
Sorrowing, sighing, bleeding, dying,
Sealed in the stone-cold tomb.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Glorious now, behold Him arise,
King and God, and sacrifice,
Alleluia, alleluia! Earth to
the heaven replies.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
All seated on the ground;
The angel of the Lord came down,
And glory shone around,
And glory shone around.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: "Fear not!" said he ... for mighty dread
Had seized their troubled mind, -
"Glad tidings of great joy I bring,
To you and all mankind,
To you and all mankind."

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: To you, in David's town, this day,
Is born of David's line
The Saviour, who is Christ the Lord;
And this shall be the sign,
And this shall be the sign.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: "The heavenly Babe you there shall find
To human view displayed,
All meanly wrapped in swathing bands,
And in a manger laid,
And in a manger laid."

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Thus spoke the seraph ... and forthwith
Appeared a shining throng
Of angels, praising God, who thus
Addressed their joyful song,
Addressed their joyful song.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: "All glory be to God on high!
And on the earth be peace!
Good-will hence forth from heaven to men
Begin and never cease,
Begin and never cease!"

title: ALL YOU WHO SEEK A COMFORT SURE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: All you who seek a comfort sure
In trouble and distress,
Whatever sorrow vex the mind,
Or guilt the soul oppress.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Jesus, who gave Himself for you
Upon the Cross to die,
Opens to you His Sacred Heart;
Oh, to that heart draw nigh.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: You hear how kindly He invites;
You hear His words so blest:
"All you that labour, come to Me,
And I will give you rest."

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: What meeker than the Saviour's heart
As on the Cross He lay?
It did His murderers forgive
And for their pardon pray.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Blessed Lamb! on Calvary's mountain
Slain to take our sins away:
Let the drops of that rich fountain,
Our tremendous ransom pay:
Sacred Saviour! Sacred Saviour!
Lowly at thy feet we pray.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Blessed Lamb! vouchsafe us pardon,
In thy love our souls confide:
By thy groans within the garden,
By the death which thou hast died,
Let thy Passion - Let thy Passion,
Evermore with us abide!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: So shall peace, sweet peace be given,
Purchase of thy precious pain;
So shall earth but lead to heaven,
Since for us the Lamb was slain:
Dear Redeemer! Dear Redeemer!
Thou canst not have died in vain.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Glory be to Jesus,
Who in bitter pains
Pour'd for me the life-blood
From His sacred veins.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Grace and life eternal,
In that blood I find,
Blest be His compassion,
Infinitely kind.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Blest through endless ages,
Be the precious stream,
Which from endless torment,
Doth the world redeem.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: There the fainting spirit,
Drinks of life her fill,
There as in a fountain,
Leaves herself at will.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Abel's blood for vengeance,
Pleaded to the skies;
But the blood of Jesus,
For our pardon cries.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Often as it is sprinkled,
On our guilty hearts,
Satan in confusion,
Terror-struck departs.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Often as earth exalting,
Wafts its praise on high,
Hell with horror tremble;
Heav'n is fill'd with joy.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Lift ye, then, your voices;
Swell the mighty flood;
Louder still and louder,
Praise the precious blood.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God of mercy and compassion,
Look with pity upon me;
Father, let me call thee Father,
Tis thy child returns to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Jesus Lord, I ask for mercy,
Let me not implore in vain;
All my sins I now detest them,
Never will I sin again.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: By my sins I have deserved,
Death and endless misery;
Hell with all its pains and torments,
And for all eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: By my sins I have abandoned,
Right and claim to heaven above;
Where the saint rejoice forever,
In a boundless sea of love.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: See our Saviour, bleeding, dying,
On the Cross of Calvary;
To that Cross my sins have nailed him,
Yet he bleeds and dies for me.

title: GOD OUR FATHER, FORGIVE OUR SINS

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God our Father, forgive our sins,
For we are very weak,
God our Father, we hope in Thee
Throughout our lives.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Remember the Lord,
The King of earth,
And of the sea,
Of heaven above. (dc)

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Lord, show us thy way,
To do according to thy will.
Lord, show us thy way,
To be ever worth love of thee.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Christ our Redeemer,
We pray to love, to save thy children;
Christ our Redeemer to be our tongue,
To our heavenly King.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let us be righteous in Communion,
As Body of Christ,
Let us be righteous to overcome,
The devil's work.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Wash away our sins with thy tongue,
And precious blood,
Wash away our sins,
To save us from the death of hell.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Mary our Mother pray for us thy children,
On earth,
Mary our Mother,
Give us on earth a Mother's care.

title: JESUS, MY LORD, BEHOLD AT LENGTH THE DAY

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jesus, my Lord, behold at length the day,
When I resolve from sin to turn away.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O pardon me, Jesus;
Thy mercy I implore;
I will never more offend thee,
No, never more.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Since my poor soul thy precious Blood has cost;
Suffer it not to be forever lost.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Kneeling in tears, behold me at thy feet:
Like Magdalene, forgiveness I entreat.

title: MAN OF SORROWS WRAPT IN GRIEF

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Man of sorrows wrapt in grief,
Bow thine ear to our relief;
Thou for us the path hast trod
Of the dreadful wrath of God;
Thou the cup of fire hast drained
Till its light alone remained.
Lamb of love! we look to thee:
Hear our mournful litany.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: By the garden, fraught with woe,
Whither thou full oft wouldst go;
By thine agony of prayer
In the desolation there;
By the dire and deep distress
Of that mystery fathomless -
Lord, our tears in mercy see:
Hearken to our litany.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: By the chalice brimming o'er
With disgrace and torment sore;
By those lips which fain would pray
That it might but pass away;
By the heart which drank it dry,
Lest a rebel race should die -
Be thy, pity, Lord, our plea:
Hear our solemn litany.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Man of sorrows! let thy grief
Purchase for us our relief;
Lord of mercy! bow thine ear,
Slow to anger, swift to hear;
By the Cross's royal road
Lead us to the throne of God.
There for aye to sing to thee
Heaven's triumphant litany.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My God, I love you - though there were
No heaven for me to win,
No hell to punish those who dare
Against your love to sin.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Upon the Cross your wide embrace
Made me, dear Lord, your own;
The nails, the spear, the long disgrace
For me should all atone.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: That night of fear, those hours of pain,
Those bitter griefs of yours,
That death itself was borne, to gain
A sinner's love 'twas mine.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And shall the fear of hell below
Or hope of heaven above
Be all the reason heart can know
This loving Lord to love.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: The love that asks not anything,
Love like your own love free,
Jesus I give, who are my king,
Who are my God, to you.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee,
Even though it be a cross
That raiseth me.
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Deep in Thy Sacred Heart
Let me abide:
Thou that hast bled for me,
Sorrowed and died.
Sweet shall my weeping be,
Grief surely leading me
Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Friends may depart from me,
Night may come down;
Clouds of adversity
Darken and frown;
