Still through my tears I'll see
Hope gently leading me
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to thee.

title: O COME AND MOURN WITH ME A WHILE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O come and mourn with me a while,
See Mary calls us to her side;
O come and let us mourn with her,
Jesus, our Love, is crucified.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Have we no tears to shed for Him;
While soldiers scoff and Jews deride?
Ah! look how patiently He hangs;
Jesus, our Love, is crucified.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: How fast His feet and hands are nailed;
His blessed tongue with thirst is tied;
His failing eyes are blind with blood;
Jesus, our Love, is crucified.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Seven times He spoke, seven words of love,
And all three hours His silence cried
For Mercy on the souls of men;
Jesus, our Love, is crucified.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O break, O break hard heart of mine;
Thy weak self-love and guilty pride
His Pilate and His Judas were;
Jesus, our Love, is crucified.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: A broken heart, a fount of tears,
Ask and they will not be denied;
A broken heart love's cradle is;
Jesus, our Love, is crucified.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: O love of God! O sin of man!
In this dread act your strength is tried
And victory remains with love;
Jesus, our Love is crucified.

title: SOLE HOPE OF ALL THE WORLD

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sole hope of all the world and Lord,
Bestower of the great reward,
Receive the prayers thy servants raise
Mixed with psalms and chants of praise.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: And though our conscience doth proclaim,
Our deep transgressions and our shame,
Cleanse us, O God, we humbly plead,
From sins of thought and word and deed.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Our sins remember thou no more,
Forgive, thy mercy can restore,
So take upon thee Lord, our care,
That pure in heart we make our prayer.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Therefore accept, O Lord, this tide
Of fact which thou hast sanctified,
That we may reach by mystic ways,
The sacraments of Paschal days.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: May he who is the threefold Lord
On us confer this high reward,
In whom so long as world abide
One only God is glorified.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: When I survey the wondrous cross,
On which the prince of Glory died,
My richest gain I strValue but loss,
And poor contempt on all my pride.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Forbid it Lord, that I should boast,
Save in the death of Christ my God;
All the vain things that charm me most,
I sacrifice them to His blood.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: See! from His head, His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down!
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet,
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Were the whole realm of nature mine,
That were an offering far too small;
Love so amazing, so Divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all.

title: AT THE LAMB'S HIGH FEAST WE SING

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: At the Lamb's high feast we sing,
Praise to our victorious King,
Who hath washed us in the tide,
Flowing from his pierced side,
Praise we him whose love divine,
Gives the guest his blood for wine,
Gives his body for the feast,
Love the victim, love the priest.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Where the Paschal blood is poured,
Death's dark angel sheathes his sword;
Israel's hosts triumphant go,
Through the wave that drowns the foe,
Christ, the Lamb whose blood was shed,
Paschal victim, Paschal bread,
With sincerity and love,
Eat we manna from above.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Mighty Victim from thy sky,
Powers of hell beneath thee lie;
Death is conquered in the fight;
Thou halt brought us life and light;
Now thy banner thou dost wave;
Vanquished Satan and the grave;
Angels join his praise to tell -
See o'erthrown the prince of hell.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Paschal triumpth, Paschal joy,
Only sin can this destroy;
From the death of sin set free,
Souls re-born, dear Lord, in thee;
Hymns of glory, songs of praise,
Father, unto thee we raise;
Risen Lord, all praise to thee,
Ever with the Spirit be.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Low in the grave He lay,
Jesus my Saviour!
Waiting the coming day,
Jesus my Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Up from the grave He arose,
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes;
He arose a victor from the dark domain,
And He lives forever with His Saints to reign
He arose! He arose!
Alleluia! Christ arose!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Vainly they watch His bed,
Jesus my Saviour!
Vainly they seal! the dead,
Jesus my Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Death cannot keep his prey,
Jesus my Saviour!
He tore the bars away,
Jesus my Lord!

title: CHRIST THE LORD IS RISEN TODAY

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Christ the Lord is risen today!
Christians, haste your vows to pay;
Offer you your praises meet
At the Paschal Victim's feet,
For the sheep, the Lamb has bled,
Sinless in the sinner's stead;
Christ, the Lord, is risen on high,
Now he lives no more to die.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Christ, the Victim undefiled,
Man to God has reconciled;
When in strange and awful strife
Met together death and life;
Christians, on this happy day
Haste with joy your vows to pay
Christ, the Lord, is risen on high!
Now he lives no more to die.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Christ, who once for sinners bled,
Now the first born from the dead,
Throned in endless might and power,
Lives and reigns forever more.
Hail, eternal hope on high!
Hail, our King of victory!
Hail, our Prince of life adored!
Help and save us, gracious Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Christ our Pasch has been slain, alleluia
Christ himself; alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Pasch of the New Law, the Spirit's holy feast;
O Pasch of Christ the Lord
who for us has come to earth.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Pasch of the New Law, O joy of all mankind;
the doors of life are wide,
giving life to us once more.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Pasch of the New Law, the banquet hall is full
of guests the Lord has called,
that all may share his feast.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Pasch of the New Law, behold
your baptized saints in robes
of purest white for the marriage of the Lamb.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Pasch of the New Law, our soul's immortal
flame shines forth in splendor bright,
never more to cease its light.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Pasch of the New Law, O Christ who live
again, the power of death you crushed,
you have given us your life.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Pasch of the New Law, we pray to you, O Lord;
stretch forth your blessed hands on the people
you have saved.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Pasch of the New Law, O Christ receive
our songs; to you be glory Lord,
with all joy and praise. Amen!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come Holy Spirit, Creator, come,
From thy bright heavenly throne,
Come, take possession of our souls,
And make them all thy own.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thou who art called the Paraclete,
Best gift of God above,
The living spring, the living fire,
Sweet unction and true love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Thou who are sev'n fold in thy grace,
Finger of God's right hand;
His promise, teaching little ones,
To speak and understand.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O guide our minds with thy blest light,
With love our hearts inflame;
And with thy strength which never decays,
Confirm our mortal frame.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Far from us drive our deadly foe;
True peace unto us bring;
And through all perils lead us safe,
Beneath thy sacred wing.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Through thee may we the Father know,
Through thee th' eternal Son,
And thee the Spirit of them both,
Thrice ... Blessed Three in One.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: All glory to the Father be,
With his co-equal Son,
The same to thee, great Paraclete,
While endless ages run.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hail this joyful day's return,
Hail the pentecostal morn,
Morn when our ascended Head,
On His Church His Spirit shed!
Like the golden tongues of flame,
On the twelve the Spirit came -
Tongues, that earth may hear their call,
Fire that love may burn in all.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hear the speech before unknown,
Trembling crowds the wonder own,
What though hardened some abide,
And the Holy work deride?
Mystic hour, when Easter's sun,
Seven times seven its course hath run;
Church of Christ from debt made free,
Hail thy day of jubilee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Lord, to thee thy people bend;
Unto us thy Spirit send;
Blessings of this sacred day,
Grant us, dearest Lord we pray,
Thou who didst our fathers guide,
With their children still abide;
Grant us pardon, grant us peace,
Till our earthly wandering cease.

title: EASTER SONG (MY LORD, HE DIED FOR A KINGDOM)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My Lord, He died for a Kingdom,
To redeem the hearts of men,
Now my people, don't you weep,
He has risen from His sleep,
He lives again, alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sing alleluia, the Lord is risen,
He is risen indeed alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: My Lord came forth like the morning
with the splendour of the sun,
Came triumphant from the womb,
from the darkness of the tomb,
the victory won, alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: My Lord united our mountains
with the everlasting hills,
Now the seasons and the sea
sing His song of victory,
rocks and rills, alleluia.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: My Lord renewed all creation
that had waited late and long,
Now we all with one accord
live and love the Risen Lord,
This is our song: alleluia.

title: HOLY SPIRIT, LORD OF LIGHT (VENI SANCTE SPIRITUS)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Holy Spirit, Lord of light,
From the clear celestial heights,
Thy pure beaming radiance give.
Come, thou Father of the poor,
Come with treasures which endure,
Come, thou light of all that live!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thou, of all consolers best,
Thou, the soul's delightful guest,
Dost refreshing peace bestow.
Thou in toll art comfort sweet,
Pleasant coolness in the heat,
Solace in the midst of woe.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Light immortal, light divine,
Visit thou these hearts of thine,
And our inmost being fill.
If thou take thy grace away,
Nothing pure in man will stay,
All his good is turned to ill.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Heal our wounds, our strength renew,
On our dryness pour thy dew,
Wash the stains of guilt away.
Bend the stubborn heart and will,
Melt the frozen, warm the chill,
Guide the steps that go astray.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Thou, on us who evermore
Thee confess and thee adore,
With thy sevenfold gifts descend;
Give them comfort when they die;
Give them life with thee on high;
Give them joys that never end.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Keep in mind that Jesus Christ
has died for us and is risen from the dead.
He is our saving Lord,
He is Joy for all ages.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: If we die with the Lord,
We shall live with the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: If we endure with the Lord,
We shall reign with the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: In him all our sorrow,
In him all our joy.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: In him hope of glory,
In him all our Love.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: In him our redemption,
In him all our grace.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: In him our Salvation,
In him all our peace.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: New praises be given to Christ newly crowned,
Who back to his heaven a new way hath found,
God's blessedness sharing before us he goes
What mansions preparing, what endless repose.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: His glory still praising on thrice holy ground,
The apostles stood gazing, his mother around,
With hearts that beat faster,
With eyes full of love,
They watched while their Master
ascended above.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: "No star can disclose him,"
The bright angels said;
Eternity knows him, your conquering head
Those high habitations he leaves not again,
Till judging nations, on earth he shall reign.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Thus spoke they, and straightway,
Where legions defend
Heaven's glittering gateway.
Their Lord they attend,
And cry, looking thither, you portals let down
For him who rides hither, in peace and renown.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Our Lord is risen from the dead,
Our Jesus is gone up on high,
The powers of hell are captive led,
Dragged to the portals of the sky.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Who is the King of glory?
The Lord that all his foes o'ercame,
The world, sin, death and hell o'erthrew,
And Jesus is the conqueror's name,
And Jesus is the conqueror's name.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: There his triumphal chariot waits
And angels chant the solemn lay,
Lift up your heads ye heavenly gates,
Ye everlasting doors give way.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Loose all your hearts in massy light,
And wide unfold the etherial scene,
He claims these mansions as his right,
Receive the King of glory in.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: See the Paraclete descending,
Burning with celestial fire,
Grace and truth on Him attending,
Man with heavenly love inspire.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Let us alleluia singing
Offer him grateful lays
He all heavenly graces bringing
Merits everlasting praise.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Timid souls no longer fearing,
Now the greatest danger scorn
Midst their sorrows persevering
Show themselves in Christ new born.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Spirit of God in the clear running water,
Blowing to greatness the trees on the hill,
Spirit of God in the finger of morning.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Fill the earth, bring it to birth and blow
where you will,
Blow, blow, blow, till I be but the breath
of the Spirit blowing in me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: I saw the scar of a year that lay dying,
Hear the lament of a lone whip-poor-will,
Spirit of God, see that cloud crying,
Fill the earth, bring it to birth and blow
where you will,
Blow, blow, blow, till I be but the breath
of the Spirit blowing in me.

title: TODAY HE'S RISEN FROM THE DEAD

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Today He's risen, death no more
shall bind him to the grave,
No more can hell or sin's foul pow'r
o'er him dominion have,
He likened to our sinful form,
Once doom'd himself to die,
That he by death might death o'ercome,
Its deadly sting destroy.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia, (dc)

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O death: where's now your moral sting,
Who triumphed over you,
Not triumphed for himself alone,
But by His mighty power,
Taught us to triumph in our turn,
Nor dread your terrors more.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: I know that my Redeemer lives,
And reigns above the skies,
He will revive my dust again,
And bid my body rise,
Then clothed in my own glorious flesh,
I shall behold His face,
That sweet hope in my bosom glows,
And cheers my ling'ring days.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Al-le-lu-ya, al-le-lu-ya, al-le-lu-ya.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Ye sons and daughters of the Lord!
The King of glory, king adored,
This day himself from death restored. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: All in the early morning grey
Went holy women on their way,
To see the tomb where Jesus lay. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Of spices pure a precious store
In their pure hands those women bore,
To anoint the sacred body o'er. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Then straightway one in white they see,
Who saith, "Ye seek the Lord; but he
Is risen, and gone to Galilee." Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: This told they Peter, told they John;
Who forthwith to the tomb are gone,
But Peter is by John outrun. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: That self-same night, while out of fear
The doors were shut, their Lord most dear,
To His apostles did appear. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: But Thomas, when of this he heard,
Was doubtful of his brethrens word;
Wherefore again there comes the Lord. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: "Thomas behold my side," saith He;
"My hands my feet, my body see,
And doubt not; but believe in me." Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: When Thomas saw that wounded side,
The truth no longer he denied;
"Thou art my Lord and God" he cried. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 11
lines: Oh, blest are they who have not seen
Their Lord, and yet believe in him!
Eternal life awaiteth them. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 12
lines: Now let us praise the Lord most high,
And strive His name to magnify
On this great day, through earth and sky. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 13
lines: Whose mercy ever runneth o'er;
Who men and angel hosts adore;
To Him be glory evermore. Alleluya!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Abide with me; fast falls the eventide:
The darkness deepens, Lord, with me abide;
When other helpers fail, and comforts flee,
Help of the helpless, O abide with me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day;
Earth's joys grow dim, its glories pass away;
Change and decay in all around I see;
O thou who changest not, abide with me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: I need thy presence every passing hour;
What but thy grace can fool the tempter's power?
Who like thyself my guide and stay can be?
Through cold and sunshine, Lord,
abide with me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: I fear no foe with thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight and tears no bitterness,
Where is death's sting? Where grave thy victory?
I triumph still, if thou abide with me.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Hold thou thy Cross before my closing eyes;
Shine through the gloom and point me
to the skies;
Heaven's morning breaks,
and earth's vain shadows flee;
In life, in death, O Lord abide with me.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia,
Praise the Lord for it's good.
Believe in God, Alleluia,
Praise the Lord for it's good.
For He is the Lord, Lord God of all;
Alleluia; praise the Lord for it's good.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Adore the Lord, alleluia.
Alleluia; praise the Lord for it's good.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: All you His creatures, alleluia.
Alleluia; praise the Lord for it's good.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Ask His forgiveness, alleluia
Alleluia; praise the Lord for it's good.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: For his mercy is without end.
Alleluia; praise the Lord for it's good.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Give thanks to God, alleluia.
Alleluia; praise the Lord for it's good.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: For all His favours to all mankind.
Alleluia; praise the Lord for it's good.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Ask for your need, alleluia
Alleluia; praise the Lord for it's good.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Ask you shall receive;
knock, He shall open;
Seek you shall find;
Praise the Lord, for it's good.
Glory be to the Father and to the Son,
and to the Spirit, now for ever more, alleluia

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Arise and shine for the Lord is coming,
Arise and shine for the Lord is coming,
Arise and shine for the Lord is coming,
Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh!
The Lord is coming.
Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh!
The Lord is coming.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: How many roads must a man walk down,
Before he's called a man,
How many seas must a white dove sail,
Before he sleeps in the sand,
How many times must the canon balls fly,
Before they're forever banned.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The answer my friend,
is blowin' in the wind,
The answer is blowin' in the wind.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: How many years can a mountain exist,
Before it's washed in the sea,
How many years can some people exist,
Before they're allowed to be free,
How many times can a man turn his head,
And pretend he just doesn't see.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: How many times must a man look up,
Before he can see the sky,
How many ears must one have,
Before he can hear people cry,
How many deaths will it take till he knows
That too many people have died.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Children in thy presence met,
Fill our hearts with holy fear,
Father, be compassionate,
God of mercy, hear.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Though we do not yet by sight,
God most high, behold thy face,
Pour into our minds the light
Of thy saving grace.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Tender Father, gracious friends,
Mighty one, tremendous Lord,
Unto all the ages' end
Be thy name adored.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Glory to the Father be,
To the uncreated Son,
Blessed Spirit, praise to thee,
God for ever One.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come down Lord, my son is ill,
Wracked with fever the livelong day
He is life to me, if you will,
Drive death away, drive death away,
Lord, do not come to my house, I'm unworthy,
Speak and the promise is sealed,
For when Your Word, O God, is spoken,
He shall be healed, he shall be healed.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Come down, Lord, my soul is ill,
Wracked with anguish the livelong day,
All my sorrowing will be still,
If You but say, if You but say,
Lord, do not come to my house, I'm unworthy,
Speak and the promise is sealed,
For when Your Word, O God, is spoken,
I shall be healed, I shall be healed.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Come down, Lord the world is ill,
Wracked with bloodshed the livelong day,
Man must struggle for peace until
You show the way, You show the way,
Lord, do not come to our house, we're unworthy,
Speak and the promise is sealed,
For when Your Word, O God, is spoken,
We shall be healed, we shall be healed.

title: DEAR ANGEL, EVER AT MY SIDE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Dear angel, ever at my side,
How loving must thou be,
To leave thy home in heaven to guard
A sinful child like me!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: For I have felt thee in my thoughts
Fighting with sin for me;
And when my heart loves God,
I know the sweetness is from thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: And when, dear spirit, I kneel down
Morning and night to prayer,
Something there is within my heart
Which tells me thou art there.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Yet! when I pray thou prayest too,
Thy prayer is all for me;
But when I sleep thou sleepest not,
But watchest patiently.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Then, for thy sake
More humble will I be;
But I am weak, and when I fall,
O weary not of me.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Fade, fade, each earthly joy, Jesus is mine!
Break every tender tie, Jesus is mine!
Dark is the wilderness,
Earth has no resting place,
Jesus alone can bless, Jesus is mine!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Tempt not my soul away, Jesus is mine!
Here would I ever stay, Jesus is mine!
Perishing things of clay,
Born but for one brief day,
Pass from my heart away! Jesu is mine!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Farewell, ye dreams of night, Jesus is mine!
Lost in this dawning Light, Jesus is mine!
All that my soul has tried,
Left but a dismal void,
Jesus has satisfied, Jesus is mine!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Farewell, mortality, Jesus is mine!
Welcome, eternity! Jesus is mine,
Welcome, O loved and blest,
Welcome, sweet scenes of rest,
Welcome, my saviour bless, Jesus is mine!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Faith of our fathers, living still,
In spite of dungeon, fire and sword:
Oh, how our hearts beat high with joy,
Whene'er we hear that glorious word!
Faith of our fathers! holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Our fathers, chained in prisons dark,
Were still in heart and conscience free.
How sweet would be their children's fate
If they, like them, could die for thee!
Faith of our fathers! holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Faith of our fathers, we will strive,
To win all Nations unto thee;
And through the truth that comes from God,
Mankind shall then be truly free.
Faith of our fathers! holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Faith of our fathers, we will love
Both friend and foe in all our strife,
And preach thee too, as love knows how,
By kindly words and virtuous life.
Faith of our fathers! holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Firmly I believe and truly,
God is Three, and God is One,
And I next acknowledge duly,
Manhood taken by the Son.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: And I trust and hope most fully,
In that manhood crucified;
And each thought and deed unruly,
Do to death, as he has died.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Simply to his grace and wholly,
Light and life and strength belong,
And I love supremely, solely,
Him the holy, him the strong.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And I hold in veneration,
For the love of him alone Holy Church,
as his creation,
And her teachings, as his own.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Adoration aye be given,
With and through the angelic host,
To the God of earth and heaven,
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: From every stormy wind that blows,
From every swelling tide of woes,
There is a calm, a sure retreat;
'Tis found beneath the mercy-seat.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: There is a place where Jesus sheds
The oil of gladness on our heads -
A place than all beside more sweet;
It is the blood-stained mercy-seat.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: There is a scene where spirits blend,
Where friends hold fellowship with friends,
Though sundered far, by faith they meet,
Around one common mercy-seat.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: There, there, on eagle wings we soar,
And sense and sin molest no more;
And heaven comes down our souls to greet,
And glory crowns the mercy-seat.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Oh, let my hand be cold, and still,
My tongue be silent, cold and still,
This pounding heart forget to beat,
If I forget the mercy-seat.

title: FULL IN THE PANTING HEART OF ROME

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Full in the panting heart of Rome,
Beneath the apostle's crowning dome,
From pilgrims' lips that kiss the ground,
Breathes in all tongues one only sound:
"God bless our Pope, the great, the good."

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The golden roof, the marble walls,
The Vatican's majestic halls,
The note redouble, till it fills
With echoes sweet the seven hills:

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Then surging through each hallowed gate,
Where martyrs glory, in peace, await;
It sweeps beyond the solemn plain,
Peals over Alps, across the main:

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: From torrid south to frozen north,
That wave harmonious stretches forth,
Yet strikes no chord more true to Rome's
Than rings within our hearts and homes:

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God be with you till we meet again!
By His counsels guide, uphold you;
With His sheep securely fold you;
God be with you till we meet again!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Till we meet!... Till meet!
Till we meet at Jesus feet...
Till we meet!... Till we meet!...
God be with you till we meet again!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: God be with you till we meet again!
'Neath His wings securely hide you;
Daily manna still provide you;
God be with you till we meet again!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: God be with you till we meet again!
When life's perils thick confound you;
Put his loving arms around you;
God be with you till we meet again!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: God be with you till we meet again!
Keep love's banner floating o'er you;
Smite death's threatening wave before you;
God be with you till we meet again

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God's spirit is in my heart;
He has called me and set me apart,
This is what I have to do,
What I have to do.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: He sent me to give the good news to the poor,
Tell prisoners that they are prisoners no more,
Tell blind people that they can see,
And set the downtrodden free,
And go tell ev'ryone the news that
the Kingdom of God has come,
And go tell ev'ryone
the news that God's Kingdom has come.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Just as the Father sent me,
So I'm sending you out to be,
My witness throughout the world,
The whole of the world.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Don't carry a load in your pack,
You don't need two shirts to your back,
A workman can earn his own keep,
Can earn his own keep.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Don't worry what you have to say,
Don't worry because on that day,
God's Spirit will speak in your heart,
Will speak in your heart.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Grant to us, O Lord, a heart renewed;
Recreate in us your own Spirit, Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Behold the days are coming,
says the Lord our God,
when I will make a new covenant
with the house of Israel.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Deep within their being I will implant my law;
I will write it in their hearts.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: I will be their God and they shall my people.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: And for all their faults I will grant forgiveness;
never more will I remember their sins.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hail, holy Joseph, hail!
Husband of Mary, hail!
Chaste as the lily flower
In Eden's peaceful vale.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hail, holy Joseph, hail!
Father of Christ esteemed,
Father be thou to those
Thy foster Son redeemed.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Hail, holy Joseph, hail!
Prince of the house of God,
May his blest grace be
By thy pure hands bestowed.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Hail, holy Joseph, hail!
Comrade of angels, hail!
Cheer thou the hearts that faint,
And guide the steps that fail.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Hail, holy Joseph, hail!
God's Choice wert thou alone;
To thee the word made flesh
Was subject as a Son.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Mother of Jesus, bless,
And bless, ye Saints on high,
All meek and simple souls
That to Saint Joseph cry.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hark! hark, my soul!
Angelic songs are swelling,
O'er earth's green fields,
And ocean's wave beat shore;
How sweet the truth those blessed
strains are telling,
Of that new life when sin shall be no more.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Angels of Jesus, angels of light,
Singing to welcome the pilgrims of the night.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Onward we go, for still we hear them singing,
Come, weary soul, for Jesus bids you come,
And through the dark, its echoes sweetly ringing,
The music of the gospel leads us home.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Far, faraway, like bell at evening pealing,
The voice of Jesus sounds o'er land and sea,
And laden souls, by thousands meekly stealing
King shepherd, turn their weary steps to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Rest comes at length,
Though life be long and dreary,
The day must dawn and darksome
night be past;
All journeys end in welcome to the weary,
And Heaven, the heart's true home,
Will come at last.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Angels sing on, your faithful watches keeping,
Sing us sweet fragments of the songs above,
While we toil on, .
And sooth ourselves with weeping.
Till life's long night shall break in endless love.

title: HARK! HOW THE BANKS OF JORDAN RING

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hark! how the banks of Jordan ring,
The Baptist's utterance echoing!
Your drowsy slumbers cast away,
Those warning accents to obey.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The conscious earth, and sea and sky,
Welcomes his advent from on high,
Who did their groaning fabric build,
With pangs of expectation thrilled.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: And shall our hearts unpurified,
The coming of their King abide?
Strew all his path, and lodging meet,
Prepare a royal guest to greet.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Jesus, our souls with health endow;
Our strength and consolation you;
Creatures of earth without your aid,
We languish like the flowers that fade.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Stretch out your hand, we faint no more;
The fallen to their feet restore,
Show but your face, and wintry earth,
Shall bring her dallying flowers to birth.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Jesus, our ransomer divine,
Let praise beyond all praise be yours;
Praise to the Father endlessly,
And his life-giving Spirit be.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: He sendeth the sunshine and rain...
He scattereth dew on the flowers...
He maketh the desert to bloom...
His blessings descend as the showers...

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Boun...tiful, mer...ciful, won...derful love.
Boun...tiful, mer...ciful, won...derful love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: He causeth the rivers to flow...
The fields now with verdure are clad...
He tempers the wind to his lamp...
The earth with His sunshine is glad...

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: For bounty so royal and free...
For mercies unending and new...
Oh, help us to praise thee, dear Lord...
And serve thee in all that we do...

title: HOLY GOD WE PRAISE YOUR NAME

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Holy God, we praise your name;
Lord of all, we bow before you!
All on earth your sceptre claim,
All in heaven above adore you,
Infinite your vast domain,
Everlasting is your reign!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hark! the loud celestial hymn,
Angel choirs above are raising!
Cherubim and Seraphim,
In unceasing praising,
Fill the heavens with sweet accord,
Holy, holy, holy, Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Holy Father, Holy Son!
Holy Spirit, Three we name you,
While in essence only One,
Undivided God we 'claim you,
And adoring bend the knee,
While we own the mystery.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Spare your people, Lord, we pray,
By a thousand snares surrounded;
Keep us without sin today;
Never let us be confounded,
Lo, I put my trust in you ...
Never Lord, abandon me.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: How excellent, how excellent,
Is thy loving kindness,
Is thy loving kindness O God,
How excellent, how excellent,
Is your loving kindness,
Is your loving kindness O God.
Therefore the children of men,
Therefore the children of men,
Therefore the children of men put their trust,
Therefore the children of men, put their trust,
Therefore put their trust under the shadow
of your wings.
They shall be abundantly satisfied,
With the fullness of your name,
And you shall make them drink
Of the river of your pleasure, .
And you shalt make them drink
Of the river of your pleasure,
Of your loving kindness,
They shall be abundantly satisfied,
They shall be abundantly satisfied,
They shall be abundantly satisfied,
With the fullness of your house,
And you shall make them drink,
Of the river of your pleasure.
Show your loving kindness unto them,
Your pleasures and you shall make them drink
Of the river of your pleasure,
That know you, unto them that know you
and your righteousness,
Your pleasures, and you shall make them drink
Of the river of your pleasure to the upright

title: IT IS WELL WITH MY SOUL

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: When peace, like a river,
attendeth my way,
When sorrows, like sea billows roll,
Whatever my lot, thou hast taught me to say:
"It is well, it is well, with my soul."

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: It is well, it is well,
With my soul, with my soul,
It is well, it is well, with my soul.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Though Satan should buffet,
Though trials should come,
Let this blest assurance control;
That Christ has regarded my helpless estate,
and hath shed his own blood for my soul.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: My sin, O the bliss, of this glorious tho't,
My sin, not in part but the whole
Is nailed to the cross, and I bear it no more.
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, O my soul!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: And Lord haste the day
when my faith shall be sight,
The clouds be rolled back as a scroll;
The trump shall resound
and the Lord shall descend,
Even so, it is well with my soul.

title: I WILL SEEK AND FIND THEE NOW

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I will seek and find thee now,
Blessed Saviour teach me how,
I will lay my heart to rest,
On thy gentle loving breast.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thou art pure and undefiled, undefiled.
I am a weak and helpless child,
Yet thy word hath said, to me:
Little ones may come to Thee,
Yet the little ones may come to Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Keep step with the Master, whatever betide;
While dark be the pathway,
Keep close to your Guide;
While foes are alluring, and danger is near;
When walking with Jesus,
You've nothing to fear.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Keeping step... go bravely forward,
And your cour...age still renew; ...
Daily walk... with Christ your Saviour,
He will lead you all the journey through.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Keep step with the Master, wherever you go;
Through darkness and shadow,
The way He will show,
The light of His presence your path will illumine,
And make all the desert a garden of bloom.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Keep step with the Master, nor halt by the way;
Whate'er He commands you, oh, haste to obey!
Arise at His bidding, press on in His might,
While walking with Jesus,
you're sure to be right.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Lead, kindly light, amid the encircling gloom,
Lead Thou me on;
The night is dark, and I am far from home,
Lead Thou me on.
Keep Thou my feet; I do not ask to see
The distant scene; one step enough for me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I was not ever thus, nor prayed that Thou
Shouldst lead me on;
I loved to choose and see my path; but now
Lead Thou me on.
I loved the garish day, and spite of fears,
Pride ruled my will: remember not past years.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: So long Thy power hath blest me, sure it still
Will lead me on
O'er moor and fen, o'er crag and torrent, till
The night is gone,
And with the morn those Angel faces smile,
Which I have loved long since, and lost awhile.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Let Thy Priest O Lord be clothed with justice,
And let thy Saints rejoice,
Saints rejoice for David's sake.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Turn not away the face of
Thy Anointed.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O sing to the Lord, sing to the Lord,
Make known his deeds,
Make known his deeds among the people.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: God has set his people, people free,
For his chosen ones joys,
And shouts of rejoicing.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: (After please repeat two times)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Like olive branches around the table of the Lord, so God's children in the Church.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: May the God of Israel join you in one;
In joy and in sorrow, the Lord is your way.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Blessed those who fear the Lord,
who seek his path,
For they shall find favour in his sight.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Blessed be the toil of hands,
they shall bear fruit,
In joy and in gladness shall you work.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: With good fortune in your home
shall you be blessed;
Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Blessed shall your children
be around your board;
Like strong olive branches shall they stand.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Blest indeed, shall be the man
who serves the Lord;
For he shall prevail throughout his life.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: May the Lord who dwells on high
give joy to you;
And may he protect you all your life.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: May the sight of many sons
delight your heart;
May God grant his peace to Israel.

title: LORD, FOR TOMORROW AND ITS NEEDS

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Lord, for tomorrow and its needs,
I do not pray;
Keep me, my God, from stain of sin,
Just for today.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Let me be slow to do my will,
Prompt to obey;
Help me to mortify my flesh,
Just for today.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Let me both diligently work,
And duly pray;
Let me be kind in word and deed,
Just for today.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Let me no wrong or idle word,
Unthinking say;
Set thou a seal upon my lips,
Just for today.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let me in season, Lord, be grave,
In season, gay;
Let me be faithful to thy grace,
Just for today.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Lord we pray for golden peace,
Peace all over the land,
May all men dwell in liberty,
Walking hand in hand.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Banish fear and ignorance,
Hunger, thirst and pain,
Banish hate and poverty,
Let no man live in vain,
Let no man live in vain.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Keep all men forever one,
One in love and grace,
Wipe away all war and strife,
Give freedom to each race.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Let your justice reign supreme,
And righteousness be done,
Let goodness rule the hearts of men,
And evil be o'ercome.

title: SEE THE LOVING SHEPHERD OF THY SHEEP

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: See the loving shepherd of thy sheep,
The holy, the holy bread of angels,
From heaven, from heaven He came to earth,
Let us adore Him.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: He is our true Father all the time,
The shepherd, the shepherd of thy sheep,
In Him, in Him we place our soul's redemption,
God full of kindness.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We are victims of our wretchedness,
O Lord, O Lord, our Saviour,
Have mercy, have mercy on us all,
'Cause of thy love for us.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Stay with us, stay with us in this world,
O, o, o, good Jesus;
So that we, so that we may be with you,
In heaven for ever.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Magnify, glorify, extol and exalt the Lord;
Magnify, glorify His holy name for evermore;
Magnify, glorify, extol and exalt the Lord;
Exalt and glorify, magnify His name
for ever more.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Our feet shall stand within thy gates,
O Jerusalem!
Rejoice in thy salvation,
Our feet shall stand... within thy gates,
O Jerusalem! shall stand within thy gates,
O Jerusalem! Magnify, glorify,
extol and exalt the Lord:
Magnify, glorify His holy Name forever more;
Magnify glorify, extol and exalt the Lord;
Exalt and glorify,
Magnify His Name for ever more.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Extol Him that rideth upon the heav'ns,
By His Name, JAH!
Extol Him that rideth upon the heav'ns,
By His name, JAH!
And rejoice... and rejoice... and rejoice....
Before Him.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: We will rejoice in your salvation,
And in your Name will we lift up our banners
And come again with singing unto Zion,
And obtain gladness and joy,
We will rejoice in your salvation,
And in Your Name will we set up our banners,
And come again with singing unto Zion,
And obtain gladness and joy Halleluia! Amen,
Alleluia! Amen! Alleluia! Alleluia! Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Man is lonely by birth,
Man is only a pilgrim on earth,
Born to be king, time is but a temporary thing,
Only on loan while on earth.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Like the wind in the tree,
Man has been rather reckless and free,
Thrown far and wide, he longs to settle down
Beside the stream flowing through eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Like the grass on the lawn,
He will pass by the way and be gone,
A lesson to learn, we walk
but once there's no return,
Time is always moving on.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Man is longing for one,
For a song and a place in the sun,
For home up above where ev'ry day
is lived in love.
For rest when the journey is done.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Most ancient of all mysteries,
Before thy throne we lie;
Have mercy now, most merciful,
Most holy Trinity.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: When heaven and earth were yet unmade,
When time was yet unknown,
Thou, in thy bliss and majesty,
Didst live and love alone.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Thou were not born; there was no fount
From which thy Being flowed,
There is no end which thou can'tst reach:
But thou art simply God.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: How wonderful creation is,
The work that thou didst bless;
And oh, what then must thou be like,
Eternal loveliness!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Most ancient of all mysteries,
Still at thy throne we lie;
Have mercy now, most merciful,
Most holy Trinity.

title: MY GOD, ACCEPT MY HEART THIS DAY

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My God, accept my heart this day,
And make it wholly thine,
That I from thee no more may stray,
No more from thee decline.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Before the Cross of him who died,
Behold I prostrate fall,
Let every sin be crucified,
And Christ be all in all.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Anoint me with thy heavenly grace,
And seal me for thine own,
That I may see thy glorious face,
And worship at thy throne.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Let every thought and work and word
To thee be ever given,
Then life shall be thy service, Lord,
And death the gate of heaven.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: All glory to the Father be,
All glory to the Son,
All glory to Holy Ghost, to thee,
While endless ages run.

title: MY GOD, HOW WONDERFUL THOU ART

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My God, how wonderful thou art,
Thy majesty how bright,
How beautiful thy mercy-seat
In depths of burning light.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: How dread are thine eternal years,
O everlasting Lord,
By prostrate spirits day and night
Incessantly adored.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: How beautiful, how beautiful
The sight of thee must be,
Thine endless wisdom, boundless power,
And awful purity.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Oh, how I fear thee, living God,
With deepest, tenderest fears,
And worship thee with trembling hope,
And penitential tears.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Yet I may love thee too, O Lord,
Almighty as thou art,
For thou hast stooped to ask of me
The love of my poor heart.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: No earthly father loves like thee,
No mother e'er so mild,
Bears and forbears as thou hast done,
With me, thy sinful child.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Father of Jesus, love's reward,
What rapture will it be,
Prostrate before thy throne to lie,
And gaze and gaze on thee.

title: MY SOUL IS LONGING FOR YOUR PEACE (PSALM 131)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My soul is longing for your peace,
near to you, my God!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Lord, you know that my heart is not proud,
And my eyes are not lifted from the earth.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Lofty thoughts have never filled my mind,
Far beyond my sight all ambitious deeds.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: In your peace I have maintained my soul,
I have kept my heart in your quiet peace.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: As a child rests on his mother's knee,
So I place my soul in your loving care.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Israel, put all your hope in God,
Place your trust in him, now and evermore.

title: MY TIMES ARE IN THY HAND

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My times are in Thy Hands,
My God, I wish them there;
My life, my friends, my soul I leave
Entirely to Thy care.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: My times are in Thy Hand,
Whatever they may be,
Pleasing or painful, dark or bright,
As best may seem to Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: My times are in Thy Hand,
Why should I doubt or fear?
A Father's Hand will never cause
His child a needless tear.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: My times are in Thy Hand,
Jesus the crucified;
The Hand my cruel sins hand pierced
Is now my guard and guide.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: My times are in Thy Hand,
I'll always trust in Thee,
And after death at Thy right Hand
I shall for ever be.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Now that the day-star glimmers bright,
We suppliantly pray
That he, the uncreated light,
May guide us on our way.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: No sinful word, nor deed of wrong,
Nor thoughts that idly rove;
But simple truth be on our tongue,
And in our hearts be love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: And, while the hours in order flow,
O Christ, securely fence
Our gates, beleaguer'd by the foe: -
The gate of every sense.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And grant that to thine honour, Lord,
Our daily toil may tend;
That we begin it at thy word,
And in thy blessing end.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: And, lest the flesh in its excess
Should loard it o'er the soul,
Let taming abstinence repress
The rebel, and control.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: To God the Father glory be,
And to his only Son,
And to the Spirit, One in Three,
While endless ages run.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O blessed Saint Joseph
how great was thy worth,
The one chosen shadow of God up on earth
Called Father of Jesus ah, then wilt thou be,
Sweet Spouse of Our Lady! a father to me?

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: For thou to the pilgrim art father and guide,
And Jesus and Mary felt safe by thy side;
Ah blessed Saint Joseph how safe should I be,
Sweet Spouse of Our Lady!
If thou were with me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: When the treasures of God were unsheltered
on earth,
Safe keeping was found for them
both in thy worth;
O Father of Jesus, be father to me,
Sweet Spouse of Our Lady, and I will love thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O happy day, that fixed my choice,
On Thee, my Saviour and my God!
Well may this glowing heart rejoice,
And tell its raptures all abroad.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Happy day! Happy day!
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray
And live rejoicing every day:
Happy day! Happy day!
When Jesus washed my sins away!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: 'Tis done, the great transaction's done
I am my Lord's and He is mine;
He drew me, and I followed on,
Charmed to confess the voice Divine.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Now rest, my long-divided heart,
Fixed on this blissful centre, rest;
Nor ever from thy Lord depart,
With Him of every good possessed.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: High Heaven, that heard the solemn vow
That vow renewed shall daily hear,
Till in life's latest hour I bow,
And bless in death a bond so dear.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O King of Kings,
In splendour of glory throned on high,
Do thou, our strong defender,
Thy Church still magnify.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Our Holy Father shielding,
His enemies o 'erthrow;
May Peter's faith unyielding,
The path to Heaven foreshew.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: That citadel surrounding,
The angry foreman raves;
Upon that rock resounding,
Dash high the sullen waves.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Yet Lord, in siege laborious,
Though hell itself should rage,
Thou wondrous, thou victorious,
Art known from age to age.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: We trust thy conquering power,
Now and in time to be,
The gift of peace to shower,
On those who trust in Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Still, still with light supernal,
Those battlement shall gleam,
And Peter's rock, eternal,
Confront the restless stream.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O perfect Love, all human thoughts
transcending,
Lowly we kneel in prayer before thy throne,
That theirs may be the love
Which knows no ending,
Whom thou for evermore dost join in one.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O Perfect Life, be thou their full assurance,
Of tender charity and steadfast faith,
Of patient hope, and quiet, brave endurance,
With child-like trust that fears
nor pain nor death.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Grant them joy which brightens
earthly sorrow,
Grant them the peace which claims
all earthly strife;
And to life's day the glorious unknown morrow
That dawns upon eternal love and life.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Our Father, who art in Heaven,
Hallowed be Thy Name;
Thy Kingdom come, Thy will be done,
Hallowed be Thy Name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: As in heaven, so on the earth,
Hallowed be Thy Name;
Give us this day our daily bread,
Hallowed be Thy Name.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: And forgive us, all our trespasses,
Hallowed be Thy Name;
As we forgive those who trespass against us,
Hallowed be Thy Name.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And lead us not into temptation,
Hallowed be Thy Name;
But deliver us from all that is evil,
Hallowed be Thy Name.

title: PRAISE WE OUR GOD WITH JOY

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Praise we our God with joy,
And gladness never ending,
Angels and saints with us,
Their grateful voices blending,
He is our Father dear,
O'er filled with parent's love,
Mercies unsought, unknown,
He showers from above.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: He is our Shepherd true,
With watchful care unsleeping
On us, his erring sheep,
An eye of pity keeping;
He with a mighty arm
The bonds of sin doth break,
And to our burden'd hearts
In words of peace doth speak.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Grace in copious stream
From that pure fount are welling,
Where, in our heart of hearts,
Our God hath set his dwelling,
His word our lantern is,
His peace our comfort still,
His sweetness all our rest,
Our law, our life, his will.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Precious promise God hath given
To the weary passer-by,
On the way from earth to heaven,
"I will guide thee with Mine eye."

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I will guide thee, I will guide thee,
I will guide thee with Mine eye;
On the way from earth to heaven,
I will guide thee with Mine eye.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: When temptations almost win thee,
And thy trusted watchers fly,
Let this promise ring within thee:
"I will guide thee with Mine eye."

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: When thy secret hopes have perished
In the grave of years gone by,
Let this promise still be cherished.
"I will guide thee with Mine eye."

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: When the shades of life are falling,
And the hour has come to die,
Hear thy trusty Leader calling:
"I will guide thee with Mine eye."

title: O GOD OF EARTH AND ALTAR

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Bow down and hear our cry,
Our earthly rulers falter,
Our people drift and die,
The walls of gold entomb us,
The swords of scorn divide,
Take not thy thunder from us,
But take away our pride.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: From all that terror teaches,
From lies of tongue and pen,
From all the easy speeches
That comfort cruel men,
From sale and profanation
Of honour and the sword,
From sleep and from damnation,
Deliver us, good Lord!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Tie in a living tether
The prince and priest and thrall,
Bind all our lives together,
Smite us and save us all;
In ire and exultation
Aflame with faith, and free,
Lift up a living nation,
A single sword to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Great and glorious Saint Patrick,
Pray for your dear children,
Great and glorious Saint Patrick,
Hearken to the prayers of your children.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hibernia's champion saint all hail,
With fadeless glory crowned,
The offspring of your ardent zeal,
This day your praise shall sound.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Borne on the wings of charity,
To Erin's coast you flew,
Bade Satan from her valleys flee,
And his dark shrines o'erthrew.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Wandering thro' error's gloomy night,
Our sires did lose their way,
You cheer'd their hearts with heav'nly light,
With truth's consoling ray.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Oh what a harvest crown your toil,
The earth long curs'd was blessed,
Each lovely virtue graced its soil,
The sinners' heart find rest.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Ten unclean and nowhere to go,
Ten men cleansed as clean as snow,
One returned to give God thanks,
But nine went away.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Ten men, lepers in a Hebrew town,
Ten crying: "Lord, won't you please come down"
No hope near, till one fine day,
Jesus of Nazareth passed that way.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: "Lord make me clean," was their single cry,
"See, how the whole world passed us by,
No man's home will take us in!"
Then Christ bent to touch their skin.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Like a tree when its buds come true,
Or a patch of spring that is fresh and new,
Christ restored the ones defiled,
Gave them the flesh of a new-born child.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: God gives gifts to us ev'ry day,
Favours His people in ev'ry way;
Hope restored and pain relieved, -
Do you ever give thanks for a gift received?

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Oh! I often sit and ponder,
When the sun is sinking low,
Where shall yonder future find me
Does but God in Heaven know,
Shall I be among the living,
Shall I mingle with the free,
Wheresoe'er my path be leading,
Saviour, keep my heart with Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Oh! the future lies before me,
And I know not where I'll be,
But where'er my path be leading,
Saviour, keep my heart with Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Shall I be at work with Jesus,
Whilst He Leads me by the hand,
And to those around be saying,
Come and join this happy band.
Come for all things now are ready
Come His faithful followers be,
Oh where'er my path be leading,
Saviour, keep my heart with Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: But perhaps my work for Jesus,
Soon in future may be done,
All my earthly trials ended,
And my crown in heaven won,
Then forever with the ransom'd
Thro' eternity l'd be
Chanting nile to Him who bought me,
With His Blood shed on the Tree.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I cannot come,
I cannot come to the banquet,
Don 't trouble me now,
I have married a wife,
I have bought me a cow,
I have fields and commitments,
That cost a pretty sum,
Pray, hold me excused, I cannot come.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: A certain man held a feast,
On his fine estate in town,
He laid a festive table and
wore a wedding gown,
He sent in invitations,
To his neighbours far and wide,
But when the meal was ready,
Each of them replied:
I cannot come.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The master rose up in anger,
Called his servants by name, said:
"Go into the town, fetch the blind and the lame,
Fetch the peasant and the pauper,
For this I have willed,
My banquet must be crowded,
And my table must be filled."
I cannot come.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: When all the poor had assembled,
There was still, room to spare,
So the master demanded:
"Go search everywhere,
To the highways and byways
And force them to come in,
My table must be filled
Before the banquet can begin."
I cannot come.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Now God has written a lesson
For the rest of mankind,
If we're slow in responding,
He may leave us behind,
He's preparing a banquet
For that great and glorious day,
Be certain not to say:
I cannot come.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We are one in Jesus, all of us are one,
We are one in Jesus, all of us are one,
We are one, we are one,
Jesus Christ and we are one,
We are one, we are one,
Jesus Christ and we are one.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: We are one in Jesus, all of us are one,
All of us are brothers, brothers of our Lord,
All of us are brothers, brothers of our Lord,
We are one, we are one,
brothers of our risen Lord,
We are one, we are on in the Spirit of our Lord,
All of us are brothers, brothers of our Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Jesus is our brother, Christ and we are one,
Jesus is our brother, Christ and we are one,
One in mind, one in heart,
in the Spirit from on high,
With our brother in our midst,
never more to die,
Jesus is our brother, Christ and we are one,
We are one in Jesus, all of us are one,
All of us are one, all of us are one.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I believe God lay sleeping in the tomb,
Waiting until the day should break.
I believe my Father has care of me
And someday, He'll say, "My child awake."

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I believe man was born to die,
Over and over again,
I believe that man was meant to cry,
"Amen, my Lord, Amen."

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: I believe that the stars are mine,
Love lifts the stars from the night,
I believe there's always sun to shine,
Though sometimes it's hidden from sight.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: I believe man must go alone,
Tossed like a wave on the sea,
Yet I believe that man must have a home,
God holds a mansion for me.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: I believe man was born for joy,
Some men must find it in pain,
Some rivers run through caves
beneath the ground,
Sometimes there's sun in the rain.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: There was a man in Jerico called Zaccheus,
There was a man in Jerico called Zaccheus,
Now the Hebrews, they were tall,
But Zaccheus, he was small,
Yet the Lord loved Zaccheus,
Better than them all.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The Lord went walking one day
through Jerico town,
And the people began to gather
from miles around,
But Zaccheus, he couldn't see,
So he climbed a sycamore tree,
And the Lord looked up and said:
"Zaccheus, come down."

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The Lord said: "Zaccheus,
I am dining with you today,
Zaccheus, I come to your house,
Come, lead the way."
Then Zaccheus, he gave a cheer,
But the people began to sneer,
"This man is a sinner,
Does the Lord seek lodging here?"

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Now Zaccheus was small of stature,
But he could show,
That a man who is stout of heart
can grow and grow:
"If I have cheated young and old,
I restore the goods fourfold."
And salvation came that day
to his whole household.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Blessed Saviour, we adore Thee,
We thy love and grace proclaim,
Thou art might, thou art Holy,
Glorious is thy matchless name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Glorious, Glorious, Glorious is thy Name, O Lord
Glorious, Glorious, Glorious is thy Name, O Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Great Redeemer, Lord and Master,
Light of all eternal days,
Let the Saints of every nation,
Sing thy just and endless praise.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: From thy throne of Heaven's glory,
To the cross of sin and shame,
Thou didst come to die a ransom,
Guilty sinners to reclaim.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Come, O come immortal Saviour,
Come and take thy royal Throne,
Come and reign and reign forever,
Be the Kingdom all thine own.

title: CHRIST IS KING OF EARTH AND HEAVEN

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Christ is King of earth and heaven;
Let his subjects all proclaim;
In the splendour of His temple,
Honour to His holy name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Christ is King! No soul created
Can refuse to bend the knee,
To the God made Man who reigneth,
As 'twas promised from the tree.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Christ is King! Let humble sorrow
For our past neglect atone,
For the lack of faithful service,
To the Master whom we own.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Christ is King! Let joy and gladness
Greet Him; let His courts resound,
With the praise of faithful subjects,
To His love in honour bound.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Christ is King! In health and sickness,
Till we breathe our latest breath,
Till we greet in highest heaven,
Christ the victory over death.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Crown him with many crowns,
The Lamb upon his throne;
Hark, how the heavenly anthem drowns
All music but its own;
Awake, my soul, and sing
Of him who died for thee,
And hail him as thy matchless King,
Through all eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Crown him the Virgin's Son,
The God incarnate born,
Whose arm those crimson trophies won,
Which now his brow adorn;
Fruit of the mystic rose,
As of that rose the stem,
The root, whence mercy ever flows,
The Babe of Bethlehem.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Crown him the Lord of love;
Behold his hands and side,
Rich wounds yet visible above,
In beauty glorified:
No angel in the sky
Can fully bear that sight,
But downward bends his burning eye
At mysteries so bright.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hail, Jesus, hail! who for my sake,
Sweet blood from Mary's veins didst take;
And shed it all for me:
Oh, blessed be my Saviour's blood,
My light, my life, my only good,
To all eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: To endless ages let us praise,
The precious blood whose price could raise,
The world from wrath and sin;
Whose streams our inward thirst appease,
And heal the sinner's worst disease,
If he but bathe therein.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Oh, Sweetest blood, that can implore,
Pardon of God, and heaven restored,
The heaven which sin had lost;
While Abel's blood for vengeance pleads,
What Jesus shed still intercedes,
For those who wrong him most.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Oh, to be sprinkled from the wells
Of Christ's own sacred blood, excels,
Earth's best and highest bliss;
The ministers of wrath divine,
Hurt not the happy hearts that shine,
With those red drops of his.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Ah, there is joy amid the Saints,
And hell's despairing courage faints,
When this sweet song we raise,
Oh, louder then, and louder still,
Earth with one mighty fill,
The precious blood to praise.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hail, Redeemer, King divine
Priest and Lamb, the throne is thine;
King whose reign shall never cease,
Prince of everlasting peace!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Angels saints and nations sing,
"Praise be Jesus Christ, our King
Lord of life, earth, sky and sea;
King of love on Calvary."

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: King, whose name creation thrills,
Rule our minds, our hearts, our wills,
Till in peace each nation rings
With thy praises, King of Kings.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: King most holy, King of truth,
Guide the lowly, guide the youth,
Christ, O King of glory bright,
Be to us eternal light!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Shepherd-king o'er mountains steep,
Homeward bring your wand'ring sheep;
Shelter in one royal fold,
States and Kingdoms new and old.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: All to Jesus I surrender,
All to Him I freely give;
I will ever love and trust Him,
In His presence daily live.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I surrender all, I surrender all.
All to Thee, my blessed Saviour,
I surrender all.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: All to Jesus I surrender,
Humbly at His feet I bow;
Worldly pleasures all forsaken,
Take me Jesus, take me now.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: All to Jesus I surrender,
Lord, I give myself to Thee;
Fill me with Thy love and power,
Let Thy blessing fall on me.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: All to Jesus I surrender,
Now I feel the sacred flame;
O the joy of full salvation!
Glory, glory to His Name!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jesus eternal truth sublime,
Through endless years the same,
Thou crown of those who through all time,
Confess Thy holy name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Thy suppliant people through the prayers,
Of thy blessed saints forgive,
For his dear sake thy wrath forbear,
And bid our spirit live.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Again returns the sacred day,
With heavenly glory bright,
Who saw Him go upon his way,
Into the beams of light.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jesus my Saviour is all things to me,
Oh what a wonderful Saviour is He,
Guiding protection o'er life troubled sea,
Mighty deliverer Jesus for me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Jesus for me, Jesus for me,
All the time everywhere, Jesus for me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Jesus in sickness, and Jesus in health,
Jesus in poverty, comfort or wealth,
Sunshine or tempest, whatever it be,
He is my safety, Jesus for me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: He is my refuge, my rock and my tower,
He is my treasure, my strength and my power,
Life everlasting, my daysman is he,
Blessed Redeemer, Jesus for me.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jesus, gentlest Saviour,
God of might and power,
Thou thyself art dwelling
In us at this hour.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Nature cannot hold thee,
Heaven is all too straight,
For thine endless glory,
And thy royal state.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Yet the hearts of children,
Hold what worlds cannot
And the God of wonders,
Loves the lowly spot.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Jesus, gentlest Saviour,
Thou art in us now;
Fill us full of goodness,
Till our hearts o'erflow.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Pray the prayer within us,
That to heaven shall rise;
Sing the song that angels
Sing above the skies.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Multiply our graces,
Chiefly love and fear,
And dear Lord, the chiefest,
Grace to persevere.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jesus is God! The solid earth,
The ocean broad and bright,
The countless stars, the golden dust,
That strew the skies at night,
The wheeling storm, the dreadful fire,
The pleasant wholesome air,
The summer's sun, the winter's frost,
His own creations were.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Jesus is God! The glorious bands
Of golden angels sing,
Songs of adoring praise to Him,
Their Maker and their King.
He was true God in Bethlehem's crib,
On Calvary's Cross true God,
He who in heaven eternal reigned,
In time on earth abode.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Jesus is God! Let sorrow come
And pain, and every ill;
All are worthwhile for all are means,
His glory to fulfill;
Worthwhile a thousand years of life,
To speak one little word,
If by our credo we might own,
The Godhead of our Lord.

title: KING OF GLORY, KING OF PEACE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: King of glory, King of peace, I will love you,
And that love may never cease, I will love you,
Thou hast granted my request,
Thou hast heard me.
Thou didst note my working breast,
Thou hast spared me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Wherefore with my utmost art, I will sing you,
And the dream of all my heart, I will sing you,
Though my sins against me cried,
Thou didst clear me,
And alone when they replied,
You did hear me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Seven whole days, not one in seven
I will praise you,
In my heart though not in heaven,
I can praise you,
Small it is in this poor sort, to enclose you,
Even eternity's too short to extol you.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O Jesus Christ, remember,
when you will come again,
Upon the clouds of heaven,
with all your shining train;
When every eye shall see you in deity reveal'd,
Who now upon this altar
in silence are concealed.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Remember then, O Saviour, I supplicate of you,
That here I bow'd before you
upon my bended knee,
That here I owned your presence,
and did not you deny,
And glorified your greatness
though hid from human eye.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Accept, divine Redeemer,
the homage of my praise;
O be the light and honour and glory
of my days,
O be my consolation when death
is drawing nigh,
O be my only treasure through all eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O Sacred heart,
Our home lies deep in thee;
On earth thou art an exile's rest,
In heaven the glory of the blest, O Sacred Heart.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O Sacred Heart,
Thou fount of contrite tears;
Wherever those living waters flow,
New life to sinners, they bestow,
O Sacred Heart.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O Sacred Heart,
Bless our dear native land;
May our Lord's sons in truth e'er stand,
With faith's bright banner still in hand,
O Sacred Heart.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O Sacred Heart,
Our trust is all in thee;
For though earth's night be dark and drear,
Thou breathest rest where thou art near,
O Sacred Heart.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O Sacred Heart,
When shades of death shall fall,
Receive us 'neath thy gentle care,
And save us from the tempter's snare,
O Sacred Heart.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: O Sacred Heart,
Lead exiled children home,
Where we may ever rest near thee,
In peace and joy eternally,
O Sacred Heart.

title: JESUS, MY LORD, MY GOD, MY ALL

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jesus, my Lord, my God, my all,
How can l love you as l ought?
And how revere this wondrous gift,
So far surpassing hope or thought?

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sweet Sacrament, You we adore;
Oh, make us love you more and more.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Had l but Mary's sinless heart,
To love you with, my dearest King,
Oh, with what bursts of fervent praise,
Your goodness, Jesus would l sing!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Ah see! within a creature's hand,
The vast Creator deigns to be,
Reposing infant-like, as though,
On Joseph's arm, or Mary's knee.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Your body, soul and Godhead, all,
O mystery of love divine!
I cannot compass all l have,
For all you have and are, are mine.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Sound, sound His praises higher still,
And come, ye angels, to our aid;
'Tis God, 'tis God, the very God;
Whose power man and angels made

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Sweet Heart of Jesus,
Fount of love and mercy,
Today we come
Thy blessing to implore;
Oh touch our hearts,
So cold and so ungrateful,
and make them, Lord,
Thine own for evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sweet heart of Jesus we implore,
Oh, make us love Thee more and more.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sweet Heart of Jesus,
Make us pure and Gentle
And teach us how
To do Thy blessed will,
To follow close
The print of Thy dear footsteps,
And when we fall,
Sweet Heart, oh love us still.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Sweet Heart of Jesus,
Bless all hearts that love Thee,
And may Thine own Heart
Ever blessed be.
Bless us, dear Lord,
And bless the friends we cherish,
And keep us true
To Mary and to Thee.

title: TO CHRIST, THE PRINCE OF PEACE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: To Christ, the prince of Peace,
And Son of God most high,
The Father of the world to come
Sing we with holy joy.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Deep in his heart for us
The wound of love he bore;
That love wherewith he still inflames
The hearts that him adore.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O Jesus victim blest,
What else but love divine
Could these constrain to open thus
That sacred heart of thine?

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O fount of endless life,
O spring of water clear,
O flame celestial, cleansing all
Who unto thee draw near!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Hide us in thy dear heart,
For thither do we fly;
There seek thy grace through life,
In death Thine immortality.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Praise to the Father be,
And sole-begotten Son;
Praise, holy Paraclete, to thee
While endless ages run

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: To Jesus' heart, all burning
With fervent love for all,
My heart with fondest yearning
Shall raise its joyful strain.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: While ages course along,
Blest be with loudest song,
The Sacred Heart of Jesus,
By every heart and tongue.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O Heart, for me on fire
With love no man can speak,
My yet untold desire
God gives me for thy sake.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Too true, I have forsaken
Thy love for wilful sin;
Yet now let me be taken
Back by thy grace again.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: As thou art meek and lowly,
And ever pure of heart,
So may my heart be wholly
Of thine the counterpart.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: When life away is flying,
And earth's false glare is done;
Still, Sacred Heart, in dying
I'll say I'm all thine own.

title: TO THEE, O HEART OF JESUS

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: To thee, O Heart of Jesus,
To Thee our hearts we give,
Help, help us all to love Thee,
And serve Thee while we live.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Yes, yes till life is o'er,
And then for evermore,
O Sacred Heart of Jesus,
We'll love Thee and adore.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: No heart can be so tender,
No heart can love like Thee:
Thy life's blood all, O Jesus,
Was shed to set us free.

title: WHAT A FRIEND WE HAVE IN JESUS

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: What a Friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
Oh, what peace we often forfeit,
Oh, what needless pain we bear ...
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness ...
Take it to the Lord in Prayer!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Are we weak and heavy-laden?
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our refuge ...
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do your friends despise, forsake you?
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
In His arms He'll take and shield you
You will find a solace there.

title: AS THE DEWY SHADES OF EVEN

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: As the dewy shades of even,
Gather o'er the balmy air,
Listen, gentle Queen of heaven,
Listen to my vesper prayer.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Holy Mother, hear me hover,
Free my thoughts from aught defiled;
With thy wings of mercy cover,
Keep from sin thy helpless child.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Thine own sinless heart was broken,
Sorrow's sword had pierced its care
Holy Mother! by that token,
Now thy pity I implore.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Queen of sorrows, guard and guide me,
Let me to thine arms repair,
In thy tender bosom hide me;
Take me, Mother to thy care.

title: AVE MARIA! O MAIDEN, O MOTHER

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Ave Maria! O Maiden, O Mother,
Proudly thy children are calling on thee;
Thine are the graces unclaimed by another,
Sinless and beautiful, star of the sea!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Mater amabilis, ora pro nobis,
Pray for thy children who call upon thee;
Ave sanctissima! Ave purrissima!
Sinless and beautiful, star of the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Ave Maria! the night shades are falling,
Softly our voices arise unto thee;
Earth's lonely exiles for succour are calling,
Sinless and beautiful, star of the sea!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Ave Maria! thou portal of heaven,
Harbour of refuge, to thee do we flee;
Lost in the darkness, by stormy winds driven,
Shine on our pathway, fair star of the sea!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Children of Mary, high your voices raise,
Ye on whom she casts her tender eyes,
Children of God, sing her immortal praise,
And all exalt her glory to the skies,
Children of Mary, high your voices raise,
Children of God, sing her immortal praise.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I see ascending to her glorious throne
The fervent prayers of every faithful child,
Each heart erects an altar to her name
Where Mary lives in everlasting fame,
Children of Mary, high your voices raise,
Children of God, sing her immortal praise.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Daily, Daily, sing to Mary,
Sing, my soul, her praises due;
All her feasts, her actions worship,
With the heart's devotion true.
Lost in wond'ring contemplation,
Be her majesty confessed:
Call her Mother, call her Virgin.
Happy Mother, Virgin blest,

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: She is mighty to deliver:
Call her, trust her lovingly;
When the tempest rages round you,
She will calm the troubled sea.
Gifts of heaven she has given,
Noble Lady! to our race;
She, the Queen, who decks her subjects
With the light of God's own grace.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sing, my tongue, the Virgin's trophies,
Who for us her Maker bore,
For the curse of old inflicted,
Peace and blessing to restore.
Sing in songs of praise unending,
Sing the world's majestic Queen:
Weary not nor faint in telling
All the gifts she gives to men.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: All my senses, heart, affections
Strive to sound her glory forth:
Spread abroad the sweet memorials
Of the Virgin's priceless worth.
Where the voice of music thrilling,
Where the tongues of eloquence,
That can utter nile beseeming
All her matchless excellence?

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: All our joys do flow from Mary,
All of them join her praise to sing:
Trembling sing the Virgin Mother,
Mother of our Lord and King.
While we sing her awful glory,
Far above our fancy's reach,
Let our hearts be quick to offer
Love the heart alone can teach.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Fading still fading the last beam is shining,
Ave Maria, the day is declining,
Safety and innocence fly with the light,
Temptation and danger walk forth in the night,
From fall of the shade to the bright
morning time,
Shield us from danger and save us from crime.
Ave Maria, Ave Maria, Ave Maria, audi nos.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hail, Queen of heav'n the ocean star,
Guide of the wand'rer here below:
Thrown on life's surge, we claim your care ...
Save us from peril and from woe.
Mother of Christ, star of the sea,
Pray for the wanderer, pray for me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O gentle, chaste, and spotless Maid,
We sinners make our prayers through you
Remind your Son that he has paid
The price of our iniquity.
Virgin most pure, star of the sea,
Pray for the sinner, pray for me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sojourners in this world of tears,
To you, blest advocate, we cry;
Pity our sorrows, calm our fears,
And soothe with hope our misery:
Refuge in grief, star of the sea,
Pray for the mourner, pray for me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And while to him who reigns above
In Godhead One, in Persons Three,
The source of life, of grace, of love,
Homage we pay on bended knee;
Do you, bright Queen, star of the sea,
Pray for your children, pray for me.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hail Queen of the Heavens,
hail Mistress of earth,
Hail Virgin most pure of immaculate birth,
Clear star of the morning in beauty enshrined,
O Mary make speed to the help of mankind,
