Clear star of the morning in beauty enshrined,
O Mary make speed to the help of mankind.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hail Mother most pure, hail Virgin renown'd,
Hail Queen with the stars as diadem crown'd,
Above all the angels in glory untold,
Standing next to the King in a vesture of gold,
Above all the angels in glory untold,
Standing next to the King in a vesture of gold.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O Mother of mercy, O Star of the sea,
O Hope of the guilty, O light of the grave,
Thro' thee may we come to the Heaven of rest,
And see Heaven's King
in the courts of the Blest,
Thro' thee may we come to the Heaven of rest,
And see Heaven's King.
in the courts of the Blest.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hail, thou star of ocean,
Portal of the sky;
Ever Virgin Mother
Of the Lord most high.
Oh! by Gabriel's Ave, Utter'd long ago,
Eva's name reversing,
'Stablish peace below.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Break the captive's fetter:
Light on blindness pour;
All our ills expelling,
Every bliss implore.
Show thyself a mother;
Offer him our sighs,
Who for us incarnate
Did not thee despise.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Virgin of all virgins,
To thy shelter take us;
Gentlest of the gentle,
Chaste and gentle make us.
Still, as on we journey,
Help our weak endeavour;
Till with thee and Jesus
We rejoice forever.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Through the highest heaven,
To the almighty Three,
Father, Son and Spirit,
One same glory be.

title: HOLY QUEEN! WE BEND BEFORE THEE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Holy Queen! we bend before thee,
Queen of purity divine!
Make us love thee, we implore thee;
Make us truly to be thine.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Teach, oh teach us Holy Mother;
How to conquer ev'ry sin;
How to love and help each other;
How the prize of life to win.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Thou to whom a child was given,
Greater than the sons of men,
Coming down from highest heaven,
To create the world again.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Oh by that almighty Maker,
Whom thyself a Virgin bore!
Oh by thy supreme Creator;
Link'd with Thee for evermore!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: By the hope thy name inspires,
Be our doom reversed through thee,
Help us, Queen of Angel-Choirs,
To a blest eternity!

title: I'LL SING A 🎼 HYMN TO MARY

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I'll sing a hymn to Mary,
The Mother of my God,
The Virgin of all virgins,
Of David's royal blood,
O teach me, holy Mary,
A loving song to frame,
When wicked men blaspheme thee,
To love and bless thy name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O noble tower of David
Of gold and ivory
The ark of God's own promise,
The gate of Heav'n to me,
To live and not to love thee,
Would fill my soul with shame;
When wicked men blaspheme thee,
I'll love and bless thy name.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: The saints are high in glory,
With golden crowns so bright
But brighter far is Mary,
Upon her throne of light,
Oh, that which God did give thee,
Let mortal ne'er disclaim;
When wicked men blaspheme thee
I'll love and bless thy name.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: But in the crown of Mary,
There lies a wondrous gem,
As Queen of all the angels,
Which Mary shares with them,
"No sin hath e'er defied thee,"
So doth our faith proclaim,
When wicked men blaspheme thee
I'll love and bless thy name.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Immaculate Mary!
Our hearts are on fire;
That title so wondrous
Fills all our desire.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Ave, ave, ave, Maria;
Ave, ave, ave, Maria.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: We pray for God's glory,
May His Kingdom come;
We pray for His vicar,
Our Father and Rome.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: We pray for our Mother,
The Church upon earth;
And bless, sweetest Lady,
The Land of our birth.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: We pray for all sinners
And souls that now stray,
From Jesus and Mary
In heresy's way.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: In grief and temptation,
In joy, or in pain,
We'll seek thee, our Mother,
Nor seek thee in vain.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: O bless us, dear Lady,
With blessings from heaven,
And to our petitions
Let answer be given.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Now to God be all glory,
And worship for aye,
And to God's Virgin Mother
And endless Ave.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Our homes and our country
We pray in thy keeping,
To love and to serve Thee
In gladness and weeping.

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: We pray for the Church
In the hour of her mourning,
We pray for all sinners
Still deaf to Thy warning.

verses.label: VERSE 11
lines: We pray for the Vicar of Christ
On whom presses,
The weight of the world
And its cruel distresses.

verses.label: VERSE 12
lines: O Queen of the Rosary,
Be thou our salvation,
Our refuge in life,
And our true consolation.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Be the answer to our prayer;
For thy Son of all the wretched,
Gives to thee perpetual care.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Ever ready help hast thou,
Let thy children feel it now.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Of our passions we are weary,
Weary of the yoke of sin;
Yet though longing to be holy,
Faint of heart, we ne'er begin.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Though we try to rise, yet ever,
Down in misery we fall;
So like feeble children sadly,
For our Mother's help we call.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let us feel thy help in sorrow,
Mourners look for joy to thee;
Spurn not God's unhappy creatures,
Whatsoe'er their faults may be.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Succour all, both Priests and people,
Who to thee their homage pay;
Toiling men and praying women,
Help them on thy festal day.

title: O COME TO THE THRONE OF GRACE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O come to the throne of grace,
O come to the heart most pure;
To Mary our hope of life,
In whom salvation is sure.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O Lady of Fatima, Hail
Immaculate Mother of grace;
O pray for us, help us to-day
Thou hope of the human race.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Immaculate Heart we kneel
To consecrate all to thee;
The present, its pain and joy
The future, all it may be.

title: O MAID CONCEIVED WITHOUT A STAIN

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O Maid conceived without a stain,
O Mother bright and fair,
Come thou within our hearts to reign
And grace shall triumph there.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hail Mary ever undefiled!
Hail Queen of Purity!
O make thy children chaste and mild,
And turn their hearts to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O Mother of all mothers best
Who soothest every grief,
In thee the weary find their rest,
And anguished hearts relief.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O purest of creatures,
Sweet Mother, sweet Maid;
The one spotless womb
Wherein Jesus was laid.
Dark night hath come down on us,
Mother, and we
Look out for thy shining,
Sweet Star of the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Deep night hath come down
On this rough-spoken world,
And the banners of darkness
Are boldly unfurled;
And the tempest-tossed Church,
All her eyes are on thee,
They look to thy shining
Sweet Star of the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: He gazed on thy soul,
It was spotless and fair,
For the empire of sin,
It had never been there;
None ever had owned thee,
Dear Mother but He,
And He blest thy clear shining,
Sweet Star of the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Earth gave Him one lodging,
'Twas deep in thy breast,
And God found a home where
The sinner finds rest;
His home and his hiding-place
Both were in thee,
He was won by thy shining
Sweet Star of the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Oh blissful and calm
Was the wonderful rest,
That thou gavest thy God
In thy virginal breast;
For the heaven he left
He found heaven in thee,
And he shone in thy shining
Sweet Star of the sea.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Queen of heaven, rejoice,
Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: For the Lord whom you were worthy to bear,
Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Has risen as he said,
Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Pray for us to God,
Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: To win my heart with visions bright and fair,
In vain the world with all its craft has tried;
Harmless and weak its dazzling weapons are,
I nothing fear with Jesus at my side.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The Cherubim, the Cherubim,
And Seraphim, and Seraphim,
And heavenly hosts, that swell the glad refrain,
In that Mary land, that Mary land.
And mother Mary, Queen of heaven shall reign,
And mother Mary, Queen of heaven shall reign.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Come, all ye proud ones of the earth,
Array your gathering hosts
around me far and wide:
My heart is calm amid the loud affray,
I do not fear with Jesus at my side.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Death hath for me no fear; its bitter pains
Shall never from my King my heart divide;
Faithful to him till death my will remains,
I do not fear with Jesus at my side.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Though all the terrors of the last dread day,
With death and hell together were allied,
Though Heaven and earth before me fled away,
I do not fear with Jesus at my side.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Jesus my Lord, my only hope and shield,
No power of ill before Thee can abide;
I trust in Thee upon the battle field,
I do not fear with Jesus at my side.

title: THE CANTICLE OF THE BLESSED VIRGIN (MAGNIFICAT)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: The Lord has done marvels for me,
Holy his name, Alleluia!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: My soul glorifies the Lord,
My Spirit rejoices in God, my Saviour.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: He looks on his servant in her nothingness;
Henceforth all ages will call me blessed.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: The Almighty works marvels for me.
Holy his name!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: His mercy is from age to age,
On those who fear him.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: He puts forth his arm in strength
And scatters the proud hearted.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: He casts the mighty from their thrones
And raises the lowly.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: He fills the starving with good things,
sends the rich away empty.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: He protects Israel, his servant,
remembering his mercy.

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: The mercy promised to our fathers,
For Abraham and his sons forever.

verses.label: VERSE 11
lines: Praise the Father, the Son and Holy Spirit,
Both now and forever, world without end.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We fly to thy protection
We fly to thy patronage
O holy Mother of God
O holy Mother of God
Despise not our prayers
Despise not our prayers
In our necessities
But from all dangers deliver us
Oh ever glorious and Blessed Virgin.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: You are the honour,
You are the glory of our people,
Holy Virgin Mary.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: You are the glory of Jerusalem,
Holy Virgin Mary.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: You are the greatest joy of Israel,
Holy Virgin Mary.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: You are the highest honour of our race,
Holy Virgin Mary.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: May you be blessed by the Lord most high,
Holy Virgin Mary.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Now, and for all ages without end,
Holy Virgin Mary.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Give praise to God in the church, and Christ,
Holy Virgin Mary.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Help, Lord, the souls that thou hast made,
The souls to thee so dear,
In prison for the debt unpaid,
Of sin committed here.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: These holy souls, they suffer on,
Resign'd in heart and will,
Until thy high behest is done,
And justice has its fill.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: For daily falls, for pardon'd crime,
They joy to undergo
The shadow of thy cross sublime,
The remnant of thy woe.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Oh, by their patience of delay,
Their hope amid their pain,
Their sacred Zeal to burn away,
Disfigurement and stain.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Oh, by their fire of love, not less
In keenness than the flame;
Oh, by their very helplessness;
Oh, by thy own great Name.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Good Jesus, help! Sweet Jesus, aid
The souls to thee most dear,
In prison for the debt unpaid,
Of sins committed here.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jerusalem, my happy home,
When shall I come to thee?
When shall my sorrows have an end?
Thy joys when shall I see?

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O happy harbour of the saints!
O sweet and pleasant soil!
In thee no sorrow may be found,
No grief, no care, no toil.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: In thee no sickness may be seen,
No hurt, no ache, no sore;
In thee there is no dread of death,
But life for evermore.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: No dampish mist is seen in thee,
No cold nor darksome night;
There every soul shines as the sun;
There God himself gives light.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: There lust and lucre cannot dwell;
There envy bears no sway;
There is no hunger, heat, nor cold,
But pleasure every way.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Jerusalem, Jerusalem,
God grant I once may see
Thy endless joys, and of the same
Partaker aye may be!

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Thy walls are made of precious stones,
Thy bulwarks diamonds square;
Thy gates are of right orient pearl,
Exceeding rich and rare.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Thy turrets and thy pinnacles
With carbuncles do shine;
Thy very streets are paved with gold,
Surpassing clear and fine.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Thy houses are of ivory,
Thy windows crystal clear;
Thy tiles are made of beaten gold ...
O God that I were there.

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: Within thy gates no thing doth come
That is not passing clean;
No spider's web, no dirt, no dust,
No filth may there be seen.

verses.label: VERSE 11
lines: Ah, my sweet home, Jerusalem,
Would God I were in thee!
Would God my woes were at an end,
Thy joys that I might see!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O Paradise! O paradise!
Who doth not crave for rest?
Who would not seek the happy land,
Where they that loved are blest?

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: When loyal hearts and true,
Stand ever in the light,
All rapture through and through,
In God's most holy sight.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O Paradise! O Paradise!
Wherefore doth death delay?
Bright death that is the welcome dawn
Of our eternal day.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O Paradise! O Paradise!
'Tis weary waiting here;
I long to be where Jesus is,
To feel, to see Him near.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O Paradise! O Paradise!
I want to sin no more;
I want to be as pure on earth,
As on thy spotless shore.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: O Paradise! O Paradise!
I feel 'twill not be long;
Patience: I almost think I hear
Faint fragments of thy song.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: One thought only have we
As we journey on:
'Tis our soul's salvation,
That and that alone.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Seeking heav'n alone
Brings true happiness;
Seeking heav'n alone
Brings true happiness;
Seeking heav'n alone!
Seeking heav'n alone!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Each soul was created
For the God most high;
Naught but God, our yearnings
E'er can satisfy.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Life on earth is passing,
Vanity and show;
God alone is changeless,
God alone is true.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Though we gain the whole world,
Poor indeed are we,
If we lose our Jesus
For eternity.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Seek then, but salvation,
Seek that peace and joy
Which endure forever,
Bliss without alloy.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Maiden Mother, lead me
To my Saviour's throne,
Keep and guard and guide me,
Make me all His own.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: There is a home eternal,
Beautiful and bright,
Where sweet joys supernal,
Ne'er are dimm'd by night,
White rob'd Angels are singing
Ever around the bright throne,
When, oh when shall I see thee
Beautiful, beautiful Home.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Home beautiful Home,
Bright beautiful Home,
Bright home of our Saviour,
Beautiful home.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Flowers are ever springing
In that home so fair,
Little children are singing
Praises to Jesus there,
How they swell the glad Anthem
Ever around the bright throne
When, oh when shall I see thee
Beautiful, beautiful, Home?

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Soon shall I join the ransomed
Far beyond the sky,
Christ is my Salvation
Why should I fear to die?
Soon my eyes shall behold him
Seated upon the bright throne,
Then, oh then shall I see thee
Beautiful, beautiful Home

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Yes, heaven is the prize,
My soul shall strive to gain;
One glimpse of Paradise
Repays a life of pain.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: 'Tis heaven - 'tis heaven;
Yes, heaven is the prize.
'Tis heaven - 'tis heaven;
Yes, heaven is the prize.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Yes, heaven is the prize,
My soul, O think of this;
All earthly goods despise,
For such a crown of bliss.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Yes, heaven is the prize,
When sorrows press around;
Look up beyond the skies,
Where hope and strength are found.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Yes, heaven is the prize,
O, 'tis not hard to gain;
He surely wins who tries -
For hope can conquer pain.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Yes, heaven is the prize,
The strife will soon be past;
Faint not, but raise your eyes,
And struggle till the last.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Yes, I shall arise and return to my father.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: To you, O Lord, I lift up my soul;
In you, O my God, I place all my trust.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Look down on me, have mercy, O Lord;
Forgive me my sins, behold all my grief.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: My heart and soul shall yearn for your face;
Be gracious to me and answer my plea.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Do not withhold your goodness from me;
O Lord, may your love be deep in my soul.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: To you I pray, have pity on me;
My God, I have sinned against your great love.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Mercy I cry, O Lord, wash me clean;
And whiter than snow my spirit shall be.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: Give me again the joy of your help;
Now open my lips, your praise I will sing.

verses.label: VERSE 9
lines: Happy is he forgiven by God;
His sins blotted out, his guilt is no more.

verses.label: VERSE 10
lines: You are my joy, my refuge and strength;
Let all upright hearts give praise to the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 11
lines: My soul will sing, my heart will rejoice;
The blessing of the God will fill all my days.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Adeste, fideles,
Laeti triumphantes;
Venite, Venite in Bethlehem;
Natum videte.
Regem angelorum:

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Venite adoremus,
Venite adoremus,
Venite adoremus Dominum.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Deum de Deo,
Lumen de lumine,
Gestant puellae viscera:
Deum verum,
Genitum non factum: Venite,.....

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: En grege relicto
Humiles ad cunas
Vocati pastores adproperant
Et nos ovanti
Gradu festinemus: Venite,.....

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Stella duce, Magi
Christum adorantes
Aurum thus et myrrham dant munera
lesu infanti
Corda praebeamus: Venite.....

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Adoremus in aeternum,
Sanctissimum Sacramentum.
Adoremus in aeternum,
Sanctissimum Sacramentum.
Laudate Dominum omnes gentes
Laudate eum omnes populi.
Quaniam confirmata est super
nos misericordia ejus: et veritas
Domini manet in aeternum.
Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto,
Sicut erat in principio,
et nunc et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Quae sub his figuris vere latitas:
Tibi se cor meum totum subjicit,
Quia te contemplans totum deficit.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Visus tactus, gustus in te fallitur,
Sed auditu solo tuto creditur:
Credo quidquid dixit Dei filius,
Nil hoc verbo veritatis verius.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: In cruce latebat sola Deitas,
At hic latet simul et humanitas:
Ambo tamen credens, atque confitens
Peto quod petivit latro poenitens.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Plagas sicut Thomas non intueor,
Deum tamen meun te confiteor,
Fac me tibi semper magis credere,
In te spem habere, te diligere.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: O memoriale mortis Domini,
Panis vivus vitam praestans homini:
Praesta meae menti de te vivere
Et te illi semper dulce sapere.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Pie pellicane, Iesu Domine,
Me immundum munda tuo sangunie:
Cujus una stilla salvum facere
Totum mundum quit ab omni scelere.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Iesu, quem velatum nunc aspicio,
Oro fiat illud, quod tam sitio,
Ut te revelata cernens facie,
Visu sim beatus tuae gloriae. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Anima Christi, sanctifica me,
Corpus Christi, salva me,
Sanguis Christi, inebria me,
Aqua lateris Christi, lava me
Passio Christi, conforta me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O bone Jesu, exaudi me, (x2)
In hora mortis meae voca me,
Et jube me venire ad te,
Et cum Sanctis tuis laudem te
In saecula saeculorum. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Attende Domine, et miserere,
Quia peccavimus tibi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Ad te Rex summe, omnium redemptor.
Oculos notros sublevamus flentes;
Exaudi, Christe, supplicantum preces.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Dextera Patris, lapis angularis,
Via salutis, ianua caelestis,
Ablue nostri maculas delicti.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Rogamus, Deus, tuam maiestatem.
Auribus sacris gemitus exaudi
Crimina nostra placidus indulge.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Tibi fatemur crimina admissa.
Contrito corde pandimus occulta
Tua, Redemptor, pietas ignoscat.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Innocens captus, nec repugnans ductus,
Testibus falsis pro impiis damnatus;
Qui redemisti, tu conserva, Christe.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Ave maris stella,
Dei Mater alma,
Atque semper Virgo,
Felix caeli porta.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Sumens illud Ave
Gabrielis ore,
Funda nos in pace,
Mutans Hevae nomen.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Solve vincla reis,
Profer lumen caecis,
Mala nostra pelle,
Bona cuncta posce.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Monstra te esse matrem,
Sumat per te preces,
Qui pro nobis natus
Tulit esse tuus.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Virgo singularis,
Inter omnes mitis,
Nos culpis solutos
Mites fac et castos.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Vitam praesta puram,
Iter para tutum,
Ut videntes Jesum,
Semper collaetemur.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Sit laus Deo Patri,
Summo Christo decus,
Spiritui sancto,
Tribus honor unus.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Ave, Regina caelorum!
Ave, Domina angelorum!
Salve radix, salve porta,
Ex qua mundo lux est orta.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Gaude, Virgo gloriosa,
Super omnes speciosa
Vale, o valde decora!
Et pro nobis Christum exora.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: V. Dignare me laudare te, Virgo sacrata.
R. Da mihi virtutem contra hostes tuos.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Ave verum Corpus natum
De Maria Virgine,
Vere passum, immolatum
In cruce pro homine,
Cujus latus perforatum
Fluxit aqua et sanguine,
Esto nobis praegustatum
Mortis in examine.
O Jesu, dulcis, O Jesu Pie,
O Jesu, fill Mariae.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Benedictus qui venit,
In nomine Domini.
Benedictus qui venit,
In nomine Domini.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Hosanna! Hosanna!
Hosanna in excelsis.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Ecce panis angelorum,
Factus cibus viatorum,
Vere panis filiorum,
Non mittendus canibus.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: In figuris presignatur,
Cum Isaac immolatur
Agnus Paschae deputatur,
Datur manna patribus.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Bone Pastor, Panis vere,
Jesu nostri miserere,
Tu nos pasce nos tuere,
Tu nos bona fac videre,
In terra viventium.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Jesu dulcis memoria,
Dans vera cordis gaudia:
Sed super mel, et omnia,
Ejus dulcis praesentia.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Nil canitur suavius,
Nil auditur jucundius,
Nil cogitatur dulcius,
Quam Jesus Dei Filius.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Jesu spes poenitentibus,
Quam pius es petentibus!
Quam bonus te quaerentibus!
Sed quid invenientibus?

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Nec lingua valet dicere
Nec littera exprimere:
Expertus potest credere,
Quid sit Jesum diligere.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Sis, Jesu, nostrum gaudium,
Qui es futurus praemium:
Sit nostra in te gloria,
Per cuncta semper saecula.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Lauda, Sion, Salvatorem,
Lauda ducem et pastorem,
In hymnis et canticis:
Quantum potes, tantum aude,
Quia major omni laude,
Nec laudare sufficis.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Laudis thema specialis,
Panis vivus et vitalis
Hodie proponitur;
Quem in sacrae mensa coenae,
Turbae fratrum duodenae
Datum non ambigitur.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sit laus plena, sit sonora,
Sit jucunda, sit decora
Mentis jubilatio:
Dies enim solemnis agitur,
In qua mensae prima recolitur
Huius institutio.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: In hac mensa novi Regis,
Novum Pascha novae legis,
Phase vetus terminat:
Vetustatem novitas,
Umbram fugat veritas
Noctem lux eliminat.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O esca viatorum,
O panis angelorum,
O manna caelitum!
Esurientes ciba,
Dulcedine non priva,
Corda quaerentium.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O lympha, fons amoris,
Qui puro Salvatoris
E corde profluis!
Te sitientes pota,
Haec sola nostra vota,
His una sufficis.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: O lesu tuum vultum,
Quem colimus occultum
Sub panis specie,
Fac, ut remoto velo,
Aperta nos in caelo,
Cernamus facie.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O Salutaris hostia,
Quae coeli pandis ostium;
Bella premunt hostilia,
Da robur fer auxilium.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Uni trinoque Domino,
Sit sempiterna gloria,
Qui vitam sine termino,
Nobis donet in patria. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O sanctissima, O piissima,
Dulcis virgo Maria!
Mater amata, intemerata,
Ora, ora pro nobis.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Tu solacium et refugium,
Virgo, mater Maria!
Quidquid optamus, per te speramus
Ora, ora pro nobis.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Ecce debiles, perquam flebiles,
Salva nos, O Maria!
Tolle languores, sana dolores,
Ora, ora pro nobis.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Virgo, respice, Mater, adspice,
Audi nos, O Maria!
Tu medicinam portas divinam,
Ora, ora pro nobis.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Tua gaudia et suspiria,
luvent nos, O Maria!
In te speramus, ad te clamamus,
Ora, ora pro nobis.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Pange lingua gloriosi
Corporis Mysterium,
Sanguinisque pretiosi,
Quem in mundi pretium,
Fructus ventris generosi
Rex effudit gentium.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Nobis datus, nobis natus
Ex intacta Virgine,
Et in mundo conversatus,
Sparso verbi semine,
Sui moras incolatus
Miro clausit ordine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: In supremae nocte coenae,
Recumbens cum fratribus,
Observata lege plene
Cibis in legalibus;
Cibum turbae duodenae
Se dat suis manibus.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Verbum caro, panem verum
Verbo carnem efficit;
Fitque sanguis Christi merum;
Et si sensus deficit,
Ad firmandum cor sincerum
Sola fides sufficit.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Parce Domine, parce populo tuo;
Ne in aeternum irascaris nobis.
Spare O Lord, spare Thy people;
Be not angry with us forever.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Salve Mater misericodiae,
Mater Dei et Mater veniae,
Mater spei et Mater gratiae,
Mater plena sanctae laetitiae, O Maria.
R/. Salve Mater

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Salve decus humani generis,
Salve Virgo dignior ceteris,
Quae virgines omnes transgrederis
Et altius sedes in superis, O Maria.
R/. Salve Mater

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Salve felix Virgo puerpera;
Nam qui sedet in Patris dextera,
Caelurn regens, terram et aethera,
Intra tua se clausit viscera, O Maria.
R/. Salve Mater

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Te creavit Pater ingenitus
Obumbravit te Unigenitus,
Fecundavit te Sanctus Spiritus,
Tu es facta tota divinitus, O Maria.
R/. Salve Mater

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Te creavit Deus mirabilem,
Te respexit ancillam humilem,
Te quaesivit sponsam amabilem,
Tibi numquam fecit consimilem, O Maria.
R/. Salve Mater

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Esto mater nostrum solacium;
Nostrum esto tu Virgo gaudium;
Et nos tandem post hoc exsilium,
Laetos iunge choris caelestium, O Maria.
R/. Salve Mater

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Salve, Regina, Mater misericordiae;
Vita, dulcedo, et spes nostra, salve.
Ad te clamamus, exsules filii havae,
Ad te suspiramus,
Gementes et flentes
In hac lacrimarum valle.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Eia ergo, advocata nostra,
Illos tuos misericordes oculos
Ad nos converte;
Et Iesum, benedictum fructum ventris tui,
Nobis post hoc exsilium ostende,
O clemens, O pia, O dulcis Virgo Maria.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Tantum ergo Sacramentum,
Veneremur cernui,
Et antiquum documentum
Novo cedat ritui,
Praestet fides supplementum,
Sensuum defectui.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Genitori, Genitoque;
Laus et jubilatio,
Salus, honor, virtus quoque,
Sit et benedictio,
Procedenti ab utroque,
Compar sit laudatio. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Veni, Creator Spiritus,
Mentes tuorum, visita,
Imple superna gratia,
Quae tu creasti, pectora.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Qui diceris Paraclitus,
Altissimi donum Dei,
Fons vivus, ignis, caritas,
Et spiritalis unctio.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Tu septiformis munere,
Digitus paternae dexterae,
Tu rite promissum Patris
Sermone ditans guttura.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Accende lumen sensibus,
Infunde amorem cordibus,
Infirma nostri corporis
Virtute firmans perpeti.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Hostem repellas longius,
Pacemque dones protinus,
Ductore sic te praevio,
Vitemus omne noxium.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Per te sciamus da Patrem,
Noscamus atque Filium,
Teque utriusque Spiritum
Credamus omni tempore.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Deo Patri sit gloria,
Et Filio qui a mortuis
Surrexit, ac Paraclito,
In saeculorum saecula. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 8
lines: V. Emitte spiritum tuum et creabuntur.
R. Et renovabis faciem terrae.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Veni Jesu Amor Mi,
Veni, veni, veni Amor Jesu,
Veni Jesu Amor Mi
Veni, O Amor Mi.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Veni Jesu Amor Mi
V-E-N-I, veni Amor Mi;
Veni Jesu Amor Mi
Veni, veni O Amor Mi.
V-E-N-I-, veni Amor Mi;
V-E-N-l-, veni Amor Mi.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Vexilla Regis prodeunt:
Fulget crucis mysterium;
Qua vita mortem pertulit,
Et morte vitam protulit.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Quae vulnerata lanceae
Mucrone diro, criminum
Ut nos lavaret sordibus,
Manavit unda et sanguine.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Impleta sunt, quae concinit
David fideli carmine,
Dicendo nationibus
Regnavit a ligno Deus.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Arbor decora et fulgida,
Ornata Regis purpura,
Electa digno stipite
Tam sancta membra tangere.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Beata cujus brachiis
Pretium pependit saeculi,
Statera facta corporis,
Tulitque praedam tartari.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: O Crux, ave, spes unica,
Hoc Passionis Tempore
Piis adauge gratiam
Reisque dele crimina.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Te, fons salutis, Trinitas,
Collaudet omnis spiritus:
Quibus crucis victoriam
Largiris, adde praemium. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Beautiful Saviour, King of creation,
Son of God and son of man!
Truly I'd love Thee, Truly I'd serve Thee,
Light of my soul, my joy, my crown!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Fair are the meadows, fairer the woodlands,
Robed in flow'rs of blooming spring.
Jesus is fairer, Jesus is purer;
He makes our sorrowing spirit sing.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Come to me, Beloved
Babe of Bethlehem;
Lay aside thy sceptre
And thy diadem.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Bid all fear and doubting
From my soul depart,
As I feel the beating
Of thy human heart.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Look upon me sweetly
With thy human eyes;
With thy human finger
Point me to the skies.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Guide me, ever guide me
With thy pierced hand,
Till I reach the borders
Of the pleasant land.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Then, my own beloved,
Take me home to rest,
Whisper words of comfort,
Lay me on thy breast.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: By the quiet waters
Sweetest Jesus, lead;
'Mid the Virgin lilies
Purest Jesus, feed.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: Only thee, Beloved,
Only thee I seek,
Thee, the man Christ Jesus
Strength in flesh made weak.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Dear children, praise the Lord in all,
Early and late, in mirth and tears.
Lift up thy voice in earnest call,
With mingled love and holy fear.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Dear children, praise His holy name,
Adore His presence, fear His word,
And oh in all be this thy aim,
Still more and more to praise the Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Praise Him for all His mercies given
In flowing streams with lavish hand,
Who made thee that thy soul in heav'n
Might ever in his presence stand.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Praise Him who in Baptismal rite
Call'd thee from sin to life of grace,
Who pour'd on thee His Holy light
To fit thee for the heav'nly place.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Hark, hark, the Angels singing,
Through all the heavenly coast,
'Tis Holy, Holy, Holy,
And thou Lord God of Host.
The starry skies around us,
The shining earth below,
The greatness of thy glory,
In bright effulgence shows.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Then, children join your voices,
And sing with one accord,
Thrice Blessed he who cometh,
In thy name, mighty Lord,
Hosanna in the Highest,
Hosanna David's Son.
Thus may we sing in glory,
Forever round his throne

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: He bought the whole field for joy,
He bought the whole field for sheer joy.
A man found a treasure,
it was hidden in a field,
He bought the whole field for joy.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Paul was a Hebrew by birth,
He left his land to inherit the earth.
He sowed God's word,
And when the seed gave yield
in the hearts of a few,
He bought the whole field.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: A rich young man searching for truth,
Who kept his commandments
the whole of his youth,
Was promised a kingdom,
If he gave all he had.
But he did not have the vision of Paul,
Who bought the whole field for joy.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Howl, you, for the day of the Lord is near,
Howl, my soul, for the day of the Lord is here,
Let every knee be bent, ev'ry head be bowed,
For He will come like thunder
tearing up the cloud.
Howl, my soul, tremble, my soul, in fear.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Weep, you, for he comes to judge the land,
Weep, my soul, for none but the just shall stand,
He will come in a whirl-wind to uproot the trees,
Yet He will rock my soul,
for the judgment is at hand.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sing, you, for the Lord was born of men,
Sing, my soul, for the Lord returns again,
He will breath new Spirit into old dry bones,
Trade a heart of flesh for a heart of stone,
Sing, my soul, sing my soul. Amen.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Peace, you, there's no need to be afraid,
Peace, my soul, for He knows
of what you're made,
Though mountains crumble
when He bares His breast,
In the crook of His arm I will lie to rest,
Peace, my soul, it is the moment
for which you've prayed.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I come to thee once more my God,
No longer will I roam,
For I have sought thee wide world through
And never found a home.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Though bright and many are the spots,
Where I have built a nest,
Yet in the brightest still I pined
For more abiding rest.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Riches could bring me joy and power
And they were fair to see,
Yet Gold was but a sorry god
To serve instead of Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Then honour and world's good word
Appear a nobler faith,
Yet could I rest on bliss that hung
And trembled on a breath.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: For thou hast made this wondrous soul
All for thyself alone,
Ah, send thy sweet transforming word
To make it more thine own.

title: IT'S A LONG ROAD TO FREEDOM

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: It's a long road to freedom,
A winding steep and high,
But when you walk in love,
With the wind of your wing,
And cover the earth with the songs you sing,
The miles fly by.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I walked one morning by the sea,
And all the waves reached out to me,
I took their tears, then let them be.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: I walked one morning at the dawn,
When bits of night still lingered on,
I sought my star, but it was gone.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: I walked one morning with a friend,
And prayed the day would never end,
The years have flown - so why pretend?

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: I walked one morning with the king,
And all my winters turned to spring,
Yet ev'ry moment held its sting.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Joy-bells ringing, children singing,
Fill the air with music sweet;
Joyful measure, guileless pleasure,
Make the chain of song complete.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Joy-bells! Joy-bells!
Never, never cease your ringing!
Children! Children!
Never, never cease your singing!
List, list, the song that swells -
Joy-bells! Joy-bells!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Joy-bells ringing, children singing,
Hark their voices loud and clear,
Breaking o'er us, like a
From a purer, happier sphere.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Earth seems brighter,
Heart grows lighter,
As the gladsome melody
Charms our sadness into gladness,
Pealing, pealing joyfully.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Joy-bells nearer sound, and clearer,
When the heart is free from care;
Skies are cheering, and we're hearing
Joy-bells ringing everywhere.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I saw rain drops on my window,
Joy is like the rain,
Laughter runs across my pain,
Slips away and comes again,
Joy is like the rain.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I saw clouds upon a mountain,
Joy is like a cloud,
Sometimes silver, sometimes gray,
Always sun not far away,
Joy is like a cloud.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: I saw Christ in wind and thunder,
Joy is tried by storm,
Christ asleep within my boat,
Whipped by wind yet still afloat,
Joy is tried by storm.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: I saw rain drops on the river,
Joy is like the rain,
Bit by bit the river grows,
Till all at once it overflows,
Joy is like the rain.

title: LITTLE KING SO FAIR AND SWEET

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Little King, so fair and sweet,
See us gathered round Thy feet;
Be Thou Monarch of our School,
It shall prosper 'neath Thy rule
We will be Thy subjects true,
Brave to suffer, brave to do,
All our hearts to Thee we bring
Take them, keep them little King.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Raise Thy little Hand to bless
All our childhood's happiness;
Bless our sorrow and our pain,
That each cross may be our gain,
By Thine own sweet childhood, Lord
Sanctify each thought and word,
Set Thy seal on everything,
Which we do, O little King.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Be our Teacher when we learn,
All the hard to easy turn;
Be our Playmate when we play,
So we shall indeed be gay,
Keep us happy, keep us pure,
While our childhood shall endure,
All its days to Thee we bring,
Bless them, guard them, little King.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Be our Leader in the fight,
In the darkness be our Light,
O'er the rough and o'er the smooth,
Safely guide our wayward youth,
Whereso'er our path may be,
We will try to follow Thee,
To Thy mantle we will cling,
Help us, save us, little King.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Little King, so dear and sweet,
Here we cast before Thy feet
All we are or yet may be,
Every sense and faculty;
All our body, all our soul
We subject to Thy control
Let them all Thy praises sing,
Now and always, little King.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Let us in the noisy world,
Keep Thy banner broad unfurled,
In an age of ease and pride,
Leading Christian lives denied,
In an age which seeks its way,
Glad and cheeful to obey,
While Thy simple Truth shall ring,
In word and act, O little King.

verses.label: VERSE 7
lines: And when holidays have come,
Call Thy children to Thy home,
In that gentle Voice of Thine,
Which we know, sweet child Divine,
At the gate, O! meet us thus,
As we loved Thee - Child like us,
Stretch Thy hands in welcoming,
To Thine own, O little King.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: O holy Lord, by all adored,
Our trespasses confessing,
To you this day your children pray,
Our holy faith professing,
Accept O King, the gifts we bring,
Our songs of praise,
The prayer we raise,
And grant us Lord, your blessing.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: To God on high be thanks and praise,
Who deigns our bonds to sever,
His care shall guide us all our days,
And harm shall reach us never,
On Him we rest with faith assured:
Of all that live,
He is the Lord,
Forever and forever.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Of how much more value are you than these!
Of how much more value are you than these!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Look at the sparrow: he neither sows nor reaps;
he has no barn, no storehouse,
yet your Father feeds him.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Look at the lily: she neither toils nor spins;
yet not even Solomon in all his glory
was arrayed like one of them.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Look at the green grass: see how it
flourishes in the fields.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: So, don't worry, don't be anxious, saying,
"What shall we eat?" or "What shall we drink?"
"What shall we put on today?"
Your Father knows you need these things.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: So, give all, and be empty,
then be filled with all good things.

title: STANDING ON THE PROMISES OF GOD

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
Through eternal ages let His praises ring;
Glory in the highest, I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Stand...ing...stand...ing,...
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Stand...ing...stand...ing,...
I'm standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Standing on the promises cannot fail,
When the howling storms
of doubt and fear assail,
By the living Word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Standing on the promises I now can see
Prefect, present cleansing in the blood for me;
Standing in the liberty where Christ makes
free,
Standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong word
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Standing on the promises I cannot fall,
Listening every moment to the Spirit's call,
Resting in my Saviour as my all in all,
Standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: "Whosoever heareth!" shout, shout the sound!
Send the blessed tidings all the world around;
Spread the joyful news wherever man is found,
"Whosoever will, may come."

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: "Whosoever will! whosoever will!"
Send the proclamation over vale and hill;
'Tis a loving Father calls the wandering home;
"Whosoever will may come."

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Whosoever cometh need not delay;
Now the door is open, enter while you may;
Jesus is the True, the only Living Way;
"Whosoever will may come."

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: "Whosoever will," the promise is secure;
"Whosoever will," forever shall endure;
"Whosoever will," 'tis life for evermore;
"Whosoever will may come."

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: We're going with Jesus, walking together,
Over the path he has trod;
And up every mountain, down every valley
We walk along with God.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: We're working for the Lord on earth,
Until you find it true;
The good you do will all come back
A hundredfold to you.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: He heard his word, we know it true,
He came to save the world;
Then tell the people, all the people
Jesus keeps his word.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Would we be joyful in the Lord,
Then strValue the riches over,
Revealed to faith with His word,
And the boundless store.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: There is pardon, peace and power,
And purity, and paradise,
With all of these, in Christ for me,
Let' joyful songs of praise to him arise.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: For every sin by grace divine,
A pardon free bestowed,
And with the pardon peace is mine,
The peace in Jesus' blood.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Of grace to break the power of sin,
He gives a full supply,
The Holy Ghost the heart within,
From sin do purify.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: The power to win a soul to God,
The spirit to impart,
And He, the gift of Christ our Lord,
Dwells now in all our hearts.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: These blessings we by faith receive,
By simple child-like trust,
In Christ 'tis God's delight to give,
He promised and He must.

title: OH, THE LOVE OF MY LORD

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Oh, the love of my Lord is the essence
of all that I love here on earth.
All the beauty I see he has given to me
and his giving is gentle as silence.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Every day, every hour, every moment
have been blessed by the strength of his love,
At the turn of each tide,
he is there at my side,
and his touch is as gentle as silence.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: There've been times when I've turned
from his presence,
And I've walked other paths, other ways.
But I've called on his name in the dark
of my shame,
And his mercy was gentle as silence.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Daughter of a Mighty Father
Maiden patron of the May
Angel forms around thee gather
Macula non est in te.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Macula non est in te
Macula non est in; te
Macula non est in te
Macula non est in te

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Mother of the Son and Savior
Of the Truth the Life the Way
Guide our footsteps calm our passion
Macula non est in te

title: ON THIS DAY, O BEAUTIFUL MOTHER

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: On the day, O beautiful Mother,
On this day we give Thee our love.
Near they, Madonna, fondly we hover,
Trusting thy gentle care to prove.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: On this day we ask to share,
Dearest Mother, thy sweet care.
Aid us ere our feet astray
Wander from thy guiding way.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Queen of angels, deign to hear
Lisping children's humble pray'r,
Young hearts gain, O Virgin pure,
Sweetly to thyself allure.

title: MOTHER AT YOUR FEET IS KNEELING

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Mother at your feet is kneeling,
One who love you, 'tis your child
Who has sighed so oft to see you.
Bless me Mother bless your child
Mother when my Jesus calls me
From this world so dark and drear
From the wily snares of Satan,
Shield me, Mother Mother dear

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Dearest Mother tell my Jesus,
How I love Him fond and true
And oh Mary, dearest Mother
Tell Him I belong to you.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Plead for me when Jesus judges,
Answer for me when He asks
How I spent so many moments
How perform'd so many tasks
Mary, oh my dearest Mother
May it e'er to me be giv'n
As on earth I fondly love Thee
So, to love Thee still in Heav'n.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Mother dearest, Mother fairest,
Help of all, who call on thee.
Virgin purest, brightest, rarest,
Help us, help, we cry to thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Mary, help us, help we pray.
Mary, help us, help we pray.
Help us in all care and sorrow.
Mary, help us, help we pray.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Lady, help in pain and sorrow,
Soothe those rack'd on beds of pain,
May the golden light of morrow,
Bring them health and joy again.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Lady, help the absent loved ones.
How we miss their presence here.
May the hand of Thy protection
Guide and guard them far and near.

title: MOTHER DEAR, O PRAY FOR ME

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Mother dear, O pray for me!
Whilst far from heav'n and thee.
I wander in a fragile bark.
O'er life's tempestuous sea.
O Virgin Mother, from thy throne,
So bright in bliss above.
Protect they child and cheer my path
With thy sweet smile of love.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Mother dear, remember me!
And never cease thy care,
Till in heaven eternally,
Thy love and bliss I share.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Mother dear, O pray for me!
Should pleasure's siren lay.
E'er tempt thy child to wander far
From Virtue's path away.
When thorns beset life's devious way,
And darkling waters flow.
Then Mary aid thy weeping child,
Thyself a mother show.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Mother dear, oh pray for me,
When all seems full of cheer,
That I may all my danger see,
For surely then this near.
A Mother's help I, then, most need,
For baleful is the ray,
That paints with gold the flow'ry mead
Which blossoms in my way.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: 'Tis the month of our Mother,
The blessed and beautiful days.
When our lips and our spirits
Are glowing with love and with praise.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: All Hail! To thee dear Mary.
The guardian of our way;
To the fairest of Queens,
Be the fairest of seasons, sweet May.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Oh! what peace to her children,
'Mid sorrows and trials to know
That the love of their Mother
Hath ever a solace for woe.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And what joy to the erring.
The Sinful and sorrowful soul.
That a trust in her guidance,
Will lead to a glorious goal.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Let us sing then, rejoicing,
Then God hath so honoured our race,
as to clothe with our nature,
Sweet Mary, the Mother of Grace.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Bring flowers of the fairest, bring flowers of the rarest,
From garden and woodland and hillside and vale.
Our full hearts are swelling, our glad voices telling
The praise of the loveliest, Rose of the vale.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O Mary! we crown thee with blossoms today!
Queen of the Angels, Queen of the May.
O Mary! we crown thee with blossoms today,
Queen of the Angels, Queen of the May.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Our voices ascending, in harmony blending.
Oh! Thus may our hearts turn dear Mother, to thee.
Oh! Thus shall we prove thee, how truly we love thee,
How dark without Mary, life's journey would be.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O Virgin most tender, our homage we render.
Thy love and protection, sweet Mother, to win.
In danger defend us, in sorrow befriend us,
And shield our hearts from contagion and sin.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Of mothers the dearest, Oh, wilt thou be nearest,
When life with temptation is darkly replete?
Forsake us, o never! Our hearts be thine ever
As pure as the lilies we lay at thy feet.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Holy Mary, Mother mild,
O dearest Mother!
Hear, O hear thy feeble child,
O sweet, sweet Mother!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O, exult ye Cherubim!
And rejoice ye Seraphim!
Praise her! Praise her!
O praise our spotless Mother!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Tossed on life's tempestuous sea,
O dearest Mother!
Cast thy tender eyes on me,
O sweet, sweet Mother!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Brightest in the courts above,
O dearest Mother!
Joy of angels, Queen of love,
O sweet, sweet Mother!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Maiden Mother! hear my pray'r,
O dearest Mother!
Prove to me thy loving care,
O sweet, sweet Mother!

title: AVE MARIA (AS I KNEEL BEFORE YOU)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Ave Maria, Gratia plena,
Dominus tecum, Benedicta tu.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: As I kneel before you,
As I bow my head in prayer,
Take this day, make it yours
and fill me with your love.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: All I have I give you,
Every dream and wish are yours,
Mother of Christ, Mother of mine,
Present them to my Lord.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: As I kneel before you,
And I see your smiling face,
Ev'ry thought, ev'ry word
Is lost in your embrace.

title: O QUEEN OF THE HOLY ROSARY

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: AO Queen of the Holy Rosary!
Oh! bless us as we pray,
And offer thee our roses
In garlands day by day.
While from our Father's garden,
With loving hearts and bold,
We gather to thine honour,
Buds white and red and gold.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: O Queen of the Holy Rosary!
Each myst'ry blends with thine.
The sacred life of Jesus
In ev'ry step divine.
Thy soul was His fair garden,
Thy virgin breast His throne,
Thy tho'ts his faithful mirror,
Reflecting Him above.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sweet Lady of the Rosary,
White roses let us bring,
And lay them round thy footstool,
Before our Infant King.
For, resting in thy bosom,
God's Son was fain to be
The Child of thy obedience
And spotless purity.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My soul now glorifies,
The Lord who is my Saviour,
Rejoice for who am I,
The God has shown me favour.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: The world shall call me blessed
And ponder on my story,
In me is manifest
God's greatness and His glory.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: For those who are is his friends
And keep His laws most holy,
His mercy is never ends,
And He exalts the lowly.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: But by His power the great
The proud, the self-conceited,
The kings who sit in state,
Are humbled and defeated

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: He feeds the starving poor,
He guides His holy nation,
Fulfilling what He swore,
Long since in revelation.

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Then glorify with me,
The Lord who is my Saviour
One Holy Trinity
Forever and forever.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Dear Guardian of Mary! dear nurse of her Child!
Life's ways are full weary, the desert is wild.
Bleak sands are all round us, no home can we see.
Sweet Spouse of our Lady, we lean safe on thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: For thou to the pilgrim art father and guide,
And Jesus and Mary felt safe at thy side.
O Glorious Patron, secure shall I be,
Sweet Spouse of our Lady, if thou stay with me!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: God chose thee for Jesus and Mary, wilt thou
Forgive a poor exile for choosing thee now?
There's no saint in heaven, St. Joseph like thee,
Sweet Spouse of our Lady, do thou plead for me.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Alma Redemptóris Mater, quae pérvia caeli
porta manes, et stella maris, succ\u00farre cadénti,
s\u00fargere qui curat pópulo: tu quae genu\u00edsti,
nat\u00fara mir\u00e1nte, tuum sanctum Genitórem
Virgo prius ac postérius, Gabriélis ab ore
Sumens illud Ave, peccatórum miserére.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Loving mother of the Redeemer,
gate of heaven, star of the sea,
assist your people who have fallen yet strive to rise again,
To the wonderment of nature you bore your Creator,
yet remained a virgin after as before,
You who received Gabriel's joyful greeting,
have pity on us poor sinners.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Oh Lord my God
When I in awesome wonder
Consider all the worlds
Thy hands have made
I see the stars
I hear the rolling thunder
Thy power throughout
The universe displayed

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Then sings my soul
My Saviour God, to Thee
How great thou art,
How great thou art!
Then sings my soul
My Saviour, God, to Thee
How great Thou art,
How great Thou art!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: When through the woods
And forest glades I wander,
And hear the birds
Sing sweetly in the trees;
When I look down
From lofty mountain grandeur
And hear the brook,
And feel the gentle breeze;

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And when I think that God,
His Son not sparing,
Sent Him to die,
I scarce can take it in;
That on the cross,
my burden gladly bearing,
He bled and died
to take away my sin;

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: When Christ shall come
With shout of acclamation
And take me home
What joy shall fill my heart.
Then I shall bow
in humble adoration,
And there proclaim,
My God, how great Thou art.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: I am Thine, O Lord,
I have heard Thy voice, and it told Thy love to me;
But I long to rise in the arms of faith,
And be closer drawn to Thee.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Draw me nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died;
Draw me nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Consecrate me now to Thy service, Lord
By the power of grace divine;
Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope,
And my will be lost in Thine.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: O the pure delight of a single hour
That before Thy throne I spend,
When I kneel in prayer, and with Thee, my God,
I commune as friend with friend!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: There are depths of love that I cannot know
Till I pass the narrow sea;
There are heights of joy that I may not reach
Till I rest in peace with Thee.

title: BECAUSE HE LIVES, I CAN FACE TOMORROW

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: God sent His son, they called Him Jesus
He came to love, heal and forgive
He lived and died to buy my pardon
An empty grave is there to prove my Saviour lives.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Because He lives, I can face tomorrow
Because He lives, all fear is gone.
Because I know He holds the future
And life is worth the living just because He lives.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: How sweet to hold a new born baby
And feel the pride and joy He brings
But greater still the calm assurance
This child can face uncertain days, because He lives.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: And then one day, I'll cross the river
I'll fight life's final war with pain.
And then, as death gives way to victory
I'll see the lights of glory and I'll know He reigns.

title: COUNT YOUR BLESSINGS NAME THEM ONE BY ONE

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: When upon life's billows you are tempest tossed,
When you are discouraged, thinking all is lost,
Count your many blessings, name them one by one,
And it will surprise you what the Lord hath done.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Count your blessings, name them one by one;
Count your blessings, see what God hath done;
Count your blessings, name them one by one;
Count your many blessings, see what God hath done.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Are you ever burdened with a load of care?
Does the cross seem heavy you are called to bear?
Count your many blessings, ev'ry doubt will fly,
And you will be singing as the days go by.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: When you look at others with their lands and gold,
Think that Christ has promised you His wealth untold;
Count your many blessings, money cannot buy
Your reward in heaven, nor your home on high.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: So, amid the conflict, whether great or small,
Do not be discouraged, God is over all;
Count your many blessings, angels will attend,
Help and comfort give you to your journey's end.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: Great is Thy faithfulness, O God my Father;
There is no shadow of turning with Thee;
Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not;
As Thou hast been, Thou forever will be.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Great is Thy faithfulness!
Great is Thy faithfulness!
Morning by morning new mercies I see.
All I have needed Thy hand hath provided;
Great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Summer and winter and springtime and harvest,
Sun, moon and stars in their courses above,
Join with all nature in manifold witness
To Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth,
Thine own dear presence to cheer and to guide;
Strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow,
Blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside!

title: ALL HAIL THE POWER OF JESUS' NAME

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: All hail the power of Jesus' name!
Let angels prostrate fall.
Bring forth the royal diadem,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Bring forth the royal diadem,
and crown Him Lord of all!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Ye chosen seed of Israel's race
Ye ransomed from the fall,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all.
Hail Him who saves you by His grace,
And crown Him Lord of all!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Let every kindred, every tribe,
on this terrestrial ball,
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all.
To Him all majesty ascribe,
And crown Him Lord of all!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Oh, that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall!
We'll join the everlasting song
And crown Him Lord of all.
We'll join the everlasting song
And crown Him Lord of all.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: On a hill far away,
stood an old rugged Cross,
The emblem of suff'ring and shame;
And I love that old Cross
where the dearest and best
For a world of lost sinners was slain.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: So I'll cherish the old rugged Cross,
Till my trophies at last I lay down;
I will cling to the old rugged Cross,
And exchange it someday for a crown.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Oh, that old rugged Cross,
so despised by the world,
Has a wondrous attraction for me;
For the dear Lamb of God,
left His glory above,
To bear it to dark Calvary.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: In the old rugged Cross,
stain'd with blood so divine,
A wondrous beauty I see;
For 'twas on that old cross,
Jesus suffered and died,
To pardon and sanctify me.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: To the old rugged Cross,
I will ever be true,
Its shame and reproach gladly bear;
Then He'll call me someday
to my home far away,
Where His glory forever I'll share.

title: MY FAITH HAS FOUND A RESTING PLACE (I NEED NO OTHER ARGUMENT)

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My faith has found a resting place,
Not in device nor creed;
I trust the Ever-living One,
His wounds for me shall plead.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: I need no other argument,
I need no other plea;
It is enough that Jesus died,
And that He died for me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Enough for me that Jesus saves,
This ends my fear and doubt;
A sinful soul I come to Him,
He'll never cast me out.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: My heart is leaning on the Word,
The written Word of God,
Salvation by my Saviour's name,
Salvation through His blood.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: My great Physician heals the sick,
The lost He came to save;
For me His precious blood He shed,
For me His life He gave.

title: THERE'S NOT A FRIEND LIKE THE LOWLY JESUS

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: There's not a Friend like the lowly Jesus:
No, not one! no, not one!
None else could heal all our souls' diseases:
No, not one! no, not one!

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Jesus knows all about our struggles;
He will guide till the day is done:
There's not a Friend like the lowly Jesus:
No, not one! no, not one!

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: No friend like Him is so high and holy,
No, not one! no, not one!
And yet no friend is so meek and lowly,
No, not one! no, not one!

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: There's not an hour that He is not near us,
No, not one! no, not one!
No night so dark, but His love can cheer us,
No, not one! no, not one!

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: Did ever saint find this Friend forsake him?
No, not one! no, not one!
Or sinner find that He would not take him?
No, not one! no, not one!

verses.label: VERSE 6
lines: Was e'er a gift like the Savior given?
No, not one! no, not one!
Will He refuse us a home in heaven?*
No, not one! no, not one!

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: My hope is built on nothing less
Than Jesus' blood and righteousness.
I dare not trust the sweetest frame,
But wholly trust in Jesus' name.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: On Christ the solid rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: When darkness seems to hide His face,
I rest on His unchanging grace.
In every high and stormy gale,
My anchor holds within the veil.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: His oath, His covenant, His blood,
Support me in the whelming flood.
When all around my soul gives way,
He then is all my hope and stay.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: When He shall come with trumpet sound,
Oh may I then in Him be found.
Dressed in His righteousness alone,
Faultless to stand before the throne.

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: He leadeth me! O blessed thought,
O words with heav'nly comfort fraught;
Whate'er I do, where'er I be,
Still 'tis God's hand that leadeth me.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: He leadeth me! He leadeth me!
By His own hand He leadeth me;
His faithful follower I would be,
For by His hand He leadeth me.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: Sometimes 'mid scenes of deepest gloom,
Sometimes where Eden's flowers bloom,
By waters still, o'er troubled sea,
Still 'tis His hand that leadeth me.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Lord, I would clasp Thy hand in mine,
Nor ever murmur nor repine;
Content, whatever lot I see,
Since 'tis my God that leadeth me.

verses.label: VERSE 5
lines: And when my task on earth is done,
When, by Thy grace, the vict'ry's won,
E'en death's cold wave I will not flee,
Since God through Jordan leadeth me.

title: THIS WORLD IS NOT MY HOME I'M JUST A PASSING THROUGH

verses.label: VERSE 1
lines: This world is not my home I'm just a passing through,
My treasures are laid up somewhere beyond the blue,
The angels beckon me from heaven's open door,
And I can't feel at home in this world anymore.

verses.label: VERSE 2
lines: Oh lord you know I have no friend like you,
If heaven's not my home, then Lord what will I do.
The angels beckon me from heaven's open door,
And I can't feel at home in this world anymore.

verses.label: VERSE 3
lines: I have a loving mother just over in gloryland,
And I don't expect to stop until I shake her hand.
She's waiting now for me in heaven's open door,
And I can't feel at home in this world anymore.

verses.label: VERSE 4
lines: Just over in gloryland, we'll live eternally;
The saints on every hand are shouting victory.
Their songs of sweetest praise,
drift back from heaven's shore;
And I can't feel at home In this world anymore.
